CHR-0001.name: Maren of Hazelhollow
CHR-0001.looks: A lean, weathered woman of 49 with grey-streaked brown hair under a linen kerchief and hands thick from dairy work.
CHR-0001.manner: She speaks little and keeps her eyes down before lords, but turns plain and stubborn once she decides to speak.
CHR-0001.wants: She wants her son Tarn to stay across the Gordush and not raid before Return Day, so he lives to see summer.
CHR-0001.fears: She fears that swearing at the Drum Stones will make Tarn his half-brother's rival and get him killed.

CHR-0002.name: Hilda Rook
CHR-0002.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0002.title: Captain
CHR-0002.looks: A broad-shouldered woman of 42 with cropped dark hair, a sunburnt face and old stake-splinter scars across both palms.
CHR-0002.manner: She barks drill in short counts, swears like a sergeant, and judges every newcomer by how fast they can set a stake.
CHR-0002.wants: She wants her stake-men ready to build a Hartgate Box at the Gashmar Fords if the Emperor crosses in July.
CHR-0002.fears: She fears Iron Road crossbows in Tarn's hands, taught by Bram Hollis, a sergeant who knows the Crossmarch…

CHR-0003.name: Roland Ashby
CHR-0003.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0003.title: Master of the Lance Yard of Kingsmere, captain of the Iron Guard's
CHR-0003.looks: A tall, grey-bearded man of 54 whose right shoulder no longer lifts above the ear, with a spear scar through the left calf.
CHR-0003.manner: Patient and exact, he talks like a teacher, in few words, nearly all of them about horses, grain and shields.
CHR-0003.wants: He wants Prince Harald kept out of Harrow's May crossing, and the Iron Guard ready for the war he does not want.
CHR-0003.fears: He fears that his lance arm has lost its snap, and that the next young knight to meet him will find out.

CHR-0004.name: Garrick Harrow
CHR-0004.title: Lord of the Southern March, head of the March Hawks
CHR-0004.looks: A massive, thick-necked man of 46 with the Harrow bull-blood, who rides a huge destrier and climbs down from it stiffly.
CHR-0004.manner: Loud, blunt and impatient, he talks of the war as already won and claps men on the back hard enough to bruise.
CHR-0004.wants: He wants to cross the Gordush on 2 May with 4,000 lances and Prince Harald, seize Tarn Halfblood and retake the upper river.
CHR-0004.fears: He fears his heart and stiffening joints will fail him before he wins back the river Aldmark gave up in 1074.

CHR-0005.name: Leofric Stane
CHR-0005.title: Marshal
CHR-0005.looks: A spare, upright man of 57 with a close white beard, a once-broken nose and a plain red wool cloak over old mail.
CHR-0005.manner: Dry and careful, he answers questions with counts of men, wagons and days, and never raises his voice in council.
CHR-0005.wants: He wants the first host of 20,000 fed, shod and ready to cross the Gashmar Fords in July if Vrag still shelters Tarn.
CHR-0005.fears: He fears Harrow will start the war in May with half the army and leave him to finish it on open grass in July…

CHR-0006.name: Emeric Vane
CHR-0006.title: Master
CHR-0006.looks: A stout, well-fed man of 55 in a fur-lined green cloak, with ink-stained fingers and a heavy amber seal-ring.
CHR-0006.manner: Smooth and friendly, he talks profit in every second sentence and never lets anyone see the bottom of his purse.
CHR-0006.wants: He wants an Aldmark garrison on the Iron Road and first claim for his company on every bar of Irondeep iron.
CHR-0006.fears: He fears the dwarves of Irondeep, who drowned three of his prospecting miners in the hills and never forgive…

CHR-0007.name: Edda Holt
CHR-0007.title: Mistress
CHR-0007.looks: A lean, freckled woman of 44 with straw-colored braids, mud-caked riding boots and a horse-bite scar on one forearm.
CHR-0007.manner: Brisk and horse-mad, she speaks to stallions more gently than to men and haggles like a cattle drover.
CHR-0007.wants: She wants fresh steppe blood for the Millrun herds before May, even if the horses come from across the Gordush.
CHR-0007.fears: She fears a horse sickness reaching the Millrun studs and costing Aldmark its cavalry in the year of war.

CHR-0008.name: Tova Brand
CHR-0008.title: Master
CHR-0008.looks: A tall, sharp-featured woman of 50 with grey-blond hair under a linen cap and a string of amber beads at her throat.
CHR-0008.manner: Cool and quick with figures, she speaks softly and lets long silences make other merchants nervous.
CHR-0008.wants: She wants Frostholm's giants to sell tin direct for 3,000 bushels of rye a summer, cutting out Northreach's Tin Reeves.
CHR-0008.fears: She fears Northreach's ebb-ships will seize her tin cog in Cold Bay and call the voyage an act of war.

CHR-0009.name: Audra Fairrush
CHR-0009.looks: A handsome, straight-backed woman of 43 with dark auburn hair in a net, a green wool gown and her father's signet ring.
CHR-0009.manner: Polite and precise, she argues law in the Oath Moot from memory and never lets an old right pass unmentioned.
CHR-0009.wants: She wants to limit the Emperor's new taxes and keep the old jarls' right to judge their own people.
CHR-0009.fears: She fears that a quick win on the Gordush will make the Emperor strong enough to ignore the Oath Moot.

CHR-0010.name: Sigurd Greymane
CHR-0010.title: Jarl
CHR-0010.looks: A big, grey-maned man of 60 with a wind-reddened face, a forked beard and a heavy fur cloak pinned with iron.
CHR-0010.manner: Gruff and proud, he speaks of his forefathers as if they sat at the table, and laughs loudly at his own grudges.
CHR-0010.wants: He wants to see the truce record of 946 at Wolfhaven and prove Harald Ironside broke his truce with Ulf Greymane.
CHR-0010.fears: He fears his house will be bled dry by Ironside taxes while the Emperor's own cousin is treated like any jarl.

CHR-0011.name: Wendel Marsh
CHR-0011.title: Treasurer
CHR-0011.looks: A thin, stooped man of 52 with a bald crown, a neat grey beard and a ring of treasury keys at his belt.
CHR-0011.manner: Quiet and fussy, he counts under his breath and answers every request by naming its cost first.
CHR-0011.wants: He wants more Irondeep iron on credit for the Gordush and fir masts for the Cold Bay fleet without paying hard coin.
CHR-0011.fears: He fears Irondeep calling in the 24,000 hold-marks Aldmark owes it in the middle of a war.

CHR-0012.name: Osmund Greave
CHR-0012.title: High Hall-Keeper
CHR-0012.looks: A gaunt priest of 64 with a long white beard, deep-set eyes and the iron ring of his office on a thong at his chest.
CHR-0012.manner: Stern and certain, he quotes oath-lays in a deep chanting voice and treats every disagreement as oath-breaking.
CHR-0012.wants: He wants the royal wedding on 21 June sworn on the iron ring, and Ashmere's village halls sworn to the Emperor.
CHR-0012.fears: He fears the 946 truce record at Wolfhaven, which could shake the Emperor's headship of the faith.

CHR-0013.name: Elswyth Tidewell
CHR-0013.looks: A tall, deep-chested woman of 48 with pale hair under a pearl-sewn veil and a seal-grey Greyhaven cloak over red wool.
CHR-0013.manner: Calm and gracious in public, she gives orders as gentle requests and forgets no slight.
CHR-0013.wants: She wants the Gordush kept quiet until Harald marries Rowena of Ashmere on Return Day, 21 June.
CHR-0013.fears: She fears Harrow will drag her only son into the river crossing on 2 May and that Harald will not come back.

CHR-0014.name: Harald Ironside
CHR-0014.title: Heir
CHR-0014.looks: A heavy-boned, square-jawed young man of 26, broad as a door, who weighs far more than he looks and wears Iron Guard mail.
CHR-0014.manner: Eager and open, he laughs easily, hungers for glory, and listens to Harrow's war talk more than to his mother.
CHR-0014.wants: He wants to ride beside Garrick Harrow across the Gordush on 2 May and win a name before his wedding.
CHR-0014.fears: He fears being kept home like a child while other men win the war that will one day be his.

CHR-0015.name: Aldwin Ironside
CHR-0015.title: Emperor, head of the Seven Halls
CHR-0015.looks: A heavy, iron-boned man of 55 with a grey-shot beard, a thick skull and the black iron ring of his oath on his thumb.
CHR-0015.manner: Slow, deliberate and loud, he leans in to hear because his ears are failing, and rarely unsays a thing once spoken.
CHR-0015.wants: He wants no crossing of the Gordush before his son weds Rowena on 21 June, then Tarn handed over or taken in July.
CHR-0015.fears: He fears the whispered prophecy that an Ironside will fall into the water and take the empire down with him.

CHR-0016.name: Corbin Ravenscar
CHR-0016.title: Master of the Night School of Northmoor
CHR-0016.looks: A lean, quiet man of 34 with pale, owl-wide Ravenscar eyes, a strip of dark gauze over them by day, and soft riding boots.
CHR-0016.manner: He speaks in a murmur, moves without noise, and seems half-asleep at noon and wide awake after dusk.
CHR-0016.wants: He wants Tarn's camp at Gashmar mapped by the dark of the moon before March, so Harrow does not cross blind.
CHR-0016.fears: He fears being caught in noon sun, half-blind with a migraine, on the day a fight comes to him.

CHR-0017.name: Ysolde Ravenscar
CHR-0017.looks: A slight, grey-haired widow of 58 with Ravenscar owl-eyes behind dark gauze, a black wimple and ink on her fingertips.
CHR-0017.manner: Soft-voiced and courteous, she asks small questions, remembers every answer, and writes down as little as she can.
CHR-0017.wants: She wants Halvard Stagg's cook in Ostra silenced before the spring Thing, and Sariel Thornwise's list of Eastern Edge tree stands bought.
CHR-0017.fears: She fears the cook talking at Northreach's spring Thing and restarting the war before the wedding.

CHR-0018.name: Wynn of Swanvale
CHR-0018.looks: A sturdy, round-faced young woman of 23 with flax-pale braids, a patched brown kirtle and a shawl full of goose-down.
CHR-0018.manner: Cheerful and chatty, she gossips with everyone on the Swanvale road and notices far more than she lets on.
CHR-0018.wants: She wants to marry at May Fair and get a farm of her own, away from the strangers who watch her neighbors.
CHR-0018.fears: She fears the quiet strangers who watch the old huntsmen's farm next door and ask her too many questions.

CHR-0019.name: Garr Whitlock
CHR-0019.looks: A wiry, weather-burnt man of 35 with a broken front tooth, salt-stiff hair and a sealskin coat worn green at the seams.
CHR-0019.manner: Friendly, quick and full of jokes, he tells every buyer exactly what that buyer wants to hear.
CHR-0019.wants: He wants to be paid twice this year for news of Tova Brand's tin deal, once in Coldhaven and once by Ravenscar.
CHR-0019.fears: He fears his Coldhaven buyer, or any Northreach jarl, learning that he also reports to Lady Ysolde Ravenscar.

CHR-0020.name: Hask of Copperham
CHR-0020.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0020.looks: A big half-orc of 34 with grey-green skin, short tusks, a shaved head and a lord's license token on a cord at his neck.
CHR-0020.manner: Steady and slow-spoken, he gives his men short, fair orders and looks any lord straight in the eye.
CHR-0020.wants: He wants his half-orc stake-men to fight well on the Gordush, so the march will treat them as free men.
CHR-0020.fears: He fears his sister Orla will burn Hartgate and make every half-orc in the southern march an outlaw, him…

CHR-0021.name: Isa Ravenscar
CHR-0021.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0021.looks: A lean, hard-faced woman of 28 with owl-wide Ravenscar eyes, dark gauze tied over them by day, and black riding leathers.
CHR-0021.manner: Cold, clipped and impatient, she gives an order once and rides off before anyone can argue.
CHR-0021.wants: She wants Orla of Hazelhollow caught before May Fair, before any fire touches the stakes and wagons at Hartgate.
CHR-0021.fears: She fears the truth about Fenny Ford coming out and shaming House Ravenscar and her Night Riders.

CHR-0022.name: Aldous Crane
CHR-0022.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0022.title: Iron Guard knight, the prince's shield
CHR-0022.looks: A tall, strong knight of 36 in Iron Guard mail, with an axe-scarred kite shield and a left knee that locks in cold.
CHR-0022.manner: Plain, loyal and slow to speak, he stands like a post beside the prince and answers most questions with yes or no.
CHR-0022.wants: He wants Prince Harald alive at his wedding, whether that means stopping him at the river or riding beside him.
CHR-0022.fears: He fears having to choose between the prince he guards and the Empress who asked him to keep Harald home.

CHR-0023.name: Ingrid Greymane
CHR-0023.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0023.looks: A tall, raw-boned woman of 32 with dark-blond hair cropped short, salt-chapped cheeks and a boarding axe at her belt.
CHR-0023.manner: Proud, blunt and sharp-tongued, she gives orders like her father and has little patience for merchants.
CHR-0023.wants: She wants the Cold Bay squadron's pennant kept for war, not lent to Tova Brand's guild cog to start one.
CHR-0023.fears: She fears being blamed if a merchant cog under a crown pennant gives Northreach its cause for war on Cold Bay.

CHR-0024.name: Fennick Oakes
CHR-0024.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0024.looks: A slim half-elf of 38 with pointed ears under a hood, hazel eyes, and a crown ranger's green cloak and horn.
CHR-0024.manner: Quiet and watchful, he speaks carefully to lords and with an easy grin to woodsmen.
CHR-0024.wants: He wants Dunstan Cole caught before the twelve oaks fall in March, without his own old bribe coming to light.
CHR-0024.fears: He fears Dunstan naming him as a bribed man, and Calithil Lightfoot's rangers waiting across the Oak Line.

CHR-0025.name: Orla of Hazelhollow
CHR-0025.looks: A strong half-orc woman of 30 with olive skin, small tusks, a burn scar across one hand and a farm-wife's brown hood.
CHR-0025.manner: Fierce and fast-talking, she argues with heat in her voice and has no patience at all for petitions.
CHR-0025.wants: She wants the stakes and wagons in the Hartgate depot burned before May Fair, so Harrow cannot build his war.
CHR-0025.fears: She fears Isa Ravenscar's Night Riders, who hunt her on moonless nights across the southern march.

CHR-0026.name: Oswin Gordale
CHR-0026.looks: A grey-templed half-orc of 40, heavy-shouldered and soft-bellied, with worn tusks and his best brown wool coat brushed clean.
CHR-0026.manner: Patient and courteous, he speaks slowly, choosing words no lord can call insolent.
CHR-0026.wants: He wants to carry the half-orcs' petition to Kingsmere by May Fair and win them the right to own land and bear arms.
CHR-0026.fears: He fears Orla's fire will burn his petition along with the depot and make every half-orc an outlaw.

CHR-0027.name: Dunstan Cole
CHR-0027.looks: A thick-armed woodsman of 42 with sawdust in a tangled brown beard, a split ear and an outlaw's patched leather jerkin.
CHR-0027.manner: Loud, cheerful and reckless, he talks big about money and laughs off every warning about the elves.
CHR-0027.wants: He wants twelve great oaks felled beyond the Foxhurst stones in March and sold to Greyhaven's Timber Guild.
CHR-0027.fears: He fears elven arrows from the trees, though he would never admit it in front of his cutters.

CHR-0028.name: Aldith Crowe
CHR-0028.looks: A small, hollow-cheeked woman of 46 with grey braids, a plain undyed wool robe and fish-scale stains on her sleeves.
CHR-0028.manner: Gentle in voice but fierce in her words, she preaches the Free Halls' right to choose their own priests.
CHR-0028.wants: She wants the Free Halls kept free of the Emperor's priests, and Ashmere's village halls to join them if he claims them.
CHR-0028.fears: She fears Osmund Greave's men finding her and drowning her in the Fairrush as an oath-breaker.

CHR-0029.name: Merewyn Ashcombe
CHR-0029.looks: A short, ink-stained woman of 41 with mouse-brown hair under a scribe's cap and squinting eyes from years of reading by candle.
CHR-0029.manner: Precise and nervous, she speaks in careful legal phrases and jumps when a door opens behind her.
CHR-0029.wants: She wants enough of Lady Audra's silver to buy a house of her own before anyone counts the copies she has made.
CHR-0029.fears: She fears the High Hall-Keeper learning that she copies the old Oath Hall rolls for the Old Plains Lords.

CHR-0030.name: Tilda Burrow
CHR-0030.looks: A small, quick half-orc woman of 26 with olive skin, tusks filed short, a shawl pulled low and a peddler's pack of pins and ribbon.
CHR-0030.manner: Sweet-voiced and eager to please, she agrees with whoever is talking and watches their hands while they do.
CHR-0030.wants: She wants Ravenscar silver and a lord's license to own land, paid for with the names she brings Isa's riders.
CHR-0030.fears: She fears the half-orcs of the march learning that she sells names to the Night Riders.

CHR-0031.name: Cuthbert Lowe
CHR-0031.looks: A plump, pleasant-faced man of 43 with thinning sandy hair, a wool merchant's good blue coat and a purse that never looks heavy.
CHR-0031.manner: Jovial and generous, he buys the drinks, laughs at every joke and gently steers the talk toward votes.
CHR-0031.wants: He wants the March Vote at Highcastle to say yes, so 4,000 highland crossbowmen reach the Gordush by May Fair.
CHR-0031.fears: He fears Hall-Keeper Aelfric exposing the money he paid Speaker Tomas Redford.

CHR-0032.name: Owain Cinderwell
CHR-0032.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0032.title: Captain of the King's Guard
CHR-0032.looks: A broad, solid man of 44, slow to turn, with a heavy iron-rimmed shield strapped to a scarred left forearm and red-rimmed eyes.
CHR-0032.manner: Silent and grave, he stands in doorways as if rooted there and speaks only when his king or princess asks.
CHR-0032.wants: He wants to be free of the hidden clause before the wedding, without breaking his oath of silence to King Edric.
CHR-0032.fears: He fears that Rowena will learn the clause from someone else and know he kept it from her.

CHR-0033.name: Hugh Fletcher
CHR-0033.title: Master of the King's Bowmen and the King's Butts
CHR-0033.looks: A tall man of 52 with a bowman's twisted back, a huge right shoulder, a knife scar on one thigh and a padded jack.
CHR-0033.manner: He talks in a great carrying bark, short and practical, and calls range and wind the way other men say good morning.
CHR-0033.wants: He wants the King's Bowmen's rolls counted true before the Spring Equinox Moot, and yew enough to keep 22,400 bows drawn.
CHR-0033.fears: He fears the day his voice fails on a hillside and the volley falls short, since it no longer reaches all…

CHR-0034.name: Isolde Varley
CHR-0034.looks: A handsome, heavy-lidded woman of 46 with chestnut hair under a fine linen veil and Varenna silk at her cuffs.
CHR-0034.manner: Warm, witty and persuasive, she flatters freely and writes long letters to half the merchants on the Palella.
CHR-0034.wants: She wants the Aldmark match delayed or broken, and peace and trade with Varenna kept on the Palella.
CHR-0034.fears: She fears Ashmere becoming an Aldmark province and her bargemen being cut off from Varenna's markets.

CHR-0035.name: Piers Copperhand
CHR-0035.title: Master
CHR-0035.looks: A squat, bald man of 53 with copper-green stains on his fingers, a thick neck and a fur-trimmed guild gown.
CHR-0035.manner: Gruff and plain, he talks about weights and debts and trusts no promise that is not written down and sealed.
CHR-0035.wants: He wants Lord Ranulf to repay the loan made against the Hawkmarch tolls, or hand him the tolls instead.
CHR-0035.fears: He fears a war with Varenna closing the Hawkmarch pass and making his loan worthless.

CHR-0036.name: Tamsin Yewhurst
CHR-0036.title: Master
CHR-0036.looks: A wiry woman of 47 with strong, nicked bowyer's hands, grey-flecked hair tied back and a leather apron full of shavings.
CHR-0036.manner: Short-spoken and critical, she flexes every stave she sees and judges people in much the same way.
CHR-0036.wants: She wants enough yew for Ashmere's bows once the wedding sends 1,000 elven staves a year to Aldmark.
CHR-0036.fears: She fears the elves cutting off the yew and leaving Ashmere's longbowmen with bows that crack in the cold.

CHR-0037.name: Edmund Hale
CHR-0037.title: Chancellor
CHR-0037.looks: A tall, thin man of 60 with a clean-shaven, deeply lined face, dark eyes and the Chancellor's seal on a chain at his chest.
CHR-0037.manner: Smooth, patient and reasonable, he never raises his voice and always seems to be doing the king a favor.
CHR-0037.wants: He wants Rowena married to Harald on 21 June, and the runaway spinner Sabina of Camia brought to Ashmere first.
CHR-0037.fears: He fears King Edric waking from his black mood long enough to present a new testament at the Spring Equinox…

CHR-0038.name: Ranulf Hawkmarch
CHR-0038.looks: A lean, hawk-nosed man of 55 with iron-grey hair, a scarred chin and a riding cloak in faded house colors.
CHR-0038.manner: Proud and touchy, he speaks of his loyalty loudly and often, and takes offense at the smallest slight.
CHR-0038.wants: He wants no Aldmark escort or garrison in Harrowbrook, and the wedding delayed or broken.
CHR-0038.fears: He fears his debt to Piers Copperhand, which could cost him the Hawkmarch tolls and his house's pride.

CHR-0039.name: Tobias Cinderwell
CHR-0039.title: Head of House Cinderwell, master of the Shield Yard
CHR-0039.looks: A broad, stiff-backed man of 68 with milky blind eyes, a square-cut white beard and huge hands still callused from the shield.
CHR-0039.manner: Deep-voiced and slow, he listens hard, knows men by their footsteps, and gives his verdicts like a judge.
CHR-0039.wants: He wants Owain to come through the wedding year with both his oath and his honor whole.
CHR-0039.fears: He fears that his son has not slept since March 1104, and that a tired man is a door that opens.

CHR-0040.name: Gudrun Ashdown
CHR-0040.title: Hall-Keeper
CHR-0040.looks: A tall, raw-boned woman of 54 with iron-grey braids, a weather-beaten face and a plain brown hall-keeper's robe.
CHR-0040.manner: Plain-spoken and stubborn, she talks like a village wife and argues like a lawyer when the halls are threatened.
CHR-0040.wants: She wants Ashmere's village halls kept free of any emperor's priests, whatever the crown marries.
CHR-0040.fears: She fears the wedding oath on the iron ring will make the Emperor head of every hall in Ashmere.

CHR-0041.name: Silvan Aurel
CHR-0041.title: Luminary
CHR-0041.looks: A plump, soft-handed priest of 65 with a shaved head, white brows and a gold twelve-rayed sun on his white robe.
CHR-0041.manner: Courtly and mild, he slips into Old Solen when he wants to sound wise and smiles when he disagrees.
CHR-0041.wants: He wants the royal wedding of 21 June blessed by the Sun rite rather than sworn on the iron ring.
CHR-0041.fears: He fears the Temple losing Ashmere's court to the Seven Halls if the iron ring wins the wedding.

CHR-0042.name: Rowena Ashford
CHR-0042.title: Heir; commands the King's Bowmen in her father's name
CHR-0042.looks: A tall, sharp-eyed woman of 33 with dark hair in a soldier's braid, bowman's calluses on her fingers and a plain grey riding gown.
CHR-0042.manner: Quick, restless and direct, she sleeps four hours a night and wears out every courtier who tries to keep up.
CHR-0042.wants: She wants to read her marriage contract in full at the Spring Equinox Moot on 20 March before she weds Harald.
CHR-0042.fears: She fears the Ashford black moods that have swallowed her father, and the bold fits that make Ashford rulers…

CHR-0043.name: Edric Ashford
CHR-0043.title: King
CHR-0043.looks: A gaunt, stooped king of 71 with a ragged white beard, sunken eyes dulled by poppy and a crown he rarely wears now.
CHR-0043.manner: He has barely spoken since autumn, and when he does it is slow and slurred, with flashes of his old sharpness.
CHR-0043.wants: He wants to present a new testament at the Spring Equinox Moot and undo what he signed in his bold fit.
CHR-0043.fears: He fears that his clause has sold his kingdom, and his daughter's birthright, to the Emperor of Aldmark.

CHR-0044.name: Perrin Hollowell
CHR-0044.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0044.title: Vintenar of the King's Bowmen, winner of the Return Day silver arrow
CHR-0044.looks: A lanky young man of 25 with a sunburnt, freckled face, a heavy right shoulder and a silver arrow pinned to his hood.
CHR-0044.manner: Cocky and good-humored, he grins through every contest and goes quiet only when he draws.
CHR-0044.wants: He wants to keep the Return Day silver arrow and one day follow Hugh Fletcher as master of the King's Butts.
CHR-0044.fears: He fears his twenty bowmen being marched to the Stagley walls in a war nobody has explained to him.

CHR-0045.name: Bryony Cinderwell
CHR-0045.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0045.title: Shield Guard officer, Kingsdale
CHR-0045.looks: A square-built woman of 29 with stiff Cinderwell shoulders, cropped fair hair and a shield-rim bruise that never quite fades.
CHR-0045.manner: Blunt, sharp-tongued and quick to judge, she stands at Rowena's door like a wall and lets no one forget it.
CHR-0045.wants: She wants Rowena kept safe through the Moot and the wedding, and to learn what her brother is hiding.
CHR-0045.fears: She fears that whatever keeps Owain awake will one day come through the door she guards.

CHR-0046.name: Godwin Ashdown
CHR-0046.title: Lord Warden of the Stag Downs, captain of Stagley
CHR-0046.looks: A weathered, thick-set man of 49 with a cropped brown beard, a bent nose and a Downs Rider's sheepskin over his mail.
CHR-0046.manner: Steady and friendly, he talks walls and wells with masons and remembers every soldier's name.
CHR-0046.wants: He wants Stagley held with 3,000 garrison, 3,500 bowmen and 1,000 Downs Riders against any stroke from Varenna.
CHR-0046.fears: He fears that his sister Gudrun's quarrel with the Emperor's priests will split Ashmere just as Varenna…

CHR-0047.name: Anwen Rushlight
CHR-0047.looks: A neat, small woman of 42 with greying hair under a white linen coif, herb-scented chapped hands and a satchel of jars.
CHR-0047.manner: Soft, kind and professional, she talks about the king's sleep and bowels as calmly as the weather.
CHR-0047.wants: She wants to keep King Edric calm and alive until the wedding, as the Chancellor has asked.
CHR-0047.fears: She fears Princess Rowena finding the poppy in her father's cup and calling it poison.

CHR-0048.name: Faelan Greyholt
CHR-0048.looks: A slim half-elf of 34 with long dark hair over pointed ears, grey eyes and a yew-buyer's worn green coat.
CHR-0048.manner: Easy and charming, he speaks elven and human trade-talk equally well and seems to have friends at every inn.
CHR-0048.wants: He wants to learn how many elven staves really cross the border, and who carts them, for Chancellor Hale.
CHR-0048.fears: He fears the elves learning that he watches their yew trade for a human Chancellor.

CHR-0049.name: Nessa Dunmore
CHR-0049.looks: A strong, sun-browned woman of 24 with a bargewoman's thick arms, a brown braid under a kerchief and inky fingertips.
CHR-0049.manner: Cheerful and dull-seeming on purpose, she hums river songs and lets people think she cannot read.
CHR-0049.wants: She wants enough of the Chancellor's silver to buy her own barge on the Palella before the wedding.
CHR-0049.fears: She fears Lady Varley finding the copies and having her quietly put over the side of a barge.

CHR-0050.name: Ada Stonefoot
CHR-0050.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0050.title: Master of the Ridge School; captain of the Cliff Runners
CHR-0050.looks: A light, wiry woman of 29 with wind-reddened cheeks, short brown hair and soft cliff-runner's boots.
CHR-0050.manner: Quick and teasing, she runs ridges for fun and turns pale and short-tempered at any talk of boats.
CHR-0050.wants: She wants the clefts where about 15 Snow Drakes nest kept hidden from Varennan egg-buyers and Liss Cairnhold's maps.
CHR-0050.fears: She fears that if the drakes are found, hunters will pour into the League and her mother will lose her seat.

CHR-0051.name: Ulric Greycloak
CHR-0051.title: Captain-General
CHR-0051.looks: A short, wiry man of 49 with a weathered face, eyes that squint at anything close and a grey felt cloak over a padded coat.
CHR-0051.manner: Dry and businesslike, he talks of men as contracts and bolts as wages, and counts his drill aloud.
CHR-0051.wants: He wants the Council of Valleys to send 4,000 crossbowmen to Aldmark's Gordush line by May Fair, at double the usual rate.
CHR-0051.fears: He fears the vote failing after he has already taken 20,000 highland silver from Aldmark in advance.

CHR-0052.name: Borin Flintaxe
CHR-0052.title: Master
CHR-0052.looks: A broad, grizzled dwarf of 163 with a white-streaked braided beard, a miner's stoop and a metal guild clasp at his collar.
CHR-0052.manner: Gruff and exact, he speaks only in terms of contract and repeats every promise back word for word.
CHR-0052.wants: He wants his dwarf crews paid in full for the League's deep silver, whoever wins the March vote at Highcastle.
CHR-0052.fears: He fears the Silver Chest cannot pay, because more silver has gone out of it than the Council knows.

CHR-0053.name: Ivo Stringer
CHR-0053.title: Master
CHR-0053.looks: A stocky man of 51 with a bald head, glue-burn scars on both forearms and a crossbow-maker's leather apron.
CHR-0053.manner: Cheerful and boastful, he talks about draw-weights the way other men talk about their children.
CHR-0053.wants: He wants the March vote to pass, so 4,000 crossbowmen bound for the Gordush need new Roseham crossbows and bolts.
CHR-0053.fears: He fears a no vote that leaves his shops full of 150 kg crossbows and nobody paying for them.

CHR-0054.name: Gerda Silvervein
CHR-0054.title: Mine-Warden
CHR-0054.looks: A stout, silver-haired woman of 55 with heavy keys at her belt, a grey felt cloak and the pale skin of an indoor worker.
CHR-0054.manner: Careful and pleasant, she answers questions about money with numbers that sound exact and are not.
CHR-0054.wants: She wants the Aldmark contract voted down, so that Northreach keeps repaying the loan she made it.
CHR-0054.fears: She fears that a yes vote will make Northreach stop paying, and the empty Silver Chest will expose her.

CHR-0055.name: Tomas Redford
CHR-0055.title: Speaker
CHR-0055.looks: A handsome, well-fed man of 40 with a trimmed red-brown beard, a foreign silk tunic under his grey felt cloak and many rings.
CHR-0055.manner: Charming and loud, he speaks for the common herder in public and counts votes in private.
CHR-0055.wants: He wants Helga Stonefoot unseated, the First Speakership back, and the high valleys opened to hunters and buyers.
CHR-0055.fears: He fears the Council learning that his vote on the Aldmark contract was bought.

CHR-0056.name: Aelfric of Amberhurst
CHR-0056.title: Hall-Keeper
CHR-0056.looks: A tall, white-bearded man of 61 with a hooked nose, bright angry eyes and a plain grey felt hall-keeper's cloak.
CHR-0056.manner: Fiery and eloquent, he preaches against Aldmark like a man at a funeral and never tires of the subject.
CHR-0056.wants: He wants the Council to refuse Aldmark's crossbow contract until the Emperor swears never to claim the Free Halls.
CHR-0056.fears: He fears Aldmark's silver buying the Council and the Free Hall valleys being sworn to the Emperor one by one.

CHR-0057.name: Helga Stonefoot
CHR-0057.title: First Speaker
CHR-0057.looks: A lean, upright woman of 53 with weathered cheeks, grey hair in a crown of braids and the light, sure feet of the Stonefoots.
CHR-0057.manner: Calm and patient, she hears every valley's speaker in turn and always speaks last.
CHR-0057.wants: She wants her middle course passed at the March vote: 2,000 crossbowmen for Crossmarch's walls only, not 4,000.
CHR-0057.fears: She fears losing her seat to Redford if the Snow Drake valleys are found and the Stonefoots' word is doubted.

CHR-0058.name: Col Eyrie
CHR-0058.looks: A lean, dark man of 45 with old Crown Eagle claw scars across his scalp and shoulder, nailed boots and a coil of rope.
CHR-0058.manner: Restless and bitter, he jokes about owing his life to Helga and spits after he says it.
CHR-0058.wants: He wants to find the Stonefoots' closed valleys and sell a Snow Drake egg to Orso Fenn at Roseham.
CHR-0058.fears: He fears Ada Stonefoot's cliff runners, and the look on Helga's face if she learns who is hunting her valleys.

CHR-0059.name: Liss Cairnhold
CHR-0059.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0059.looks: A wiry, sun-browned woman of 36 with cropped hair, lips chapped by high passes and a leather map-case slung across her back.
CHR-0059.manner: Curious and talkative, she asks every traveler about roads and writes down whatever they say.
CHR-0059.wants: She wants to sell her Worldspine charts to Chuma the Dragonspear at Highcastle in May for a fortune.
CHR-0059.fears: She fears losing charts that took her years, or being blamed if the valleys she maps are found.

CHR-0060.name: Kettil Frost
CHR-0060.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0060.title: Hirdmaster
CHR-0060.looks: A thick-necked, grey, salt-burned man of 47 with a three-fingered left hand and a linden shield strapped to his forearm.
CHR-0060.manner: Short-spoken and steady, he talks like a man counting steps and keeps his shoulder close to whoever stands beside him.
CHR-0060.wants: He wants the cook in Ostra never to reach the spring Thing, where he could name the guard who waved the taster away.
CHR-0060.fears: He fears that he is slowing, and has quietly moved himself to the second rank in drill.

CHR-0061.name: Svala Snowstride
CHR-0061.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0061.title: Master of the Ski Yard of Saltbridge
CHR-0061.looks: A lean woman of 34 with wind-cut cheeks, pale plaited hair under a fur hat and one finger short by a frozen joint.
CHR-0061.manner: Quiet and watchful, she studies ice, faces and weather the same way and talks about none of them.
CHR-0061.wants: She wants her Ice Walkers patrolling the stones of Wolfhaven while the ice still holds this winter.
CHR-0061.fears: She fears reading the ice wrong again, as in 1092, when 60 raiders drowned through a crack she had called…

CHR-0062.name: Leif Saltar
CHR-0062.title: Master
CHR-0062.looks: A ruddy, barrel-chested man of 45 with a salt-bleached beard, sealskin boots and three silver arm-rings on his right arm.
CHR-0062.manner: Hearty and generous, he trades jokes with fishwives and jarls alike and never quite answers a question.
CHR-0062.wants: He wants tin running quietly to Kingsmere, whoever wins the quarrel between Tova Brand and the Tin Reeves.
CHR-0062.fears: He fears the Tin Reeves or King Eirik learning that his ships already carry Frostholm tin south.

CHR-0063.name: Oddny Tinmark
CHR-0063.title: Reeve
CHR-0063.looks: A neat, sharp-nosed woman of 38 with dark hair under a fur hat, silver arm-rings of office and a brass balance in a leather case.
CHR-0063.manner: Brisk and precise, she speaks in weights and tolls and smiles only when the scale settles.
CHR-0063.wants: She wants Tova Brand's rye-for-tin offer killed, so every bar of Frostholm tin still passes through her Tin Reeves.
CHR-0063.fears: She fears Colm Ashby's tallies, which prove her balance has cheated the giants for years.

CHR-0064.name: Asta Coldwater
CHR-0064.title: Jarl
CHR-0064.looks: A tall, handsome woman of 46 with amber beads in her fair braids, a sealskin cloak and heavy silver arm-rings on both wrists.
CHR-0064.manner: Shrewd and smiling, she speaks warmly of peace and trade and always seems to know the price of everything.
CHR-0064.wants: She wants Coldhaven kept out of any war with Aldmark, so that tin and amber keep flowing to Kingsmere.
CHR-0064.fears: She fears the cook in Ostra talking and forcing Northreach into a war she has promised to stay out of.

CHR-0065.name: Halvard Stagg
CHR-0065.title: Jarl
CHR-0065.looks: A big, red-bearded man of 52 with a scar through one eyebrow, a wolf-fur hat and a dozen silver arm-rings.
CHR-0065.manner: Hot-tempered and loud, he swears by the Sea King and speaks of King Bjorn's death as if it happened yesterday.
CHR-0065.wants: He wants the Kingsmere-born cook brought alive from Ostra to the spring Thing to name King Bjorn's poisoner.
CHR-0065.fears: He fears King Eirik would rather keep peace with Aldmark than avenge his own father.

CHR-0066.name: Ragna of the Stones
CHR-0066.title: Hall-Keeper
CHR-0066.looks: A bent, white-haired woman of 63 with a weathered face, sharp pale eyes and a staff of whale bone.
CHR-0066.manner: Slow, stern and dry, she quotes the old law from memory and makes kings wait for her answer.
CHR-0066.wants: She wants Jarl Sigurd Greymane to see the 946 record, and Aldmark to remember the Free Halls can strike back.
CHR-0066.fears: She fears Osmund Greave's men stealing or burning the record before it can be shown.

CHR-0067.name: Bjorn Winterborn
CHR-0067.title: Heir
CHR-0067.looks: A gangly, fair-haired boy of 16, growing fast, who wears thick mittens on the ice where his father goes bare-handed.
CHR-0067.manner: Eager and earnest, he tries to stand like the hird men and blushes when they notice.
CHR-0067.wants: He wants to earn a place in the front rank of the King's Hird under Kettil Frost before he is grown.
CHR-0067.fears: He fears the jarls learning that the cold bites him like any common boy.

CHR-0068.name: Eirik III Winterborn
CHR-0068.title: King
CHR-0068.looks: A broad, pale-eyed king of 44 with a cropped fair beard, bare hands even in hard frost and a white wolf-fur cloak.
CHR-0068.manner: Cool and watchful, he speaks little, lets the jarls argue, and then decides alone.
CHR-0068.wants: He wants the Aldmark crossbow contract voted down at Highcastle, and the 946 record kept as a weapon rather than spent on a grudge.
CHR-0068.fears: He fears Halvard's cook forcing him into a war with Aldmark that Northreach cannot win alone.

CHR-0069.name: Einar Greyhand
CHR-0069.title: Lawspeaker
CHR-0069.looks: A thin, stooped man of 66 with a long grey beard, an old frost-greyed left hand and a staff of carved ash.
CHR-0069.manner: Measured and patient, he recites the law in long chanted lines and corrects anyone who quotes it wrongly.
CHR-0069.wants: He wants the law recited true at the spring Thing, whatever the jarls shout about poison.
CHR-0069.fears: He fears the law dying with him, since few young men now have the patience to learn it by heart.

CHR-0070.name: Ivar Longmemory
CHR-0070.looks: A thin, pale young man of 24 with ink-stained fingers, a scholar's stoop and a satchel of parchment leaves under his cloak.
CHR-0070.manner: Earnest and quick, he talks fast about law and writing, and goes red when anyone mentions money.
CHR-0070.wants: He wants the whole law of Northreach written on parchment, so that it can never be forgotten.
CHR-0070.fears: He fears the king learning that some of his law leaves have gone to a buyer in Aldmark.

CHR-0071.name: Colm Ashby
CHR-0071.title: Tin-Reeve
CHR-0071.looks: A short, broad miner of 49 with tin dust in the lines of his face, a crooked back and hands like old roots.
CHR-0071.manner: Plain and stubborn, he speaks for the miners in a slow, careful voice that bends for neither giants nor reeves.
CHR-0071.wants: He wants the tribute-folk free to leave the island and to keep a share of the tin they dig.
CHR-0071.fears: He fears another pit collapse like the one at Torvik in 1071 that killed eleven miners, two of them his…

CHR-0072.name: Thrand the Broad
CHR-0072.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0072.looks: A huge giant of 54, nearly 4 m tall and broad even for his kind, with a braided brown beard and a walrus-hide coat.
CHR-0072.manner: Patient and slow-spoken, he teaches by moving his pupils' feet with his own hands and seldom raises his voice.
CHR-0072.wants: He wants every hall pair drilled to turn together before the Thing of 1106, in case the quarrel turns to fighting.
CHR-0072.fears: Since his wife and pair-partner Gerd died of fever in 1099 he fights alone, and he fears the Thing will see…

CHR-0073.name: Bergthor of Haugberg
CHR-0073.title: Eldest
CHR-0073.looks: A massive old giant of 72, about 4 m tall, with a grey beard to his belt, stiff knees and huge seal-fur robes.
CHR-0073.manner: Proud and booming, he speaks of the big halls' honor and mocks the small Skarfells in every second sentence.
CHR-0073.wants: He wants to beat Skarvi the Younger at the Thing of 1106 and sell tin direct to Kingsmere for more grain.
CHR-0073.fears: He fears the small Skarfell line keeping the chieftainship and leaving the big halls to beg humans for grain.

CHR-0074.name: Hroa of Torvik
CHR-0074.title: Eldest
CHR-0074.looks: An enormous, white-haired giant of 119, nearly 4 m tall, with a right knee crushed stiff by a walrus and a stone-headed maul.
CHR-0074.manner: Dry, old and careful, she speaks slowly, rarely moves, and makes everyone come to her.
CHR-0074.wants: She wants the Truce of Dobin kept and her hall fed, so the Drevnan harpoon head must stay hidden.
CHR-0074.fears: She fears Solvei carrying the harpoon head to the Hrimfell Thing at Midsummer and restarting the Hrimfell…

CHR-0075.name: Skarvi the Younger
CHR-0075.title: Chieftain
CHR-0075.looks: A small giant of 63, barely 3 m tall and quick on his feet for his kind, bundled in heavy furs against the cold.
CHR-0075.manner: Friendly and practical, he speaks plainly to humans and teases the big halls before they can mock him.
CHR-0075.wants: He wants more grain and ale for the halls, which is why he let a Kingsmere cog load tin at Ragvik in 1104.
CHR-0075.fears: He fears Bergthor of Haugberg taking the chieftainship from the Skarfell line at the Thing of 1106.

CHR-0076.name: Sva the Long-Voiced
CHR-0076.title: Lore-Chanter
CHR-0076.looks: A tall, thin old giant of 85 with long white braids, a deep chest and a necklace of carved bone beads.
CHR-0076.manner: She speaks slowly in a deep, ringing voice, and even in plain talk she seems to be chanting.
CHR-0076.wants: She wants a match between Eyja of Torfell and Hauk of Helstad, tying Hrimfell's young giants to Frostholm.
CHR-0076.fears: She fears the giants dying out for want of brides, as each Thing counts fewer young giants than the last.

CHR-0077.name: Yrsa Blackpenny
CHR-0077.looks: A small, sharp-faced woman of 28 with black hair cut short, a tarred sealskin coat and a blackened penny on a thong at her neck.
CHR-0077.manner: Cocky and quick-tongued, she haggles hard, laughs at danger and never sails the same route twice.
CHR-0077.wants: She wants to run as much Frostholm tin to Kingsmere as she can before the Tin Reeves close the gaps.
CHR-0077.fears: She fears Northreach's ebb-ships catching her boat in open water with tin in the hold.

CHR-0078.name: Vermund Farcast
CHR-0078.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0078.looks: A tall, long-armed giant of 49 with a huge right shoulder, a shaved head and a 50 kg throwing stone he carries like a loaf.
CHR-0078.manner: Boastful and easy-going, he loves the crowd at the Stone Ring and sulks when he is not the center of it.
CHR-0078.wants: He wants a hall of his own and a Haugberg bride, which Bergthor has promised him for his arm at the Thing of 1106.
CHR-0078.fears: He fears Hroa learning that her best pupil has sold his arm to her rival.

CHR-0079.name: Solvei of Torvik
CHR-0079.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0079.looks: A strong, weathered giant of 46, nearly 4 m tall, with salt-cracked hands, a walrus-hide coat and a harpoon over her shoulder.
CHR-0079.manner: Honest and stubborn, she says plainly what she saw, even when her elders order silence.
CHR-0079.wants: She wants the Hrimfell giants told of the dead Frost Leviathan with Drevnan iron in its back before the Thing of Midsummer.
CHR-0079.fears: She fears that silence will let Drevnan whalers keep killing leviathans until the giants find out the hard…

CHR-0080.name: Hauk of Helstad
CHR-0080.looks: A young giant of 29, about 3.5 m tall, with a shaggy brown beard, a cheerful broad face and a scarf knitted by a tribute-woman.
CHR-0080.manner: Warm, curious and restless, he talks with humans as equals and asks questions his elders find rude.
CHR-0080.wants: He wants the tribute-folk free to leave the island and keep a share of the tin, and he says so at the Miners' Moot.
CHR-0080.fears: He fears being matched to a Hrimfell bride and sent across the sea, away from the miners he has sworn to help.

CHR-0081.name: Groa of Haugberg
CHR-0081.looks: A smallish giant woman of 38, about 3.4 m tall, with her dead mother's narrow face, quick hands and a hooded seal-fur cloak.
CHR-0081.manner: Soft-spoken and attentive, she pours her father's ale and listens to every word, saying little herself.
CHR-0081.wants: She wants her father to lose at the Thing of 1106, and she still blames him for her mother's death in childbirth in 1080.
CHR-0081.fears: She fears her father learning that she sells his every word to Northreach's Tin-Reeve.

CHR-0082.name: Harrek Stonejaw
CHR-0082.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0082.title: Gate-Warden
CHR-0082.looks: A square, heavy dwarf of 134 with a jaw set crooked since 1041, a stiff right arm and a tall gate shield.
CHR-0082.manner: Stubborn and plain, he speaks bluntly, listens more than he looks, and admits his own failings aloud.
CHR-0082.wants: He wants the Iron Road forts kept in dwarven hands and Queen Brynja's promise to Aldmark undone before 1 March.
CHR-0082.fears: He fears Law-Carver Orsa's questions reaching his secret, which would cost him the gate and his name.

CHR-0083.name: Vigdis Coalbrow
CHR-0083.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0083.title: Sapper-Master
CHR-0083.looks: A stocky dwarf woman of 103 with thick black brows, a soot-dark face and boots that are always wet from the tunnels.
CHR-0083.manner: Cold and practical, she talks about water as a weapon and about humans as a leak to be stopped.
CHR-0083.wants: She wants every human prospector driven out of Irondeep's hills before Aldmark soldiers arrive on the Iron Road.
CHR-0083.fears: She fears the Aldmark garrison of 1 March putting human soldiers within reach of her tunnels.

CHR-0084.name: Ulla Stonecount
CHR-0084.title: Trade-Warden
CHR-0084.looks: A neat, grey-braided dwarf of 114 with a heavy ledger chained to her belt and fine mail under a plain wool coat.
CHR-0084.manner: Polite, exact and cool, she quotes debts to the last hold-mark and never forgets a late payment.
CHR-0084.wants: She wants Irondeep selling to Northreach and Greyhaven too, so that Aldmark is only one buyer among several.
CHR-0084.fears: She fears Aldmark asking for more iron on credit for the Gordush while it still owes 24,000 hold-marks.

CHR-0085.name: Hella Brightanvil
CHR-0085.title: Forge-Master
CHR-0085.looks: A broad, grey-braided dwarf of 156 with forge-burn scars up both arms, a thick leather apron and a smith's heavy shoulders.
CHR-0085.manner: Proud and gruff, she speaks of steel the way priests speak of gods and suffers no fool near her forge.
CHR-0085.wants: She wants her grandson's leak kept buried until the Law-Carvers' questions turn to something else.
CHR-0085.fears: She fears the Judgment of the First Hall falling on Irondeep if Eyvind's trip-hammer at Saltbridge is proved.

CHR-0086.name: Dain Coalbrow
CHR-0086.title: Mine-Master
CHR-0086.looks: A thick-set, coal-blackened dwarf of 144 with a grey beard tucked into his belt and a miner's lamp hooked to his shoulder.
CHR-0086.manner: Hearty and reassuring, he laughs off bad news and tells the Council that everything is in hand.
CHR-0086.wants: He wants the flooded lower coal seam at Dunheim pumped out quietly before anyone counts the lost coal.
CHR-0086.fears: He fears the Council learning the flood will take two years to clear and his clan losing its standing.

CHR-0087.name: Orsa Flintmark
CHR-0087.title: Law-Carver
CHR-0087.looks: A tiny, ancient dwarf of 199 with a deeply lined face, cloudy eyes and a carving chisel on a chain at her belt.
CHR-0087.manner: Slow, dry and merciless, she asks one exact question at a time and writes the answers in stone.
CHR-0087.wants: She wants Irondeep to sell less, close its gates in winter and keep humans out of the valleys.
CHR-0087.fears: She fears Queen Brynja's deals with Aldmark ending with human soldiers inside the Deep Halls.

CHR-0088.name: Korrin Deepeye
CHR-0088.title: Thane
CHR-0088.looks: A broad, pale dwarf of 122 with large dark Deepeye eyes, a hooded veil worn outdoors and a black beard bound in iron rings.
CHR-0088.manner: Cold and intense, he speaks quietly, listens for weakness, and never forgives his mother's softness toward Aldmark.
CHR-0088.wants: He wants the Law-Carvers to declare his mother unfit at the Founding on 3 March and the Iron Road gate shut to Aldmark.
CHR-0088.fears: He fears that 400 Aldmark soldiers at the lower Iron Road fort will be the first step toward an Aldmark…

CHR-0089.name: Brynja Deepeye
CHR-0089.title: Queen
CHR-0089.looks: An old, heavy-set dwarf queen of 184 with large dark Deepeye eyes, white braids bound in iron and a hooded veil for outdoors.
CHR-0089.manner: Slow, shrewd and patient, she speaks softly and lets her ministers argue themselves out before she rules.
CHR-0089.wants: She wants 6,000 bushels of Aldmark grain for the hold, bought by letting 400 Aldmark soldiers hold the lower Iron Road fort from 1 March.
CHR-0089.fears: She fears Eldest Carver Thora Grimstone's long memory of Irondeep's old arms sales to the Wind Empire…

CHR-0091.name: Torsten Grimhelm
CHR-0091.title: Captain of the Iron Road guard
CHR-0091.looks: A hard-faced dwarf of 94 in his prime, with a short red beard, a dented steel cap and a heavy crossbow always within reach.
CHR-0091.manner: Stiff and loyal, he answers to Korrin's word only and repeats orders back exactly as given.
CHR-0091.wants: He wants Korrin's word before he hands the lower Iron Road fort to any Aldmark captain on 1 March.
CHR-0091.fears: He fears the Law-Carvers learning that he sold dwarven bolts to Northreach's hird in 1091.

CHR-0092.name: Eyvind Coldforge
CHR-0092.looks: A broad, restless dwarf of 54, young for his people, with a short brown beard, burn-pocked hands and a wool cap.
CHR-0092.manner: Eager, clever and careless, he talks about wheels and water like a lover and forgets who might be listening.
CHR-0092.wants: He wants to see the trip-hammer at Saltbridge working at full speed, whatever the old law says.
CHR-0092.fears: He fears Law-Carver Orsa proving the leak and the Judgment of the First Hall falling on his grandmother and…

CHR-0093.name: Thyra Wheelwright
CHR-0093.looks: A wiry dwarf woman of 74 with wet sleeves rolled to the elbow, a leather cap and fingers worn rough by pump chains.
CHR-0093.manner: Honest and impatient, she talks in water levels and pump strokes and hates being told to lie.
CHR-0093.wants: She wants more pumps, more hands and an honest count of the Dunheim flood laid before the Council.
CHR-0093.fears: She fears that if the flood is hidden too long, the lower galleries will collapse with miners inside.

CHR-0094.name: Ness Tidewell
CHR-0094.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0094.title: Diver-Master
CHR-0094.looks: A deep-chested woman of 34 with cropped salt-stiff hair, a boathook scar across her scalp and a silver diver's ring on a cord.
CHR-0094.manner: Loud because she is half deaf, she speaks bluntly, laughs easily and watches lips more than faces.
CHR-0094.wants: She wants to walk the channel floor off Smokewell this year and prove there is no dragon beneath it.
CHR-0094.fears: She fears the truth of Tristan's ring dive coming out, which could cost her cousin the crown.

CHR-0095.name: Rolf Brightwater
CHR-0095.title: Admiral
CHR-0095.looks: A thick, weathered man of 53 with a shipwright's heavy forearms, a burn-shiny left hand and a sealskin coat instead of mail.
CHR-0095.manner: Gruff and confident, he speaks in orders, slow on land but sharp as a whip on a deck.
CHR-0095.wants: He wants Velgrad's fire rafts to sail in July, so he can burn the Sevany squadron and take all the channel tolls.
CHR-0095.fears: He fears the rafts coming on a night when his crews are ashore, so that his trap closes on him instead.

CHR-0096.name: Hamo Keel
CHR-0096.title: Master
CHR-0096.looks: A big, red-faced shipwright of 48 with a bald scalp, adze-scarred shins and tar under every fingernail.
CHR-0096.manner: Cheerful and boastful, he talks oak and iron all day and sells to anyone with coin in hand.
CHR-0096.wants: He wants dwarven iron for his yard through Ulla Stonecount's private contract, cheaper than Aldmark pays.
CHR-0096.fears: He fears Greyhaven learning that three of Velgrad's fire-raft hulls are old cogs he sold.

CHR-0097.name: Garth Ferris
CHR-0097.title: Master Pilot
CHR-0097.looks: A lean, wind-burned man of 56 with a grey seaman's beard, a squint from years of watching water and an oiled wool cloak.
CHR-0097.manner: Quiet and exact, he names every shoal and tide aloud and trusts no chart he has not checked himself.
CHR-0097.wants: He wants the Amber pilots' secret routes learned by his boy inside House Karang and brought home to Greyhaven.
CHR-0097.fears: He fears House Karang discovering that the boy they call Kalu was sent by a Greyhaven pilot.

CHR-0098.name: Beatrix Hollin
CHR-0098.title: Toll-Mistress
CHR-0098.looks: A stout, grey-haired woman of 54 in bright Sunland cloth, with a heavy toll-house key on her belt and ink on her cuffs.
CHR-0098.manner: Brisk, confident and charming, she speaks of the toll as if it were her own and never lets a clerk see her worry.
CHR-0098.wants: She wants toll income kept high through the dragon year, so the crown never needs Redley's or Lucerna's loans.
CHR-0098.fears: She fears her clerk Edith Quill's copies reaching Velgrad's Channel-Master.

CHR-0099.name: Elinor Wren
CHR-0099.looks: A tall, elegant woman of 44 with dark hair under a jeweled net, a fur-trimmed green cloak and hands hardened in her timber yards.
CHR-0099.manner: Cool and polished, she speaks of timber as if it were gold and never names a price first.
CHR-0099.wants: She wants Dunstan Cole's twelve great Foxhurst oaks for her Timber Guild, whatever border they grow behind.
CHR-0099.fears: She fears Ned Thornby's letter, which proves she sells Greyhaven oak to Velgrad.

CHR-0100.name: Godric Redley
CHR-0100.looks: A heavy, soft-handed man of 57 with a fleshy face, small sharp eyes and rings of Sunland gold on every finger.
CHR-0100.manner: Smooth and polite, he talks of friendship while counting interest and never forgets a debt owed to him.
CHR-0100.wants: He wants a share of the Toll-House in return for the 60,000 tides he lent the crown for galleys in 1096.
CHR-0100.fears: He fears a war in the channel, which would sink the trade his loans depend on.

CHR-0101.name: Wulfric Grey
CHR-0101.title: Hall-Keeper
CHR-0101.looks: A tall, gaunt priest of 64 with wild white hair, sea-grey eyes and a cloak stitched with a black serpent over waves.
CHR-0101.manner: Fervent and dramatic, he preaches the dragon's rising from the harbor wall and frightens sailors and children alike.
CHR-0101.wants: He wants the harbor closed on the feared day and the crown paying for more priests and watch towers.
CHR-0101.fears: He fears the black serpent he saw rise in 1071 coming again with no rite ready to stop it.

CHR-0102.name: Linnet Tidewell
CHR-0102.title: King's Voice
CHR-0102.looks: A slim, quick-eyed young woman of 19 with pale hair in a sea-green net and fingers that move in divers' signs as she talks.
CHR-0102.manner: Poised and careful, she speaks her father's words aloud in council and sometimes softens them on the way.
CHR-0102.wants: She wants to stay at Greyhaven as her father's voice, not be sent to Drevna as Prince Yaromir's bride by Sea Opening.
CHR-0102.fears: She fears that if she leaves court, Tristan's helped ring dive will lose a guardian and come out.

CHR-0103.name: Tristan Tidewell
CHR-0103.title: Heir
CHR-0103.looks: A tall, broad-chested young man of 21 with salt-pale hair and a nervous habit of touching the silver ring at his throat.
CHR-0103.manner: Charming in company but tense alone, he laughs too quickly whenever anyone mentions diving.
CHR-0103.wants: He wants his sister Linnet kept at court, where she guards the secret his claim rests on.
CHR-0103.fears: He fears the Ring Law, which bars an heir whose ring dive was helped, and anyone who might talk.

CHR-0104.name: Osric IV Tidewell
CHR-0104.title: King
CHR-0104.looks: A broad, deep-chested king of 46, stone deaf from diving, with a salt-grey beard and eyes that read lips across a hall.
CHR-0104.manner: Silent and intent, he speaks with his hands in divers' signs and misses very little of what he cannot hear.
CHR-0104.wants: He wants Linnet married to Prince Yaromir of Drevna by Sea Opening, to win a northern ally against Velgrad.
CHR-0104.fears: He fears Velgrad seizing the channel tolls in the dragon year while Greyhaven stands without allies.

CHR-0105.name: Aveline Fairweather
CHR-0105.looks: A slender half-elf woman of 64 who looks barely thirty-five, with long dark hair, long hands and a midwife's linen apron.
CHR-0105.manner: Kind, unhurried and quietly firm, she talks to frightened people as if they were mothers in labor.
CHR-0105.wants: She wants the secret of Tristan's dive kept, and her long life lived out quietly in Greyhaven.
CHR-0105.fears: She fears being blamed if the secret comes out, since half-elves are already mistrusted in human lands.

CHR-0106.name: Wat Eelby
CHR-0106.looks: A wiry, damp-looking man of 38 with lank black hair, eel-skin boots and a nose broken in more than one tavern.
CHR-0106.manner: Shifty and talkative, he hints at great secrets for the price of a drink and never meets a stranger's eye.
CHR-0106.wants: He wants to sell what he saw of the eight hulls below Mount Dobava for enough silver to leave the channel for good.
CHR-0106.fears: He fears Velgrad's informers learning what he saw before he finds a buyer.

CHR-0107.name: Hawise Tapper
CHR-0107.looks: A big, red-armed woman of 42 with a tavern-keeper's apron, a gap-toothed grin and a heavy ladle she also uses as a club.
CHR-0107.manner: Loud and motherly, she knows every sailor's name and every rumor on the waterfront.
CHR-0107.wants: She wants a fair cut of whatever Wat Eelby's secret fetches, and no trouble in her tavern.
CHR-0107.fears: She fears Velgrad's informers, or the admiral's men, burning her tavern to keep Wat quiet.

CHR-0108.name: Hob Yellowhand
CHR-0108.looks: A stooped, coughing man of 44 with sulfur-yellowed hands and teeth, red-rimmed eyes and a rag tied over his mouth.
CHR-0108.manner: Mumbling and nervous, he coughs between sentences and changes the subject whenever anyone mentions dragons.
CHR-0108.wants: He wants the Hall-Keeper's silver to keep coming, and enough of it to stop digging sulfur before it kills him.
CHR-0108.fears: He fears Velgrad's buyers, who now come to Smokewell for sulfur, learning what else he knows.

CHR-0109.name: Edith Quill
CHR-0109.looks: A thin, pale young woman of 25 with ink-stained fingers, a neat brown braid and a plain grey dress patched at the elbows.
CHR-0109.manner: Timid and precise, she speaks softly, counts everything twice and hides behind her ledgers.
CHR-0109.wants: She wants her copies kept safe until she decides whether they buy her a fortune or her freedom.
CHR-0109.fears: She fears Toll-Mistress Beatrix finding the copies, and the Velgrad merchant who has started asking about her…

CHR-0110.name: Hugo Stannard
CHR-0110.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0110.title: Captain of the Chain Guard
CHR-0110.looks: A powerful, square-jawed man of 36 with rope-burned hands, a sealskin coat over mail and a ring of chain-house keys.
CHR-0110.manner: Steady, dutiful and humorless, he speaks in short reports and checks the chain at every tide.
CHR-0110.wants: He wants the Grey Channel chain raised and manned every dusk in July, when fire rafts may come.
CHR-0110.fears: He fears burning hulls drifting onto the chain itself, where no amount of iron can stop fire.

CHR-0111.name: Isobel Crane
CHR-0111.title: Marshal of the Rift, warden of the Rift Watch
CHR-0111.looks: A tall, lean woman of 42 with close-cropped grey-brown hair, mason's dust on her boots and a worn mail coat.
CHR-0111.manner: Brisk and demanding, she walks the walls at dawn and asks every mason how many stones he laid.
CHR-0111.wants: She wants the Falconhaven wall rebuilt before April, with the Rift Watch's 1,600 spearmen holding both passes.
CHR-0111.fears: She fears an enemy coming over the Rift Heights before the Falconhaven wall is finished.

CHR-0112.name: Ned Thornby
CHR-0112.looks: A rangy, sunburnt man of 29 with a shaggy beard, a patched green hood and a forester's longbow across his back.
CHR-0112.manner: Bitter and charismatic, he speaks to serfs like a brother and to lords like a judge.
CHR-0112.wants: He wants to free 200 more of House Redley's serfs at the Spring Equinox, with his 40 outlaws of the Wrendale forest.
CHR-0112.fears: He fears being caught and hanged at Redley's gate like his brother in 1097.

CHR-0113.name: Clemence Varrow
CHR-0113.looks: A small, round-shouldered woman of 52 with grey hair under a scholar's cap, dust in her sleeves and a ring of archive keys.
CHR-0113.manner: Mild and bookish, she speaks in dates and references and grows excited over old ink.
CHR-0113.wants: She wants the king to open the ferry accounts she found, so the archive's truth is not buried again.
CHR-0113.fears: She fears Khan Ozbek's envoys, who press the Greyhaven archives for old proofs and do not take no for an…

CHR-0114.name: Merrick Fenn
CHR-0114.looks: A forgettable man of 35 with mousy hair, a fisherman's tarred smock and quick, watchful eyes in a plain face.
CHR-0114.manner: Quiet and agreeable, he speaks Velgrad's tongue like a native and never stays long in one place.
CHR-0114.wants: He wants to get off the Velgrad shore alive once the fire rafts are ready to sail in July.
CHR-0114.fears: He fears Admiral Brightwater will let the rafts sail and leave him stranded on the wrong shore.

CHR-0115.name: Grete Tuskcutter
CHR-0115.looks: A sturdy woman of 34 with ivory dust in her hair, scarred carver's fingers and a reindeer-hide coat trimmed with seal fur.
CHR-0115.manner: Proud and direct, she speaks of her carvings as if they were her children and argues hard about price.
CHR-0115.wants: She wants to sail south on Leif Saltar's ship and sell her own carved tusk work for what it is really worth.
CHR-0115.fears: She fears Valdhall and House Coldwater, who need the unicorn-horn secret kept and will not like her going…

CHR-0116.name: Ragna of Valdgard
CHR-0116.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0116.looks: A tall, heavy-shouldered giant of 46, about 4 m tall, with thick red braids, walrus-leather armor and a sling of throwing stones.
CHR-0116.manner: Calm and blunt, she says little, trusts her pair-partner's back completely and has no patience for hall politics.
CHR-0116.wants: She wants the Pair Hall's pairs ready for the Thing of Midsummer, in case the choice of king turns to blows.
CHR-0116.fears: She fears the Hrimfell Raids starting again and sending her young pairs against Drevnan crossbows.

CHR-0117.name: Arvo Sealbane
CHR-0117.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0117.title: Headman of the Hunters
CHR-0117.looks: A short, weather-blackened man of 42 with a seal-tooth necklace, a harpoon scar across one cheek and reindeer-hide clothes.
CHR-0117.manner: Plain, proud and patient, he speaks to giants without craning his neck and weighs every word meant for the Thing.
CHR-0117.wants: He wants a human seat at the Thing of Midsummer for the 9,100 human hunters who feed the halls and fight beside them.
CHR-0117.fears: He fears Mother Asta blocking the seat again, as she did in 1098, and his people running out of patience.

CHR-0118.name: Brenna of Valdhall
CHR-0118.looks: A broad, handsome giant of 55 with silver-blond braids, a walrus-ivory brooch as big as a shield boss and seal-fur robes.
CHR-0118.manner: Practical and warm, she talks grain and ivory prices with humans as easily as lineage with giants.
CHR-0118.wants: She wants the Truce of Dobin kept and ivory sold south for grain, so that Valdhall's votes stay bought.
CHR-0118.fears: She fears that her brother Skuli's loose tongue has already sent Drevnan hunters to the tusk-whales' calving…

CHR-0119.name: Torvald of Torholm
CHR-0119.title: Eldest of Torholm; field leader in the raids
CHR-0119.looks: A huge, scarred giant of 52 with a coarse black beard, old bolt scars on his thighs and one stiff, hidden knee.
CHR-0119.manner: Fierce and proud, he talks of war as the only cure for the halls and mocks kings who rule from sledges.
CHR-0119.wants: He wants the war-leadership of the pairs at the Thing, and any excuse to break the Truce of Dobin and raid Dobin after first frost.
CHR-0119.fears: He fears the halls learning his own knee is failing, which would make a joke of the Walking Halls he leads.

CHR-0120.name: Asta
CHR-0120.title: Mother
CHR-0120.looks: An immense old giant of 74, over 4 m tall, whose knees have failed, with a whale-bone staff and a cloak of white fur.
CHR-0120.manner: Grave and unbending, she speaks rarely and in the old forms, and expects the halls to fall silent when she does.
CHR-0120.wants: She wants the Thing of Midsummer to take Ulfar of Jotunhall as king, the only name she will speak.
CHR-0120.fears: She fears the old Jotunhall blood losing the crown to a smaller hall, ending the line she has guarded all her…

CHR-0121.name: Ulfar of Jotunhall
CHR-0121.title: Heir; Hall Pairs of Jotunhall
CHR-0121.looks: A towering giant of 36, about 4.4 m tall and immensely strong, whose knees already ache and who leans on a whale-rib staff.
CHR-0121.manner: Earnest and heavy-voiced, he tries to sound like a king and starts bargaining the moment he fears he is losing.
CHR-0121.wants: He wants to be chosen king at the Thing of Midsummer, and has offered Torvald the war-leadership of the pairs for his vote.
CHR-0121.fears: He fears his knees failing like his father's, leaving him a king on a sledge before he is 45.

CHR-0122.name: Hraldr of Jotunhall
CHR-0122.title: King of Hrimfell
CHR-0122.looks: A vast, wasted giant of 64 who can no longer stand, carried on a great sledge, with a white beard to his waist.
CHR-0122.manner: Slow and wheezing, he speaks with long pauses, but his words are shrewd and his eyes miss nothing.
CHR-0122.wants: He wants the Truce of Dobin kept, and a giant who can walk chosen king at the Thing of Midsummer, even over his own son.
CHR-0122.fears: He fears dying before the Thing and leaving the halls to split between the old blood and the Walking Halls.

CHR-0123.name: Eyja of Torfell
CHR-0123.looks: A young giant woman of 25, about 3.6 m tall, with thick brown braids, a shy round face and an ivory comb.
CHR-0123.manner: Shy in public but stubborn in private, she listens to her elders politely and then does as she pleases.
CHR-0123.wants: She wants a match of her own choosing rather than Ulfar of Jotunhall, whose blood will take his knees.
CHR-0123.fears: She fears being tied to a king on a sledge and spending her life feeding a husband who cannot walk.

CHR-0124.name: Brodd of Torholm
CHR-0124.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0124.looks: A massive, quiet giant of 42 with a shaved scalp, a heavy maul and old scars from Dobin's harbor gate on his forearms.
CHR-0124.manner: Silent and steady, he speaks mostly to Torvald and always stands on his partner's weak side.
CHR-0124.wants: He wants Torvald leading the pairs again, and to stand beside him if they raid Dobin after first frost.
CHR-0124.fears: He fears his partner's knee giving way in front of the whole Thing.

CHR-0125.name: Skuli of Valdhall
CHR-0125.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0125.looks: A rangy, weather-cracked giant of 51 with a broken nose, walrus-hide boots and a huge harpoon of driftwood and iron.
CHR-0125.manner: Boastful and friendly, he drinks with traders and talks far too freely about the hunt.
CHR-0125.wants: He wants richer hunts and more trade, and thinks the Drevnan trader he befriended will help make Valdhall rich.
CHR-0125.fears: He fears his sister Brenna learning how much he told the Drevnan trader.

CHR-0126.name: Grani the Rememberer
CHR-0126.looks: A bent, ancient giant of 92 with a bald, spotted head, a thin white beard and cloudy eyes that seem to look inward.
CHR-0126.manner: Slow and singsong, he talks in old chant-lines and laughs softly at jokes no one else remembers.
CHR-0126.wants: He wants to chant the old version of the Mothers at the Thing, with Valdhall's and Torholm's Mothers before Jotunhall's.
CHR-0126.fears: He fears dying before he sings it, so that the old chant dies with him.

CHR-0127.name: Garin Solis
CHR-0127.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0127.title: Master of Noon Hall; Marshal of the Holy Coast province
CHR-0127.looks: A solid man of 44 with a pox-pitted face, a right eye half-blind from a lance splinter and a sun-painted shield.
CHR-0127.manner: Grim and sober, he speaks little, never drinks, and seems to be doing penance in everything he does.
CHR-0127.wants: He wants Bruno Castell's chair as Grand Master of the Knights of the Sun when the old man's breath finally fails.
CHR-0127.fears: He fears his blind right side in a fight, and the shame of Mirona catching up with him.

CHR-0128.name: Hugo Varr
CHR-0128.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0128.title: Master of the Crossbow Yard; captain of the Dorata Crossbows
CHR-0128.looks: A lean, sharp-eyed man of 49 with a clipped grey beard, a crossbowman's thick thumbs and a dark blue coat over mail.
CHR-0128.manner: Clever and cynical, he jokes about the Temple's piety and counts every bolt in the See's stores.
CHR-0128.wants: He wants the profit from the See's surplus Dorata crossbows before anyone counts the Yard's stores again.
CHR-0128.fears: He fears the first Blackreef raider taken this spring turning out to carry Dorata bolts.

CHR-0129.name: Bruno Castell
CHR-0129.title: Grand Master of the Knights of the Sun
CHR-0129.looks: A grey, heavy-set man of 55 with a puckered bolt scar through his right cheek and a sun-painted kite shield.
CHR-0129.manner: Gruff and straightforward, he speaks with a slur from that old wound and rides straight at every problem.
CHR-0129.wants: He wants to lead 1,000 Knights of the Sun to Tessar before Andros marches after 1 May.
CHR-0129.fears: He fears his wind failing after two passes in front of knights who already whisper about his age.

CHR-0130.name: Ada Tallow
CHR-0130.looks: A plump, rosy woman of 45 with wax-spattered sleeves, burn-shiny fingertips and a brass pilgrim's sun badge on her shawl.
CHR-0130.manner: Bustling and pious in speech, she praises the Light in one sentence and haggles hard in the next.
CHR-0130.wants: She wants her Return Day candle wax ordered by Lantern Night, 2 February, and cheap enough to keep her guild's profit.
CHR-0130.fears: She fears anyone finding a Dawn Church mark on her wax, which would ruin her and any candidate who looked…

CHR-0131.name: Rufus Gatewell
CHR-0131.looks: A big-bellied man of 53 with a red, jolly face, a stained innkeeper's apron and a heavy purse beneath it.
CHR-0131.manner: Hearty and welcoming to pilgrims, he turns cold as a ledger the moment a debt is overdue.
CHR-0131.wants: He wants Sir Tobias Merel's 1,200 suns repaid, or the Clarente granary lease in his own hands.
CHR-0131.fears: He fears a hungry spring and a contested election emptying Solenne's inns before Return Day.

CHR-0132.name: Aurelia Corvane
CHR-0132.looks: A tall, thin woman of 54 with silver hair under a dark blue veil, strikingly pale eyes and the Warden's gold key at her breast.
CHR-0132.manner: Precise and courteous, she notices every shade of color in a face and speaks as if she can see a lie.
CHR-0132.wants: She wants her four Luminaries' votes to choose the next High Luminary, and a Corvane crowned lay King of the Solen.
CHR-0132.fears: She fears the council learning that her son Cassius is color-blind and cannot read a banner, which would sink…

CHR-0133.name: Cato Brennus
CHR-0133.title: Lord of Lorina
CHR-0133.looks: A heavy, grey-bearded man of 57 with a sea-weathered face, a dark blue cloak and an old Lorina seal-ring on his thumb.
CHR-0133.manner: Bitter and patient, he speaks of Lorina's old grievance as if the fire at Mirona happened last winter.
CHR-0133.wants: He wants Tavian's letter of December 3 BR, which asked Corvan to let Lorina carry the blame for the fire.
CHR-0133.fears: He fears dying with Lorina still blamed for Mirona and the proof still locked in the Temple archive.

CHR-0134.name: Matthias Vell
CHR-0134.looks: A soft-faced, balding man of 46 in a faded dark blue coat, with ink-stained cuffs and a habit of twisting his rings.
CHR-0134.manner: Anxious and courteous, he apologizes often and talks about harvests the way gamblers talk about dice.
CHR-0134.wants: He wants good harvests at Lavino to pay off the 5,000 suns he owes House Lunetti before they call the debt in.
CHR-0134.fears: He fears the Temple raising the old fixed rent on Lavino's 12,000 acres, set at 1 sun for 10 acres in 760.

CHR-0135.name: Tobias Merel
CHR-0135.looks: A lean, tired knight of 41 with the bearing of Noon Hall, a patched dark blue surcoat and grey coming early to his hair.
CHR-0135.manner: Proud but worn down, he speaks of honor and money in the same breath and apologizes for both.
CHR-0135.wants: He wants to sell the old Clarente granary's great oak beams to pay his 2,600 suns of debt and feed his four children.
CHR-0135.fears: He fears the Keepers of the Count burning the beams before he is paid, or making him vanish with them.

CHR-0136.name: Crispin Dorn
CHR-0136.looks: A sleek, well-fed priest of 60 in white and gold, with a smooth jowly face, soft hands and a heavy gold sun on a chain.
CHR-0136.manner: Genial and quick with numbers, he speaks of faith in the language of loans and returns.
CHR-0136.wants: He wants Severin's chair, cheap bread for Solenne, and Lady Aurelia Corvane's four votes before the old man dies.
CHR-0136.fears: He fears Livia's claim falling apart and taking the Temple's loans, and his own name, down with it.

CHR-0137.name: Marius Quill
CHR-0137.looks: A thin, bent priest of 67 with a hawk's face, cold grey eyes and the archive keys hanging heavy from a chain at his waist.
CHR-0137.manner: Quiet and icy, he speaks in short, exact sentences and makes every listener feel watched.
CHR-0137.wants: He wants Serra's copied proof bought or stolen from Queen Saelith in March, and the six missing years buried forever.
CHR-0137.fears: He fears the Book of Ash panic if the Needle's count and the tree-ring count are ever shown to agree.

CHR-0138.name: Ottone Brandi
CHR-0138.looks: A stout, red-cheeked priest of 64 in white and gold, with heavy rings and the comfortable belly of a rich see.
CHR-0138.manner: Smiling and smooth, he blesses everyone he meets and remembers exactly what each one owes the Temple.
CHR-0138.wants: He wants the Temple's sixth of Varenna's farm rents collected in full, whatever Clara Serafin's Tithe Resisters say.
CHR-0138.fears: He fears Agnese of Venina's 40 villages spreading their refusal until no collector dares ride into the…

CHR-0139.name: Severin III
CHR-0139.title: Head of state
CHR-0139.looks: A frail, wasted old priest of 73 in white and gold, with paper-thin skin, a trembling hand and sharp eyes under heavy lids.
CHR-0139.manner: Slow and whispering, he speaks in short breaths and lets silence do most of his work.
CHR-0139.wants: He wants Queen Livia's crown upheld and the Temple's secrets kept until his chair passes to a safe successor.
CHR-0139.fears: He fears dying before the succession is settled, leaving a hungry city and two rivals to fight over his chair.

CHR-0140.name: Lucan Serra
CHR-0140.looks: A slight, pale monk of 34 with ink on his fingers, a Needle-Keeper's plain robe and bright, sleepless eyes.
CHR-0140.manner: Earnest and quick, he talks about star-lists and tree rings with a passion that frightens his elders.
CHR-0140.wants: He wants the Clarente beams counted before they burn, and Serra's proof kept safe from Marius Quill's envoy.
CHR-0140.fears: He fears being walled up for the Needle Heresy, as two men of his family have been since 316.

CHR-0141.name: Otto Quire
CHR-0141.looks: A bent, short-sighted scrivener of 56 with a fringe of white hair, ink-black fingertips and a plain brown robe.
CHR-0141.manner: Fussy and whispery, he talks to old documents more kindly than to people.
CHR-0141.wants: He wants Lord Cato Brennus's silver to keep coming for every list of the archive's Famine War papers he copies.
CHR-0141.fears: He fears Marius Quill learning what he has found in the archive, and whom he has told.

CHR-0142.name: Bastian of Clarente
CHR-0142.looks: A strong, broad-handed joiner of 38 with sawdust in his beard, a leather apron and an oxcart he drives himself.
CHR-0142.manner: Cheerful and plain-spoken, he talks about wood like an old friend and asks no questions about buyers.
CHR-0142.wants: He wants more carting work from Sir Tobias, and to forget whatever was so special about two old roof beams.
CHR-0142.fears: He fears the Keepers of the Count learning that he carted the Clarente beams away.

CHR-0143.name: Tessa Marlow
CHR-0143.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0143.looks: A rangy, hard-faced woman of 36 with a broken nose, cropped black hair and a hire-captain's mismatched finery over mail.
CHR-0143.manner: Cheerful and mercenary, she talks money first and loyalty second, and keeps both bargains to the letter.
CHR-0143.wants: She wants Lorina's purse to keep paying her company of 440, whatever war Varenna or the Temple starts.
CHR-0143.fears: She fears being ordered to fight the Temple's own men if Lorina's old grudge against Solenne ever turns to…

CHR-0144.name: Aimon Rastell
CHR-0144.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0144.title: Commander of the Solenne chapter
CHR-0144.looks: A lean, light knight of 36 with a climber's long arms, a once-broken collarbone and a coil of rope beside his mace.
CHR-0144.manner: Courteous and reserved, he says little about himself and watches rooftops the way other knights watch roads.
CHR-0144.wants: He wants to reach Silverbough in March and see his father's proof before he decides to buy it, steal it, or turn.
CHR-0144.fears: He fears the letter said to wait for him in the Silverbough archive, and what it will ask of him.

CHR-0145.name: Leandro Fosca
CHR-0145.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0145.title: Captain of the Lantern Guard
CHR-0145.looks: A solid man of 41, going soft at the belt, with a knife scar along his ribs and a tall lantern-painted shield.
CHR-0145.manner: Calm and unhurried, he is polite to everyone and lets nothing in his face show what he is thinking.
CHR-0145.wants: He wants every trace of the night Amadeo Rusk used his key wiped away before Marius Quill notices.
CHR-0145.fears: He fears Keeper Marius Quill above all men, and what the Needle Court does to traitors.

CHR-0146.name: Petra Brennus
