CHR-0146.title: Castellan of Lorina Castle; captain of the Lorina squadron
CHR-0146.looks: A tall, sunburnt woman of 33 with her father's heavy brows, salt-bleached hair tied back and a dark blue sea-cloak over mail.
CHR-0146.manner: Bold and quick, she gives orders in a carrying voice and enjoys shocking the priests of Solenne.
CHR-0146.wants: She wants her 12 Lorina galleys at sea with Admiral Castellan's fleet against Blackreef after Sea Opening.
CHR-0146.fears: She fears the Temple learning she spent 3,000 suns of Lorina's tithe money on new oars.

CHR-0147.name: Isaria Vale
CHR-0147.looks: A tall, slender half-elf woman of 52 who looks thirty, with dark hair under a sun-sister's white wimple.
CHR-0147.manner: Serene and dry-witted, she speaks gently and lets others underestimate her.
CHR-0147.wants: She wants to be confirmed as Mother of the sun-sisters, and to see the Temple tell the truth about its count.
CHR-0147.fears: She fears her cipher packets being opened on the road north with her own seal on them.

CHR-0148.name: Honora Castine
CHR-0148.looks: A neat, grave woman of 42 with grey-streaked hair under a linen cap, a physician's sharp eyes and herb-stained fingers.
CHR-0148.manner: Measured and cautious, she speaks in careful medical terms and never gives a straight answer for free.
CHR-0148.wants: She wants Lady Aurelia's silver for news of Severin's health, and to be kept on by whoever wins his chair.
CHR-0148.fears: She fears being blamed if the High Luminary dies under her care at the worst possible moment.

CHR-0149.name: Amadeo Rusk
CHR-0149.looks: A thin, nervous young man of 25 with ink-black fingers, a scholar's pale face and a satchel he never puts down.
CHR-0149.manner: Clever and twitchy, he talks fast, laughs too loudly and jumps at footsteps.
CHR-0149.wants: He wants to carry his copy of the physician's tablets east to Tessar and collect the rest of his pay.
CHR-0149.fears: He fears the Lantern Guard, the Needle-Keepers and Queen Livia's men, all of whom would kill for what he…

CHR-0150.name: Ilario Monti
CHR-0150.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0150.looks: A short, broad man of 43 with a sun-browned face, a crossbowman's strong hands and a Palella-blue surcoat over mail.
CHR-0150.manner: Patient and methodical, he teaches by repetition and talks of terraces and walls like a farmer of his fields.
CHR-0150.wants: He wants his crossbowmen ready on the castle walls if the War Party marches on Crowbrook after May Fair.
CHR-0150.fears: He fears his garrisons being stripped for the Stagley stroke, leaving Castella's walls thinly manned.

CHR-0151.name: Matteo Grasso
CHR-0151.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0151.title: Master of the Hall of the Lion; Marshal of the Crown knights
CHR-0151.looks: A grey-bearded knight of 45 with knees bowed by the saddle and a white lance scar running from lip to ear.
CHR-0151.manner: Steady and slow to anger, he speaks plainly and keeps his own counsel, even with his commanders.
CHR-0151.wants: He wants King Roderic's collapse kept quiet and Prince Galen's weak eyes hidden until the boy is safe.
CHR-0151.fears: He fears the king's heart giving out before Galen is grown, and a fight over the regency.

CHR-0152.name: Dario Montaro
CHR-0152.title: Lord Marshal; War Party
CHR-0152.looks: A barrel-chested, grey man of 52 with eleven scars he can count, an open helm and a left foot that catches on stairs.
CHR-0152.manner: Loud, cheerful and fearless, he laughs at danger and at people, and his calm often reads as coldness.
CHR-0152.wants: He wants to strike Ashmere before 21 June, taking Crowbrook and besieging Stagley with about 46,000 men.
CHR-0152.fears: He fears only dying in bed rather than on a battlefield, as he swore after his father's death in 1071.

CHR-0153.name: Nino Castellan
CHR-0153.title: Admiral of the Lion Fleet
CHR-0153.looks: A lean, weather-dark man of 49 with a close black beard, gold earrings from the Corsair War and a Palella-blue sea-coat.
CHR-0153.manner: Fierce and righteous, he speaks of Blackreef as a disease and of the dragon toll as plain theft.
CHR-0153.wants: He wants 20 Lucernan galleys at Sea Opening and 40 new ones of his own, to break Blackreef and end the dragon toll.
CHR-0153.fears: He fears Varenna's coming war with Ashmere swallowing the money for his new fleet.

CHR-0154.name: Aldo Ferran
CHR-0154.looks: A big, bald shipwright of 54 with a burn-scarred scalp, thick forearms and a Palella-blue coat stained with tar.
CHR-0154.manner: Bluff and practical, he speaks in timber and coin and dislikes noblemen who do not pay on time.
CHR-0154.wants: He wants the contract for Admiral Castellan's 40 new galleys, which would keep his yards rich for ten years.
CHR-0154.fears: He fears Piero Calvane's weaving halls failing to repay what he lent against the cloth tax.

CHR-0155.name: Nella Brisa
CHR-0155.looks: A sharp-faced woman of 47 with grey-blond braids, lint on her Palella-blue sleeves and a weaver's quick hands.
CHR-0155.manner: Clever and guarded, she speaks warmly of the weavers and coldly of anyone who threatens the guild's secret.
CHR-0155.wants: She wants Sabina found before she reaches Ashmere, and the spinning wheel kept a Palella secret.
CHR-0155.fears: She fears being exposed as the aunt who helped Sabina escape in the first place.

CHR-0156.name: Bertran Ardane
CHR-0156.looks: A tall, sallow man of 46 with a thin black beard, a long Palella-blue surcoat and a toll-warden's silver chain.
CHR-0156.manner: Smooth and grasping, he speaks of honor in council and of percentages in private.
CHR-0156.wants: He wants the War Party to take Crowbrook, which has been promised to him as a new lordship.
CHR-0156.fears: He fears Remo Casti, the man he sent to the galleys, who now robs his toll wagons on the Crown Road.

CHR-0157.name: Clara Serafin
CHR-0157.looks: A tall, striking woman of 40 with dark hair under a pale veil, marble dust on her hem and a proud, sharp chin.
CHR-0157.manner: Passionate and sharp-tongued, she speaks in the Great Council like a prosecutor and never forgets the revolt of 1049.
CHR-0157.wants: She wants the Temple's tithe cut and the Temple farmland in Varenna won back for its lords.
CHR-0157.fears: She fears the Temple's courts coming down on House Serafin, as the crown crushed it in 1049.

CHR-0158.name: Piero Calvane
CHR-0158.looks: A plump, pale man of 55 with careful grey curls, ink-stained fingers and a Treasurer's chain over a fine blue coat.
CHR-0158.manner: Soft-voiced and evasive, he answers every question with a figure and every accusation with a smile.
CHR-0158.wants: He wants the spinning wheel kept a Palella secret, since his own weaving halls would be the first fortune to fall.
CHR-0158.fears: He fears the moneychangers noticing that the Varennan sun is lighter in silver than it should be.

CHR-0159.name: Bianca Falcone
CHR-0159.looks: A slim, dark-haired queen of 36 with keen Falcone eyes, green glass shades for the noon sun and a gown of Palella blue.
CHR-0159.manner: Cool, watchful and decisive, she speaks for her son in council and rarely raises her voice.
CHR-0159.wants: She wants the regency for Galen if the king dies, backed by 4,000 Morhaven men landed at Varenna.
CHR-0159.fears: She fears Dario Montaro seizing the palace, and her son, on the day Roderic's heart stops.

CHR-0160.name: Galen Valdane
CHR-0160.looks: A tall, thin boy of 12 with long arms and fingers, who grew a hand's breadth last year and squints at anything beyond 20 paces.
CHR-0160.manner: Quiet and careful, he moves through the palace by memory and covers his poor sight with polite silence.
CHR-0160.wants: He wants to be good enough with lance and sword that no one ever guesses he cannot see a banner.
CHR-0160.fears: He fears his father dying and being fought over like a prize by his mother and the Lord Marshal.

CHR-0161.name: Roderic III Valdane
CHR-0161.title: King, commander in law
CHR-0161.looks: A very tall, stooped king of 42 with long Valdane arms, a short-sighted squint and a grey pallor since November.
CHR-0161.manner: Proud and restless, he speaks of the Lionheart's legends and refuses to rest, though his breath comes short.
CHR-0161.wants: He wants to live long enough for Galen to grow, and to keep his collapse hidden from Solenne, Kingsmere and Ashmere.
CHR-0161.fears: He fears his heart giving out like those of the Valdanes before him, leaving a boy king and a fight for the…

CHR-0162.name: Oria Vantes
CHR-0162.looks: A small, elegant woman of 44 with dark hair in a silver net, a soft voice and rings that each hide a different seal.
CHR-0162.manner: Charming and patient, she listens far more than she speaks and always seems to know more than she says.
CHR-0162.wants: She wants the full terms of the Harald and Rowena betrothal, including any hidden clause, before 21 June.
CHR-0162.fears: She fears the king's collapse leaking abroad before Varenna is ready to strike.

CHR-0163.name: Sabina of Camia
CHR-0163.looks: A small, quick young woman of 21 with frizzy brown hair, spinner's calloused fingertips and a bundle she never lets out of reach.
CHR-0163.manner: Bold and talkative when she feels safe, frightened and sharp when cornered, she haggles like a merchant's daughter.
CHR-0163.wants: She wants a fortune from Ashmere's weavers for the spindle and flyer of the Palella spinning wheel.
CHR-0163.fears: She fears Captain Fiora Lanza's raiders crossing the border to drag her home, or worse.

CHR-0164.name: Lupo Grell
CHR-0164.looks: A lean, sun-blackened river smuggler of 38 with a gold tooth, pole-callused hands and a sly grin.
CHR-0164.manner: Easy-going and full of river talk, he trusts nobody and charges twice for every favor.
CHR-0164.wants: He wants the Dorata crossbow trade to Blackreef to keep running through the spring sailing season.
CHR-0164.fears: He fears the first Blackreef raider taken this spring with Dorata bolts aboard, which would lead straight…

CHR-0165.name: Fiora Lanza
CHR-0165.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0165.looks: A wiry, sharp-featured woman of 34 with a bolt-nicked ear, cropped auburn hair and a crossbow captain's Palella-blue surcoat.
CHR-0165.manner: Eager and aggressive, she talks of the border like a hunting ground and itches for orders to cross it.
CHR-0165.wants: She wants orders to raid Crowbrook and bring back the runaway spinner before Ashmere's weavers learn the wheel.
CHR-0165.fears: She fears the Weavers' Guild learning that she reports on them to Lord Calvane.

CHR-0166.name: Marta Rema
CHR-0166.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0166.title: Captain of the Lion Marines
CHR-0166.looks: A tall, sun-browned woman of 29 with a boarding axe, salt-cracked lips and a long scar along her sword arm.
CHR-0166.manner: Tough and dry-humored, she gives orders in short barks and keeps her own family out of every conversation.
CHR-0166.wants: She wants to sail against Blackreef with the admiral after Sea Opening and take a pirate raider whole.
CHR-0166.fears: She fears meeting her brother across a deck with Ima Redsail's pirates behind him.

CHR-0167.name: Rinaldo Vasco
CHR-0167.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0167.title: Captain of the Lion Guard
CHR-0167.looks: A lean, elegant knight of 40 with a duelist's quick hands, a dagger scar through his left palm and a Lion Guard surcoat.
CHR-0167.manner: Courteous and cool, he speaks like a courtier and moves like a fencer, always half a step from his sword.
CHR-0167.wants: He wants to be on the winning side when the king dies, and has bet on Dario Montaro.
CHR-0167.fears: He fears Matteo Grasso, his old master, learning what he has promised behind the king's back.

CHR-0168.name: Vittor Montaro
CHR-0168.title: Captain-General of the Crown Road army
CHR-0168.looks: A broad, scarred general of 44 with a grey-streaked beard and the calm, unbothered face of the Montaro blood.
CHR-0168.manner: Calm, forgetful and blunt, he gives orders without heat and seems unmoved by bad news.
CHR-0168.wants: He wants the passes held with the Crown Road army of 18,000 while the Stagley stroke goes up the Palella.
CHR-0168.fears: He fears being left guarding the passes while his cousins win the war on the Palella.

CHR-0169.name: Ottavia Montaro
CHR-0169.title: Captain-General of the Crown Coast
CHR-0169.looks: A hard, grey-haired woman of 46 with the Montaro calm, a dozen old scars and a black mourning ribbon on her sword hilt.
CHR-0169.manner: Cold and exact, she drills the Laughing Company without a smile and watches every recruit for hidden wounds.
CHR-0169.wants: She wants Queen Bianca, not her brother, to hold the regency if King Roderic dies.
CHR-0169.fears: She fears the Montaro blood that lets men laugh while they bleed, as her son Lucca hid a cut and died of it…

CHR-0170.name: Brina Tosk
CHR-0170.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0170.looks: A broad, wind-burned woman of 36 with a harpoon over her shoulder, tarred braids and a long scar from a snapped line.
CHR-0170.manner: Blunt and restless, she talks of almost nothing but Old Ironjaw and is bored on land within a day.
CHR-0170.wants: She wants to kill Old Ironjaw, the scarred leviathan bull of the Strait of Hael, for the Bassan insurers' bounty.
CHR-0170.fears: She fears going down with her boat like the four ships Old Ironjaw has sunk since 1088.

CHR-0171.name: Orso Fenn
CHR-0171.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0171.looks: A heavy, bearded beast-catcher of 47 with claw-scarred forearms, a leather hood and wicker cages on his mule.
CHR-0171.manner: Jovial and greedy, he talks of beasts like merchandise and of princes' menageries like markets.
CHR-0171.wants: He wants a Snow Drake egg from Col Eyrie at Roseham, to sell to a Varennan prince for a fortune.
CHR-0171.fears: He fears the Stonefoots catching him in the League with drake-catching gear and money for an egg.

CHR-0172.name: Agnese of Venina
CHR-0172.looks: A thin, sun-browned widow of 43 with grey-streaked hair under a black kerchief and work-hardened farmer's hands.
CHR-0172.manner: Plain and fierce, she speaks for the villages in short, hard sentences and never bows to a collector.
CHR-0172.wants: She wants the Luminary's rent collectors kept out of Venina's 40 villages until the Temple's sixth is cut.
CHR-0172.fears: She fears soldiers coming for the strike leaders, as the hangmen came for her grandfather in 1049.

CHR-0173.name: Tullio Ashwell
CHR-0173.looks: A gaunt, grey preacher of 59 with ash smeared on his brow, a ragged brown robe and burn-scarred hands.
CHR-0173.manner: Soft-voiced and intense, he preaches in whispers by night and speaks of the end of things with calm certainty.
CHR-0173.wants: He wants a safe place to preach, and Lady Serafin's quarries at Venina may be it.
CHR-0173.fears: He fears the Temple's hunters, who track down the Ashen as heretics.

CHR-0174.name: Remo Casti
CHR-0174.looks: A wiry, scarred man of 32 with galley-chain marks on his ankles, a shaved head and a stolen Palella-blue cloak.
CHR-0174.manner: Mocking and quick, he laughs at lords and treats every robbery as a joke at Bertran Ardane's expense.
CHR-0174.wants: He wants to ruin Bertran Ardane, the lord who sent him to the galleys in 1094, one toll wagon at a time.
CHR-0174.fears: He fears going back to the galleys, and has sworn to die before he does.

CHR-0175.name: Ferro Anselmi
CHR-0175.looks: A neat, bald physician of 50 with a grey pointed beard, a scholar's stoop and a leather case of instruments and notes.
CHR-0175.manner: Precise and gloomy, he speaks in careful Old Solen terms and prefers hard truth to comfort.
CHR-0175.wants: He wants King Roderic to rest and stop riding, so his failing heart lasts until Prince Galen is grown.
CHR-0175.fears: He fears the king dying under his care and being blamed by whichever side wins the regency.

CHR-0176.name: Lucio Fen
CHR-0176.looks: A pleasant, round-faced man of 33 in plain Aldmark wool, dressed to pass as a Kingsmere clerk.
CHR-0176.manner: Friendly and forgettable, he speaks the northern tongue without an accent and laughs at the right jokes.
CHR-0176.wants: He wants the full terms of the Harald and Rowena betrothal for Oria Vantes before the wedding on 21 June.
CHR-0176.fears: He fears Lady Ysolde Ravenscar's informers, who seem to be everywhere in Kingsmere.

CHR-0177.name: Stefano Marin
CHR-0177.title: Master of the Guild of Pilots
CHR-0177.looks: A small, leathery man of 53 with a white-stubbled chin, a sailor's squint and a pouch at his neck he never opens in company.
CHR-0177.manner: Calm, stubborn and secretive, he answers questions about the sea with riddles and questions about money very plainly.
CHR-0177.wants: He wants the pilots' pay doubled before he lends Admiral Salvi his Night Pilots for the gold expedition.
CHR-0177.fears: He fears another port learning the secret of the floating lodestone needle.

CHR-0178.name: Iacopo Rizzo
CHR-0178.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0178.title: Master of the Arsenal Yard; drill-master of the marines
CHR-0178.looks: A thick-armed man of 41 with an axe scar on his jaw, singed eyebrows and a dark red marine's coat.
CHR-0178.manner: Swaggering and curious, he cannot leave a mystery alone and boasts in taverns about what he has seen.
CHR-0178.wants: He wants to know exactly what the Arsenal's lamp oil really is, and how much the Republic is hiding.
CHR-0178.fears: He fears Ugo Brenta's count of the jars, and Sabra's oil-master asking who has been talking.

CHR-0179.name: Renzo Salvi
CHR-0179.title: Admiral of the Republic
CHR-0179.looks: A tall, handsome admiral of 50 with silver at his temples, a dark red council cloak and gold rings from the Tirana trade.
CHR-0179.manner: Charming and ambitious, he talks of glory and gold in one breath and makes every listener feel like a partner.
CHR-0179.wants: He wants a fourth expedition to the upper Tirana gold, guided by the survivor Jory Flint, before anyone else gets there.
CHR-0179.fears: He fears Varenna learning that his house shares the dragon toll his friend Admiral Castellan has sworn to end.

CHR-0180.name: Giulia Bassan
CHR-0180.looks: A handsome, heavy-browed woman of 46 in a dark red council gown, with a counting-school tally board always at hand.
CHR-0180.manner: Cool and exact, she knows the grain in every Sunland port to a tenth and never bargains when she can wait.
CHR-0180.wants: She wants the Holy See to pay more for Tamari wheat, and holds back Solenne's spring grain ships to force it.
CHR-0180.fears: She fears Marro of Lavium's salt-workers' strike spreading to her windmills and grain barges.

CHR-0181.name: Ugo Brenta
CHR-0181.title: Master of the Arsenal
CHR-0181.looks: A heavy, bald man of 57 with a ledger under one arm, tar on his boots and a gold chain of office across his belly.
CHR-0181.manner: Gruff and suspicious, he counts everything twice and suspects every clerk of theft.
CHR-0181.wants: He wants to learn who took a jar from the Arsenal before anyone outside Lucerna does.
CHR-0181.fears: He fears Sabra's oil-master Qasim Nafari learning that Lucerna's secret has leaked.

CHR-0182.name: Flavia Morello
CHR-0182.looks: A slender, sharp-eyed woman of 38 in a dark red council gown, with ink on one finger and a plain gold ring.
CHR-0182.manner: Cool, articulate and relentless, she speaks in the Great Council like an auditor reading a crime aloud.
CHR-0182.wants: She wants the Doge's strongroom opened before the next Great Council, and the next dogeship for an honest house.
CHR-0182.fears: She fears Ser Marco Vanni's Night Watch finding her source, Chiara Benn, before the Council sits.

CHR-0183.name: Marco Vanni
CHR-0183.title: Lord of the Night Watch
CHR-0183.looks: A lean, dark-eyed man of 42 with a close black beard, a dark red cloak over a watchman's leather coat and a lantern-staff.
CHR-0183.manner: Quiet, polite and menacing, he asks questions softly and never says what he will do with the answers.
CHR-0183.wants: He wants Flavia Morello's source found and silenced before the next Great Council sits.
CHR-0183.fears: He fears the front house's ledgers in the Lunetti vault at Ostra, or Ithel Varo's true copies, coming to…

CHR-0184.name: Tiberio Doravelli
CHR-0184.title: Doge
CHR-0184.looks: A thin, sickly-looking Doge of 64 with a pale, narrow face, a gold chain of office and a plate of plain bread before him.
CHR-0184.manner: Soft-spoken and fastidious, he winces at strong smells and chooses every word as carefully as his food.
CHR-0184.wants: He wants the fifth share of the dragon toll kept secret and the Clean Ledger kept out of his strongroom.
CHR-0184.fears: He fears Varenna learning that Lucerna takes a fifth of the toll Admiral Castellan wants its galleys to fight.

CHR-0185.name: Nerio Doravelli
CHR-0185.looks: A thin, pale man of 32 with a pinched, sickly face, delicate hands and a silver tasting spoon on a chain.
CHR-0185.manner: Polite, nervous and watchful, he eats tiny bites slowly and notices every flavor and every glance at table.
CHR-0185.wants: He wants Queen Livia alive and his house's name clean, while he decides whether to warn her about the paper from Solenne.
CHR-0185.fears: He fears Basil Ordane's offer becoming known and shaming the whole house of Doravelli.

CHR-0186.name: Ithel Varo
CHR-0186.looks: A slim, elegant half-elf of 44 with ink-dark fingertips, a neat dark beard and a carved wax seal on a cord.
CHR-0186.manner: Witty and careful, he praises other men's handwriting and remembers every signature he has ever seen.
CHR-0186.wants: He wants to stay useful to Marco Vanni and out of the lagoon, while keeping a way to bargain his way free.
CHR-0186.fears: He fears Marco deciding one day that a forger who knows everything is safer at the bottom of the lagoon.

CHR-0187.name: Marro of Lavium
CHR-0187.looks: A lean, sunburnt salt-worker of 30 with cracked white hands from the pans, a ragged straw hat and a loud voice.
CHR-0187.manner: Fiery and funny, he rouses crowds with jokes about the Bassans and speaks plainly to anyone who will listen.
CHR-0187.wants: He wants Lady Giulia Bassan to lower the milling toll she raised in 1103 and pay the salt-workers fairly.
CHR-0187.fears: He fears the Night Watch coming for the strike leaders some dark night.

CHR-0188.name: Chiara Benn
CHR-0188.looks: A small, bright-eyed woman of 28 with chalk on her sleeves, ink-stained fingers and a counting board under her arm.
CHR-0188.manner: Quick, precise and a little proud, she explains sums to anyone who will listen and trusts numbers over people.
CHR-0188.wants: She wants her sums on the Ostran front house laid before the Great Council, with her own name kept out of it.
CHR-0188.fears: She fears Marco Vanni's Night Watch, who are hunting Flavia Morello's source.

CHR-0189.name: Otto Deepgrave
CHR-0189.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0189.title: Master of the Mine Hall of Castina
CHR-0189.looks: A short, broad man of 50 with a pox-pitted face and a back and neck burned to ridges by the Red Widow in 1079.
CHR-0189.manner: Slow and patient, he listens more than he talks and often tilts his head as if hearing something under the ground.
CHR-0189.wants: He wants Cosimo Lunetti's gold in hand before he agrees to go back to the Tirana streams where the dragon burned him.
CHR-0189.fears: He fears the Red Widow coming out of the sunset again, as she did on the day she killed 260 men.

CHR-0190.name: Serena Falcone
CHR-0190.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0190.title: Master of the Tower of Far Eyes
CHR-0190.looks: A slim, hawk-eyed woman of 29 with sun-browned skin, green glass shades pushed up on her brow and a signal horn at her belt.
CHR-0190.manner: Sharp, alert and impatient, she points out ships before anyone else can see them and hates being doubted.
CHR-0190.wants: She wants her tower's watch kept true, even if her cipher log proves which road Livia's fire-oil jars took.
CHR-0190.fears: She fears her log being used to drag Morhaven into the Tessarian war as the road the fire came by.

CHR-0191.name: Adela Corso
CHR-0191.title: Harbor-Mistress of Felano
CHR-0191.looks: A stout, shrewd woman of 45 with grey-flecked hair under a felt cap, riding boots and a ring of warehouse keys.
CHR-0191.manner: Practical and plain-spoken, she argues for Felano like a lawyer and remembers every bill of lading.
CHR-0191.wants: She wants a charter of self-rule for Felano and a seat for its merchants on the Crown Council.
CHR-0191.fears: She fears Morhaven being named as the oil road and losing the neutral trade that makes Felano rich.

CHR-0192.name: Nico Brant
CHR-0192.looks: A burly, red-bearded shipwright of 50 with tar-stained hands, a felt cap and a voice made loud by the yards.
CHR-0192.manner: Cheerful and blunt, he talks about hulls and grain prices and has little love for the court.
CHR-0192.wants: He wants more grain cogs built and loaded at Felano, and the city's merchants given a voice on the Crown Council.
CHR-0192.fears: He fears Velgrad's galleys raiding Morhaven's coast if Felano is named as the road of the fire-oil.

CHR-0193.name: Oskan Bay
CHR-0193.looks: A lean, bow-legged horse dealer of 44 with a steppe felt cap, a sun-darkened face and a whip tucked in his boot.
CHR-0193.manner: Easy and charming, he talks horses in two tongues and never gives a price without a story.
CHR-0193.wants: He wants the 600 Sea Wind horses a year to keep coming south to Santora without the khan's tenth.
CHR-0193.fears: He fears Lord Arnaut Sabine or the khan's men learning how many horses cross untaxed.

CHR-0194.name: Arnaut Sabine
CHR-0194.title: Master of Horse
CHR-0194.looks: A tall, well-dressed horse-lord of 48 with a trimmed grey beard, fine riding boots and a heavy purse at his belt.
CHR-0194.manner: Courteous and smooth, he speaks of the king's horses with pride and of the king's silver with great care.
CHR-0194.wants: He wants the Horse Road compact with the Nine Winds to keep paying, and the oil silver to keep passing through his hands.
CHR-0194.fears: He fears his sister Oriana catching the oil caravans and dragging the oil silver into the light.

CHR-0195.name: Emilio Castor
CHR-0195.title: Chancellor
CHR-0195.looks: A heavy, tired man of 54 with ink-stained cuffs, pouched eyes and the Chancellor's seal hanging from a cord.
CHR-0195.manner: Careful and weary, he speaks in legal phrases and sighs before every hard answer.
CHR-0195.wants: He wants King Aurelio to get Nell Brine's sealed contract of 1011, so Morhaven can make Tessaria pay for the sack.
CHR-0195.fears: He fears the Temple calling in his debt now that its clerk has read the carrion roll.

CHR-0196.name: Fabio Cresta
CHR-0196.looks: A tall, silver-haired priest of 61 in white and gold, with a long, solemn face and a gold sun on his breast.
CHR-0196.manner: Grave and persuasive, he speaks of the Light's duty to Queen Livia as if it were a law of nature.
CHR-0196.wants: He wants Morhaven to enter the Tessarian war openly for Queen Livia, as the Temple wishes.
CHR-0196.fears: He fears the carrion roll of 897 being read in public, showing the Miracle was only dead cattle in a stream.

CHR-0197.name: Tancred Falcone
CHR-0197.title: Marshal of the Steppe March; commands the field army
CHR-0197.looks: A lean, weathered prince of 34 with a short dark beard, a steppe felt cap and a plain riding coat over his mail.
CHR-0197.manner: Earnest and blunt, he talks of towers, horses and walls, and distrusts his father's bargains.
CHR-0197.wants: He wants the Steppe March strengthened with towers and horses, and Livia's fire-oil kept from burning Coreria.
CHR-0197.fears: He fears Morhaven being named as the road of the fire-oil, and Velgrad's galleys raiding the coast in revenge.

CHR-0198.name: Aurelio II Falcone
CHR-0198.title: King
CHR-0198.looks: A sharp-eyed old king of 60 with keen Falcone sight, a clipped white beard and green glass shades against the noon glare.
CHR-0198.manner: Genial and cunning, he bargains with everyone, smiles at every offer and gives nothing away for free.
CHR-0198.wants: He wants to stay neutral in Tessaria and profit from both claimants, and to buy Nell Brine's sealed contract of 1011.
CHR-0198.fears: He fears Coreria burning and Velgrad and the Dawn Church naming Morhaven as the road the fire came by.

CHR-0199.name: Oriana Sabine
CHR-0199.title: Captain of the Santora Riders
CHR-0199.looks: A lean, hard-riding woman of 41 with wind-chapped cheeks, a steppe bow across her back and boots worn white at the knee.
CHR-0199.manner: Proud and competitive, she rides everywhere fast and cannot let a defeat go unanswered.
CHR-0199.wants: She wants to catch the oil caravans on the steppe road, and to win back her pride after Dorin Swiftarrow beat her in 1099.
CHR-0199.fears: She fears that catching the oil caravans will expose her own brother's skimming of the king's oil silver.

CHR-0200.name: Rico Ambro
CHR-0200.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0200.title: Master of Buckler Hall; Captain of the Exchange Guard
CHR-0200.looks: A compact, quick man of 42 with a buckler on his belt, a sword-nicked chin and a plain brown coat over mail.
CHR-0200.manner: Easy, joking and light on his feet, he laughs a lot and gambles far more than he should.
CHR-0200.wants: He wants his gambling debts to Adriano Carrano wiped out before anyone learns how he paid them.
CHR-0200.fears: He fears Cosimo Lunetti's perfect memory, which will one day connect the vault rota to him.

CHR-0201.name: Gerolt Marr
CHR-0201.title: Captain of the City
CHR-0201.looks: A grizzled, heavy-shouldered captain of 47 with a cropped grey beard, a crossbowman's scarred hands and a blue coat over mail.
CHR-0201.manner: Blunt and practical, he talks about pay before loyalty and keeps both his promises and his accounts.
CHR-0201.wants: He wants the Purple Company paid on time in good silver, and perhaps 1,000 of its men hired out to Queen Livia.
CHR-0201.fears: He fears the Purple Fair riot in June, and having to decide whom his men obey when the pay runs short.

CHR-0202.name: Adriano Carrano
CHR-0202.looks: A gaunt banker of 48 in a black cap, with sunken cheeks, a wax tablet in hand and the restless eyes of a ruined lender.
CHR-0202.manner: Bitter and clever, he speaks of law and debt with icy politeness and hates House Lunetti openly.
CHR-0202.wants: He wants House Lunetti broken and Tessaria made to pay the Carrano debt, by law or by riot.
CHR-0202.fears: He fears Cosimo Lunetti's memory, which forgets nothing and has outlasted every enemy so far.

CHR-0203.name: Beatrice Lunetti
CHR-0203.looks: A pale, composed young woman of 25 in a black banker's cap, with dark circles under her eyes and a wax tablet in hand.
CHR-0203.manner: Quiet and exact, she recites numbers from memory and rarely smiles, because she remembers every slight.
CHR-0203.wants: She wants the Purple Company's pay rolls kept in order, so the city's soldiers stay loyal through the Purple Fair.
CHR-0203.fears: She fears the black moods of her blood, which walked her father into the harbor in 1102.

CHR-0204.name: Oddo Pell
CHR-0204.title: Speaker of the Dyers
CHR-0204.looks: A fat, purple-fingered man of 56 with a heavy jaw, a dyer's stained hands and a fine green coat.
CHR-0204.manner: Pompous and nervous, he boasts of the purple trade and changes the subject whenever Sabena is mentioned.
CHR-0204.wants: He wants the Purple Fair to pass without a riot and the Murex Dyers' purple sold at the highest price.
CHR-0204.fears: He fears Mora Purplehand's march, since the dyers of Sabena still blame him for 1083.

CHR-0205.name: Enzo Sarto
CHR-0205.title: Master of the Vintners
CHR-0205.looks: A round, rosy lord of 54 with wine-red cheeks, a cheerful paunch and rings set with garnets.
CHR-0205.manner: Warm and jovial, he pours wine for everyone and counts votes behind every smile.
CHR-0205.wants: He wants to be on the winning side if Cosimo Lunetti falls, and his ships to keep passing the Strait unpaid.
CHR-0205.fears: He fears Blackreef learning that his ships slip past the dragon toll by a private deal with the Coyle kin.

CHR-0206.name: Paolo Treve
CHR-0206.looks: A tall, thin priest of 59 in white and gold, with a long, ascetic face and hands folded as if always at prayer.
CHR-0206.manner: Cool and courteous, he speaks of the Temple's interests as if they were the city's own.
CHR-0206.wants: He wants Ostra's money kept behind Queen Livia and the Holy See, and any deal with the Dawn Church stopped.
CHR-0206.fears: He fears the secret partition talks, which would cut both churches out of the Neck.

CHR-0207.name: Mora Purplehand
CHR-0207.looks: A tall, raw-boned woman of 36 with hands stained purple to the wrist and a voice that carries across the docks.
CHR-0207.manner: Bold and warm with her people and sharp with the Twelve, she speaks in short, angry sentences that crowds repeat.
CHR-0207.wants: She wants to march the Sabena Commons on the Exchange at the Purple Fair and win them a council seat and fair bread.
CHR-0207.fears: She fears Gerolt Marr's Purple Company turning the march into a massacre.

CHR-0208.name: Cosimo Lunetti
CHR-0208.title: First Banker
CHR-0208.looks: A spare, tired man of 51 in a black banker's cap and a purple-ringed robe, with sleepless eyes that rarely blink.
CHR-0208.manner: Quiet and exact, he quotes debts, dates and faces from years past without notes and never raises his voice.
CHR-0208.wants: He wants the partition of the Neck signed by Livia's and Andros's envoys before 1 May, and his gold expedition up the Tirana.
CHR-0208.fears: He fears his own memory and the black moods it brings, which walked him into the harbor in 1102.

CHR-0209.name: Brisa Blacktooth
CHR-0209.looks: A big, scarred half-orc woman of 34 with one blackened tusk, a docker's shoulders and a cudgel at her hip.
CHR-0209.manner: Gruff and sly, she speaks little, watches the harbor at night and sells what she sees to the highest bidder.
CHR-0209.wants: She wants a fortune for what she knows about the night chests before the Purple Fair turns Ostra upside down.
CHR-0209.fears: She fears Marco Vanni's Night Watch, who drown people who know too much about the front house.

CHR-0210.name: Lazzaro Fenn
CHR-0210.looks: A neat, soft-handed man of 40 with a bald head, burn marks from the casting pot and a leather apron.
CHR-0210.manner: Polite and unhurried, he speaks of coin dies like works of art and of their use like none of his business.
CHR-0210.wants: He wants Andros's envoy to buy his dies for Queen Livia's coin at a price that lets him leave Ostra.
CHR-0210.fears: He fears the Lunetti money-changers, who would know a false Tessarian coin at a glance.

CHR-0211.name: Lupo Varga
CHR-0211.looks: A lean, hard-eyed man of 38 with a broken nose, a long knife and a debt-collector's ledger tied to his belt.
CHR-0211.manner: Patient and menacing, he speaks softly about money owed and never forgets a face or a promise.
CHR-0211.wants: He wants Jory Flint kept in Madara, sober and at hand, until Cosimo Lunetti's expedition is ready.
CHR-0211.fears: He fears losing Jory to Admiral Salvi's agent or to Queen Livia's better offer, and answering for it to…

CHR-0212.name: Lorin the Lamplighter
CHR-0212.looks: A thin, wiry man of 33 with soot-blackened hands, a lamplighter's long pole and a scarred, grinning face.
CHR-0212.manner: Restless and reckless, he talks of seizing things instead of asking for them and mocks Mora's caution.
CHR-0212.wants: He wants the Sabena Commons to seize the Sabena Citadel at the Purple Fair rather than march on the Exchange.
CHR-0212.fears: He fears that a peaceful march will end in broken heads like 1083, with nothing won.

CHR-0213.name: Elthas Moonwell
CHR-0213.looks: A tall, slender elf of 230 who looks a calm forty, with silver-streaked dark hair, long cool hands and a physician's satchel.
CHR-0213.manner: Gentle and unhurried, he speaks the human tongue slowly and listens to heartbeats as carefully as to words.
CHR-0213.wants: He wants Cosimo Lunetti kept alive through a year of heavy debts and black moods.
CHR-0213.fears: He fears another of Cosimo's black moods, and that next time no one will reach the harbor in time.

CHR-0214.name: Chiara Linden
CHR-0214.looks: A neat, quiet young woman of 24 with ink-stained cuffs, a plain brown dress and her father's long, thin face.
CHR-0214.manner: Shy and careful, she says little, works long hours and watches her teachers when they think no one is looking.
CHR-0214.wants: She wants to find what the Ledger School's books hide about the partition talks and the dragon's fifth.
CHR-0214.fears: She fears being found out as a Luminary's daughter, and as a spy among the Ledger School's students.

CHR-0215.name: Fausto Renn
CHR-0215.looks: A pale, stooped clerk of 43 with ink-stained fingers, thinning hair and a black clerk's cap pulled low.
CHR-0215.manner: Meek and polite, he bows to everyone and sweats whenever anyone looks at his satchel.
CHR-0215.wants: He wants the whole partition draft copied and handed to Lidia Marek before Lantern Night, 2 February.
CHR-0215.fears: He fears Cosimo Lunetti's memory, which may already have noticed papers out of their order.

CHR-0216.name: Petar Grell
CHR-0216.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0216.looks: A strong, grey-templed knight of 47 with a red dawn badge and small white scars on the outer edge of each hand.
CHR-0216.manner: Gruff and patient, he teaches the Six-Finger Rein Grip to Tessaran riders though he cannot use it himself.
CHR-0216.wants: He wants to remain a plain lance-master at Calossa and stay out of his royal cousins' war over the crown.
CHR-0216.fears: He fears that someone will read the scars on his hands and make him a pawn of the claimants.

CHR-0217.name: Corvin Asterio
CHR-0217.title: Commander of the queen's field army
CHR-0217.looks: A hard, lean soldier of 59 with a close grey beard, a gold sun badge on faded imperial green and old scars on his forearms.
CHR-0217.manner: Gruff and careful, he speaks like a man who has fought the same war for 44 years and expects to die in it.
CHR-0217.wants: He wants the Reef Crossbows kept on the queen's side and paid by Return Day, so he can retake Doria.
CHR-0217.fears: He fears Velgrad's toll-keepers on the Neck road finding the copper carts and proving him a traitor.

CHR-0218.name: Hektor Wain
CHR-0218.looks: A thick-set carter of 51 with a weathered face, a whip-scarred hand and a sheepskin coat that smells of oxen.
CHR-0218.manner: Cheerful and unbothered, he talks about roads, mud and axle grease and never about what is in his carts.
CHR-0218.wants: He wants the copper runs north to keep paying, whichever claimant ends up on the throne.
CHR-0218.fears: He fears Velgrad's toll-keepers, who search wagons on the Neck road more closely every month.

CHR-0219.name: Irene Stoll
CHR-0219.looks: A broad, short woman of 43 with copper-green stains on her hands, a miner's leather cap and a hard, square face.
CHR-0219.manner: Plain and protective, she speaks for her miners first and bargains hard with lords who want her silence.
CHR-0219.wants: She wants her miners paid in Ostran silver rather than the queen's Leontines, and the copper road kept open.
CHR-0219.fears: She fears her miners talking about the missing carts, and the queen's men hanging the wrong people.

CHR-0220.name: Basil Ordane
CHR-0220.looks: A tall, heavy man of 55 with a greying black beard, a red dawn badge and rings he has pledged but not yet lost.
CHR-0220.manner: Confident and blunt, he speaks for the northern lords and treats every compromise as cowardice.
CHR-0220.wants: He wants Andros on the throne at Tessar, the seized Temple lands kept, and the Dawn Church made the realm's church.
CHR-0220.fears: He fears his debt of 40,000 marks to Zoran Koren, for which half of Calossa is pledged.

CHR-0221.name: Cassia Mentis
CHR-0221.looks: A slim, grey-haired woman of 52 in faded imperial green, with mint-stained fingers and a sharp, tired face.
CHR-0221.manner: Precise and discreet, she speaks in careful half-sentences and never writes down what she can keep in her head.
CHR-0221.wants: She wants the partition of the Neck signed with Milos Ternak at Ostra before Andros marches after 1 May.
CHR-0221.fears: She fears the churches learning of the Ostran drafts, which could unlight both claimants.

CHR-0222.name: Bogdan of Tessar
CHR-0222.looks: A stout, white-bearded priest of 63 with a red dawn stole hidden under a plain cloak and a calm, smiling face.
CHR-0222.manner: Gentle and patient, he blesses Temple men and Dawn men alike and keeps his true loyalty behind his smile.
CHR-0222.wants: He wants Tessar's East Gate postern opened to Andros from inside, and the physician's tablets brought from Solenne.
CHR-0222.fears: He fears Queen Livia's guards finding Olivar's second ledger in his library before he can use it.

CHR-0223.name: Nikos Tessaran
CHR-0223.title: Captain of the Dawn Lances
CHR-0223.looks: A tall, dark young prince of 27 with six fingers on each hand, a red dawn badge on his mail and a lance-scarred shield.
CHR-0223.manner: Bold and impatient, he leads from the front and speaks of the war as a contest he means to win.
CHR-0223.wants: He wants to raid toward Tessar this winter and find Queen Livia's 60 jars of fire-oil before they reach Coreria.
CHR-0223.fears: He fears his father's winter camp at Coreria burning in the night with the army asleep inside.

CHR-0224.name: Vesna Sevrin
CHR-0224.looks: A tall, broad-shouldered woman of 49, big-boned like all Sevrins, with grey-blond braids and red Velgrad embroidery at her collar.
CHR-0224.manner: Warm and dignified in public, she listens closely in council and writes long letters home every week.
CHR-0224.wants: She wants Velgrad's interests served at Andros's court, and the secret partition talks exposed through Milos Ternak.
CHR-0224.fears: She fears having to choose between her husband and her brother if the Ostran drafts reach Velgrad.

CHR-0225.name: Andros Tessaran
CHR-0225.title: Dawn-crowned king
CHR-0225.looks: A broad, grey-bearded man of 57 with six fingers on each hand, a red dawn badge on faded imperial green and a weathered face.
CHR-0225.manner: Patient and calculating, he speaks softly, buys what he cannot take, and lets others boast for him.
CHR-0225.wants: He wants to march on Tessar after 1 May with 13,000 men and siege towers, unless the Ostran partition gives him the north for good.
CHR-0225.fears: He fears Patriarch Kirill unlighting him if word of the secret partition talks at Ostra reaches Velgrad.

CHR-0226.name: Livia Tessaran
CHR-0226.title: Temple-crowned queen
CHR-0226.looks: A thin, upright queen of 64 with six fingers on each ringed hand, white hair under a gold circlet and a sharp, hollow-cheeked face.
CHR-0226.manner: Cold, proud and decisive, she speaks briefly, trusts few, and has outlasted every enemy for 44 years.
CHR-0226.wants: She wants Andros's winter camp at Coreria burned with fire-oil and the war won outright before her money runs out.
CHR-0226.fears: She fears her hired companies walking away, since they are owed about 90,000 suns a month and only half paid.

CHR-0227.name: Silas Vane
CHR-0227.title: Master of Engines
CHR-0227.looks: A wiry, white-haired engineer of 68 with burn-speckled hands, a measuring cord at his belt and sharp, squinting eyes.
CHR-0227.manner: Dry and exact, he speaks in distances and weights and treats war as a problem of angles.
CHR-0227.wants: He wants to carry 40 jars of fire-oil to Coreria in late March and burn Prince Andros's winter camp.
CHR-0227.fears: He fears Prince Nikos finding the oil cellars before the jars leave Tessar.

CHR-0228.name: Luka of Lorino
CHR-0228.looks: A stocky, flour-dusted baker of 43 with oven burns on his forearms and grief lines around his eyes.
CHR-0228.manner: Quiet and polite at his ovens, he turns hard and cold whenever the Grey Hand is mentioned.
CHR-0228.wants: He wants Oren Vask of the Grey Hand dead for the sack of Lorino, and silver from the camp map to pay for it.
CHR-0228.fears: He fears the map he sold will burn innocent cooks and bakers along with Andros's soldiers at Coreria.

CHR-0229.name: Oren Vask
CHR-0229.looks: A grizzled, one-eared mercenary of 59 with a grey glove on one hand, a scarred face and a satchel he sleeps on.
CHR-0229.manner: Sly and boastful, he speaks of old sacks as good business and of every buyer as an old friend.
CHR-0229.wants: He wants to sell Queen Livia's written leave to sack Lorino to whoever pays the most.
CHR-0229.fears: He fears Luka of Lorino and Simeon Hark, who both hunt him for the same letter for different reasons.

CHR-0230.name: Helena Tessaran
CHR-0230.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0230.title: Captain of the Queen's Six-Fingers
CHR-0230.looks: A lean, hard woman of 36 with six fingers on each hand, one fingertip missing, and lips that grey after a hard bout.
CHR-0230.manner: Fierce and controlled, she speaks little and watches Andros's men with open hatred.
CHR-0230.wants: She wants Livia's fire-oil kept safe from Prince Nikos's winter raid until it leaves for Coreria.
CHR-0230.fears: She fears her weak Tessaran heart stopping in front of her guard if a fight runs past the third minute.

CHR-0231.name: Simeon Hark
CHR-0231.looks: A lean, sharp-nosed man of 38 with a travelling merchant's plain cloak, a hidden knife and tired, watchful eyes.
CHR-0231.manner: Smooth, patient and cold, he bargains like a merchant and lies like a courtier.
CHR-0231.wants: He wants the queen's old letter taken back from Oren Vask before it is sold, and Luka's camp map in Silas Vane's hands.
CHR-0231.fears: He fears the letter reaching Patriarch Bogdan or Velgrad before he can recover it.

CHR-0232.name: Milos Ternak
CHR-0232.looks: A tall, stooped clerk of 41 with ink-stained fingers, a mild face and a plain brown travelling coat.
CHR-0232.manner: Careful and courteous, he speaks like a scribe and listens like a merchant.
CHR-0232.wants: He wants the partition of the Neck signed with Lady Cassia Mentis at Ostra before Andros marches after 1 May.
CHR-0232.fears: He fears the men who follow him through Ostra's streets, not knowing they are Princess Vesna's.

CHR-0233.name: Bett Tarhand
CHR-0233.looks: A bent, leathery woman of 55 with tar-black hands, a gold burial earring and a caulking iron in her belt.
CHR-0233.manner: Salty and blunt, she curses captains to their faces and remembers every ship she has ever tarred.
CHR-0233.wants: She wants her caulkers paid in full at Share Day and the captains kept honest.
CHR-0233.fears: She fears the young captains voting Nell Brine out and dragging the Brotherhood back to open raiding.

CHR-0234.name: Ima Redsail
CHR-0234.title: Captain of the Redsails
CHR-0234.looks: A tall, sun-blackened woman of 34 with red-dyed braids, Varennan blue silk over mail and a gold earring in each ear.
CHR-0234.manner: Loud, bold and mocking, she laughs at the Table's caution and promises her crews open raiding again.
CHR-0234.wants: She wants to vote Nell Brine out at Share Day, stop paying Lucerna its fifth and return to open raiding.
CHR-0234.fears: She fears Nell's sworn men moving against her before the vote.

CHR-0235.name: Jonas Keel
CHR-0235.looks: A thin, sun-browned man of 46 with a scholar's face, a pirate's gold earring and a quartermaster's ledger chained to his wrist.
CHR-0235.manner: Careful and wry, he talks like a clerk among wolves and counts every coin aloud.
CHR-0235.wants: He wants his page of the share-book kept safe in Greyhaven, as insurance if the Brotherhood turns on him.
CHR-0235.fears: He fears Nell Brine or Ima Redsail learning that he sent a page of the share-book out of Blackreef.

CHR-0236.name: Sten the Quiet
CHR-0236.title: Oil-Keeper of Ratrock; master of the Raft Yard
CHR-0236.looks: A silent, burn-scarred man of 41 with no eyebrows, a soot-grey face and hands that always smell of pitch and oil.
CHR-0236.manner: He almost never speaks, answers with nods, and watches everything with flat, patient eyes.
CHR-0236.wants: He wants to find the stolen fire-oil jar himself before Sabra's oil-master counts the empties and notices.
CHR-0236.fears: He fears Qasim Nafari's count, which will show a jar missing from the Ratrock caves on his watch.

CHR-0237.name: Wystan Coyle
CHR-0237.title: Toll-Master of the Strait
CHR-0237.looks: A heavy, smiling man of 49 with gold rings in both ears, a toll-master's tally board and a stolen Lucernan red coat.
CHR-0237.manner: Jovial and greedy, he counts the lights on passing ships and smiles while he decides what each will pay.
CHR-0237.wants: He wants the dragon toll flowing, his private skim untouched and the Sarto deal kept quiet.
CHR-0237.fears: He fears Lark Shoalwise, whose father drowned at the Drowning Post for Coyle's own skimming.

CHR-0238.name: Brann Hollow
CHR-0238.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0238.title: Captain of the Reef Crossbows
CHR-0238.looks: A rangy, sunburnt crossbow captain of 38 with a gold burial earring, a heavy windlass crossbow and a scar across his nose.
CHR-0238.manner: Practical and hard-bargaining, he speaks for his 800 like a guild master and never forgets an unpaid day.
CHR-0238.wants: He wants his men's half-year pay from Queen Livia by Return Day, or a better contract from someone else.
CHR-0238.fears: He fears his men walking off with their arms after 60 days unpaid, and taking his good name with them.

CHR-0239.name: Rafe Hookhand
CHR-0239.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0239.looks: A wiry, rope-scarred man of 36 with a boarding hook at each hip, rope-burned palms and a short, heavy blade.
CHR-0239.manner: Restless and cheerful, he climbs rigging for fun and teaches with shouts, slaps and laughter.
CHR-0239.wants: He wants the Dice Yard's boarders ready for Varenna's fleet, which will come for Blackreef after Sea Opening.
CHR-0239.fears: He fears the Lion Fleet's marines catching his boarders in open water with no hull to climb.

CHR-0240.name: Tam Oarsman
CHR-0240.title: Leader of the Freed Oars
CHR-0240.looks: A huge half-orc of 30 with oar-callused hands, galley-chain scars on his ankles and a shaved scalp.
CHR-0240.manner: Slow-spoken and stubborn, he speaks for the freed rowers in plain words and never raises his voice.
CHR-0240.wants: He wants galley slavery ended and a seat at the Captains' Table for the freedmen of the Freed Oars.
CHR-0240.fears: He fears the young captains' return to open raiding, which would fill the rowing benches with slaves again.

CHR-0241.name: Nell Brine
CHR-0241.title: Captain-General
CHR-0241.looks: A weathered, square-built woman of 43 with salt-white braids, captain's gold earrings and a rolling walk that sways on land.
CHR-0241.manner: Calm and businesslike, she runs piracy like a toll company and speaks of raids as accounts to be settled.
CHR-0241.wants: She wants to keep her seat at Share Day and sell King Aurelio the sealed contract of 1011 without the Table's leave.
CHR-0241.fears: She fears Ima Redsail's vote at Share Day, and the land-sickness that keeps her off the quays.

CHR-0242.name: Urka Saltjaw
CHR-0242.looks: A tall, heavy-boned orc woman of 24 with grey-green skin, copper-capped tusks and a salt-crusted leather jerkin.
CHR-0242.manner: Loud and fearless, she laughs during boarding fights and speaks in short, cheerful threats.
CHR-0242.wants: She wants a captain's share of the loot and one day a ship of her own, which Ima Redsail promises the bold.
CHR-0242.fears: She fears long, hot days at the oars, since orcs tire quickly and suffer in the southern sun.

CHR-0243.name: Grusk Tallyman
CHR-0243.looks: A stout half-orc of 32 with short tusks, ink-stained fingers and a tally board he carries to every meeting.
CHR-0243.manner: Humble and agreeable, he keeps the counts at Nell's table and seems far too dull to notice anything.
CHR-0243.wants: He wants Ima Redsail to win the Captains' Table at Share Day and reward him with a captain's share.
CHR-0243.fears: He fears Nell's sworn men discovering who has been feeding Ima her secrets.

CHR-0244.name: Lark Shoalwise
CHR-0244.looks: A slight, quick young man of 28 with sun-bleached hair, sharp eyes for water and a knotted sounding line.
CHR-0244.manner: Nervous and clever, he talks fast about tides and shoals and goes silent whenever anyone mentions his father.
CHR-0244.wants: He wants to sell the stamped Sabran jar to Qadir's Master of Doors at Sea Opening and leave Blackreef forever.
CHR-0244.fears: He fears Sten the Quiet, who may already know the jar is missing.

CHR-0245.name: Jory Flint
CHR-0245.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0245.looks: A gaunt young man of 29 with burn-scarred hands, haunted eyes and a drinker's tremor he hides in his sleeves.
CHR-0245.manner: Jumpy and bitter, he drinks too much, laughs at nothing and goes very quiet when he hears wings.
CHR-0245.wants: He wants to sell his second map to Queen Livia for more than Cosimo paid, and get out of Madara alive.
CHR-0245.fears: He fears going back up the Tirana, where the Red Widow killed the men of 1097 around him.

CHR-0246.name: Brokk Gravelbeard
CHR-0246.looks: A grizzled, wiry dwarf of 154 with a grey beard tied in a knot, wet boots and a gold-pan slung on his back.
CHR-0246.manner: Gruff and secretive, he speaks little to anyone and nothing at all about where he goes at night.
CHR-0246.wants: He wants as much Tirana gold as he can pan by night before Cosimo Lunetti's expedition arrives.
CHR-0246.fears: He fears the Red Widow's dawn flights, which is why he works the gravels only in the dark.

CHR-0247.name: Rakka Blackmane
CHR-0247.looks: A tall, black-maned orc woman of 32 with silver-capped tusks, a war-axe and an old contract in a leather tube.
CHR-0247.manner: Proud and fierce, she speaks bluntly and reminds everyone, often, that Queen Livia still owes her.
CHR-0247.wants: She wants the Madara bridge in her hands, so that every expedition up the Tirana must pay her to cross.
CHR-0247.fears: She fears her band breaking up from hunger before Queen Livia pays the old contract.

CHR-0248.name: Marek Ferryman
CHR-0248.looks: A handsome, flashy man of 38 with a curled beard, a faded imperial green cloak and rings too fine for his boots.
CHR-0248.manner: Grand and theatrical, he speaks of his imperial ancestors as if he had known them personally.
CHR-0248.wants: He wants Queen Livia to recognize his imperial blood and answer the letter he sent her in 1104.
CHR-0248.fears: He fears the Marchfolk family he paid 40 suns telling anyone where his famous ancestry came from.

CHR-0249.name: Lirien Duskwater
CHR-0249.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0249.looks: A tall, long-armed elf of 284 in a dark grey cloak and light mail, with a burn scar across one shoulder blade.
CHR-0249.manner: Cold, counting and quiet, she watches a swordsman's feet for two passes before she says a word.
CHR-0249.wants: She wants to be paid in full for scouting Cosimo Lunetti's expedition up the Tirana, by whichever paymaster she chooses.
CHR-0249.fears: She has trusted no pay chest since Madara in 1045, and fears being left unpaid again.

CHR-0250.name: Ragnfrid Gatebreaker
CHR-0250.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0250.looks: A scarred, grey-braided giant of 59, nearly 4 m tall, in patched walrus leather with a heavy maul over her shoulder.
CHR-0250.manner: Grim and few-worded, she sits apart from humans and speaks of Hrimfell only with longing.
CHR-0250.wants: She wants to go home to Valdhall, but the Truce of Dobin names her for punishment if she returns.
CHR-0250.fears: She fears the heat of the Free Marches' summers, and dying far from the cold and her kin.

CHR-0251.name: Caelan Farstep
CHR-0251.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0251.looks: A lean, weathered elf of 224 in faded green travelling leathers, with a map-case on his back and frost-burned cheeks.
CHR-0251.manner: Calm and curious, he speaks slowly, sketches as he listens and treats every mountain as an old friend.
CHR-0251.wants: He wants to carry Brother Pema's diary safely from Moonstair to Skyhold when the snow allows in May or June.
CHR-0251.fears: He fears Steward Sonam's guards searching him at the sickroom door and burning the diary.

CHR-0252.name: Grena Mossfoot
CHR-0252.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0252.looks: A lean half-orc woman of 36 with olive skin, short tusks, a moss-green cloak and a hunting bow.
CHR-0252.manner: Quiet and wry, she moves softly, talks little and trades news the way merchants trade salt.
CHR-0252.wants: She wants a good season of hunting on the Tirana banks without being caught between rival expeditions.
CHR-0252.fears: She fears the Red Widow, whose dawn flights over the Tirana she has learned to read and avoid.

CHR-0253.name: Corwin Saltmarsh
CHR-0253.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0253.looks: A sun-cured, sinewy man of 38 with a fever-yellowed face, a salt-stained hat and a map-tube slung across his back.
CHR-0253.manner: Easygoing and mercenary, he tells wild tales of the island's interior and always ends with a price.
CHR-0253.wants: He wants to sell his map of the Isle of Pearls' interior to whichever court pays more before the April landing.
CHR-0253.fears: He fears being seized by one court before the other has bid, and losing the map for nothing.

CHR-0254.name: Mirel the Bowyer
CHR-0254.looks: A slim, sharp-eyed elf of 174 with brown hair tied back, resin-stained fingers and a nettle-linen smock full of yew shavings.
CHR-0254.manner: Brisk and proud of her craft, she flexes a stave once and names its draw weight before anyone asks.
CHR-0254.wants: She wants the smuggled staves in her yard carted south before anyone in the Moot counts what she holds.
CHR-0254.fears: She fears the Keepers learning that her yard takes staves from the exile Sariel Thornwise.

CHR-0255.name: Aelar the Silent
CHR-0255.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0255.title: Master of the Starlight Range of Lirith
CHR-0255.looks: A lean, quiet elf of 244 in a grey-green cloak, with two stiff fingers on his left hand and a dark Lirith yew bow.
CHR-0255.manner: He almost never speaks, gives orders by hand sign, and is patient past the point of boredom.
CHR-0255.wants: He wants the Silent ready to shoot by starlight if the Oak Line breaks again this year.
CHR-0255.fears: He fears a starless night when the Silent are needed, because he will not shoot at what he cannot see.

CHR-0256.name: Veyla of the Quickened
CHR-0256.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0256.title: Swordmaster of the Moot, head of the Queen's Quickened
CHR-0256.looks: A slender, upright elf of 234 with a thin thrusting sword, an axe scar across the back of her right hand and very still eyes.
CHR-0256.manner: Hard and exact, she speaks in short sentences and moves only when she means to.
CHR-0256.wants: She wants Queen Ithrien's door guarded through the heir quarrel, and every Quickened carrier kept off night patrol.
CHR-0256.fears: She fears anyone in the Moot learning what torchlight and flickering flame do to the Quickened blood.

CHR-0257.name: Calithil Lightfoot
CHR-0257.title: Ranger-Captain of Sylvaran, head of the Edge Wardens
CHR-0257.looks: A slight, light-footed elf of 323 in a grey cloak and deer-hide shoes, with a coil of rope and a face painted with bark ash.
CHR-0257.manner: Quick and decisive where the Moot is slow, he speaks bluntly and is often gone before the others answer.
CHR-0257.wants: He wants Dunstan Cole's cutters warned three times and then killed openly under the seventh clause in March.
CHR-0257.fears: He fears a single mace blow, since his light Lightfoot bones would shatter where another elf would only…

CHR-0258.name: Caerwen Honeyhand
CHR-0258.looks: A plump, warm-faced elf of 144 with honey-brown hair, beeswax on her fingers and a smock that smells of the hives.
CHR-0258.manner: Kind, chatty and practical, she talks about bees, candles and her daughter's wanderings in the same breath.
CHR-0258.wants: She wants the Wax Circle's candles and honey sold well, and her restless daughter Aelis home and safe.
CHR-0258.fears: She fears her daughter's friendships at the forest's edge will bring trouble on them both.

CHR-0259.name: Elowen Brightleaf
CHR-0259.looks: A tall, graceful elf of 224 with pale gold hair, a green nettle-linen gown and an intense, searching gaze.
CHR-0259.manner: Passionate and persuasive, she speaks in the Moot about change, which most elves find almost indecent.
CHR-0259.wants: She wants to force a Moot vote at Leaf Fall 1105 so that Thalion Halfleaf, the queen's half-elf grandson, may inherit.
CHR-0259.fears: She fears the Deep Root keeping the old law whole, as it kept her half-elf son Rhun outside it, even in his…

CHR-0260.name: Thalanor of Fenali
CHR-0260.title: Warden of the Oak Line
CHR-0260.looks: A tall, stern elf of 254 with iron-grey hair, a warden's grey cloak and a staff carved with boundary marks.
CHR-0260.manner: Cool and secretive, he prefers hints to orders and lets the forest seem to do his killing.
CHR-0260.wants: He wants Dunstan Cole's cutters dealt with quietly, so their deaths look like the forest's own doing.
CHR-0260.fears: He fears Eldergrove fir building Aldmark's Cold Bay fleet and arming the axe that crossed the Oak Line.

CHR-0261.name: Arannel the Eldest Keeper
CHR-0261.looks: An ancient, silver-haired elf of 402 with a deeply lined face, bark-brown robes and hands stained by the First Oak's soil.
CHR-0261.manner: Slow, grave and certain, she speaks as if every word must last a thousand years.
CHR-0261.wants: She wants the old law kept whole at the Leaf Fall Moot and Calithil Lightfoot named heir instead of Thalion.
CHR-0261.fears: She fears fire in the Evenwood, which is why the Keepers have marked 40 km of firebreak around Evenglade.

CHR-0262.name: Ithrien the Oakborn
CHR-0262.title: Queen
CHR-0262.looks: A tall, straight-backed elf queen of 586 with silver hair, a narrow Stonehold sword and a left hand she keeps very still.
CHR-0262.manner: Calm to the point of coldness, she reads a speaker's whole body before she answers and wastes no words.
CHR-0262.wants: She wants the Moot to vote on the heir by Leaf Fall, and gave Thalion his father's green-stone ring to show where she stands.
CHR-0262.fears: She fears nothing for herself and everything for the forest, which will have no lawful heir when she dies.

CHR-0263.name: Faelwen the Chronicler
CHR-0263.looks: A small, bright-eyed elf of 314 with ink-dark fingers, ash-brown hair in a scholar's knot and tree-ring slices on a cord.
CHR-0263.manner: Precise and eager, she talks about rings and years with delight and grows impatient with careless counting.
CHR-0263.wants: She wants the Grove Count set beside Serra's proof so cleanly that no priest can ever deny it.
CHR-0263.fears: She fears the Temple's envoy reaching Silverbough and burning Queen Saelith's copy of Serra's proof.

CHR-0264.name: Naeris Seedfall
CHR-0264.looks: A small, earth-stained elf of 362 with grey-green eyes, pockets full of acorns and hands cracked from planting.
CHR-0264.manner: Gentle and slow, she talks to saplings as warmly as to people and keeps her opinions under her breath.
CHR-0264.wants: She wants the Moot to learn that Thalion has a birth tree at the right moment, and no sooner.
CHR-0264.fears: She fears the Deep Root cutting Thalion's birth tree if they learn of it before the vote.

CHR-0265.name: Sariel Thornwise
CHR-0265.looks: A lean, hard-faced elf of 183 with cropped dark hair, an exile's patched leathers and a yew-cutter's hatchet.
CHR-0265.manner: Bitter and mocking, she sneers at the Moot and trusts only coin and her own feet.
CHR-0265.wants: She wants to sell Lady Ysolde Ravenscar the list of Eastern Edge tree stands for enough silver to vanish.
CHR-0265.fears: She fears Calithil Lightfoot's rangers finding her before the sale is done.

CHR-0267.name: Vaelor the Unhurried
CHR-0267.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0267.looks: A tall, long-armed elf of 416, grey at the temples, in a plain grey-green coat with a sword ground thin as a leaf.
CHR-0267.manner: Patient past all reason, he stands still and silent for minutes, then says something brief and exact.
CHR-0267.wants: He wants to teach the Before-Thought Cut to Thalion Halfleaf before the Moot votes at Leaf Fall.
CHR-0267.fears: He fears torchlight and has not fought by it since the night in 877 his master died.

CHR-0268.name: Aeron of the Quickened
CHR-0268.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0268.title: Second of the Queen's Quickened
CHR-0268.looks: A slim young elf of 114 with his mother's still eyes, a thin thrusting sword and a light mail shirt on guard duty.
CHR-0268.manner: Eager and serious, he copies his mother's clipped speech and watches Vaelor's every move.
CHR-0268.wants: He wants to become good enough to make Vaelor work, as only his mother can.
CHR-0268.fears: He fears the flickering light that sets off fits in Quickened blood, and has never stood watch by torchlight.

CHR-0269.name: Faelan Ashgrove
CHR-0269.title: Wood-captain of the southern ranger posts
CHR-0269.looks: A lean, sun-darkened elf of 199 with a bark-ash painted face, light mail under a brown cloak and a long Lirith bow.
CHR-0269.manner: Steady and practical, he speaks plainly to his rangers and follows Thalanor's hints without asking for orders.
CHR-0269.wants: He wants his 800 rangers on the southern posts ready if Aldmark or its outlaws cross the stones this spring.
CHR-0269.fears: He fears a second cutting at Foxhurst turning into the border war of 1078 all over again.

CHR-0271.name: Aelis Farwander
CHR-0271.looks: A young, restless elf of 63 with wind-tangled brown hair, a wanderer's patched cloak and a bright, curious face.
CHR-0271.manner: Friendly and impulsive, she talks to humans and orcs at the forest's edge as if borders did not exist.
CHR-0271.wants: She wants to travel beyond the Evenwood and see the human lands her mother fears.
CHR-0271.fears: She fears her mother learning what she showed a human traveller in 1103.

CHR-0272.name: Wystan Reed
CHR-0272.looks: A broad, plain-faced carter of 38 with a licensed hauler's brass token, a leather jerkin and an ox-goad.
CHR-0272.manner: Quiet and incurious on purpose, he answers questions about his loads with a shrug.
CHR-0272.wants: He wants steady hauling work and his license kept, whatever lies under the canvas.
CHR-0272.fears: He fears losing his license, or worse, if the Moot ever looks closely at his carts.

CHR-0273.name: Merion Softhand
CHR-0273.looks: A gentle, round-shouldered elf of 284 with soft hands, a satchel of herbs and the sad face of a healer who once came too late.
CHR-0273.manner: Soft-voiced and careful, he listens more than he speaks and keeps the secrets of every body he has treated.
CHR-0273.wants: He wants the queen's failing hand and young Aeron's fit kept quiet until each can safely be told.
CHR-0273.fears: He fears coming too late again, as he did for Prince Caelan in 1036.

CHR-0274.name: Rhovan Greyleaf
CHR-0274.looks: A lean, grey-cloaked elf of 174 with a bark-ash painted face, a light bow and eyes that never stop moving.
CHR-0274.manner: Quiet and patient, he speaks in counts and distances and can lie still in a tree for a whole day.
CHR-0274.wants: He wants to keep trading counts of Aldmark's army with his orc contact at the dead oak every new moon.
CHR-0274.fears: He fears Ravenscar finding the dead oak, which would brand him a traitor who talks with the old enemy.

CHR-0275.name: Elandor the Steady
CHR-0275.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0275.title: Master of the Sea-Archers' Yard
CHR-0275.looks: A broad-shouldered elf of 124 in oiled grey wool, with salt-roughened hands, gull-feathered arrows and a sailor's steady stance.
CHR-0275.manner: Calm and plain-spoken, he says little on land and gives sharp, sure commands on a pitching deck.
CHR-0275.wants: He wants new longships for his Sea-Archers, not more of Corin Saltleaf's merchant cogs.
CHR-0275.fears: He fears Eldergrove fir going to build Aldmark's Cold Bay fleet while his own archers lack decks.

CHR-0276.name: Tavor Greywave
CHR-0276.title: Fleet-Warden
CHR-0276.looks: A tall, weathered elf of 164 with sea-grey eyes, silver rings in his ears and a Fleet-Warden's blue cloak of oiled wool.
CHR-0276.manner: Proud and formal, he speaks of the fleet as his family's honor and changes the subject when money comes up.
CHR-0276.wants: He wants the fleet at sea by Sea Opening, and his nine cogs earning enough to clear his Lunetti debt.
CHR-0276.fears: He fears House Lunetti calling in the 30,000 suns he owes on nine cogs.

CHR-0277.name: Brannoc the Shipwright
CHR-0277.looks: A big, grey-bearded human shipwright of 53 with an adze over his shoulder, sawdust in his hair and an oiled wool coat.
CHR-0277.manner: Gruff and practical, he talks to elves and humans alike in the plain language of timber.
CHR-0277.wants: He wants Corin Saltleaf's new cogs finished before anyone asks where the fir came from.
CHR-0277.fears: He fears Ilmar Seawatch, who knows whose boats cut the fir for his yard.

CHR-0278.name: Corin Saltleaf
CHR-0278.looks: A sleek half-elf of 64 who looks forty, with salt-and-pepper hair, merchant's rings and a harbor-master's brass whistle.
CHR-0278.manner: Smooth and energetic, he talks trade and open harbors with every visitor and listens for the price beneath.
CHR-0278.wants: He wants 400 fir masts delivered to Aldmark's Cold Bay fleet, and Eldergrove's harbors opened to more trade.
CHR-0278.fears: He fears Sylvaran seeing Eldergrove fir arm the axe that crossed the Oak Line, and the council turning on him.

CHR-0279.name: Wenna Netmaker
CHR-0279.looks: A sturdy half-elf woman of 46 with net-scarred hands, a sealskin coat and salt crusted in her dark braid.
CHR-0279.manner: Plain and stubborn, she speaks for the fishers of Ithira and hates owing anybody anything.
CHR-0279.wants: She wants to sell her hall's herring and seal to Coldhaven without paying Saltleaf ships to carry them.
CHR-0279.fears: She fears another failed herring year like 1101, which would sink her hall deeper into Saltleaf's debt.

CHR-0280.name: Maelis of Aelorn
CHR-0280.looks: A handsome, well-dressed elf of 204 with dark hair braided with silver, a yew-wood staff and fine blue wool.
CHR-0280.manner: Courteous and careful, he speaks smoothly of trade and changes the subject whenever the council is mentioned.
CHR-0280.wants: He wants the yew trade with Ashmere to keep paying, whatever Ashmere does with the staves after the wedding.
CHR-0280.fears: He fears Nerys the Sea Keeper refusing the Keeper's mark to his Yew Ridges, which would ruin House Aelorn.

CHR-0281.name: Nerys the Sea Keeper
CHR-0281.looks: A tall, stern elf of 344 with sea-grey hair, a Keeper's grey robe embroidered with waves and a driftwood staff.
CHR-0281.manner: Solemn and unbending, she speaks of the old forests as if they were wounded kin.
CHR-0281.wants: She wants the old split with Sylvaran healed, and no more yew sold to realms that might ally with Aldmark.
CHR-0281.fears: She fears Eldergrove yew and fir arming Aldmark against their Sylvaran cousins.

CHR-0282.name: Ilvara Mistwalker
CHR-0282.title: Heir of the Veil
CHR-0282.looks: A slender young elf of 94 with eyes that shine in lamplight, a grey gauze veil by day and a dusk-grey ranger's cloak.
CHR-0282.manner: Quick and bold at dusk, quiet and half-blind at noon, she speaks frankly and hates waiting.
CHR-0282.wants: She wants 120 night rangers to escort Thalion safely to Evenglade for the Leaf Fall Moot.
CHR-0282.fears: She fears an ambush on Thalion's road in daylight, when her eyes fail her.

CHR-0283.name: Thalion Halfleaf
CHR-0283.title: Grandson of Queen Ithrien; citizen of Eldergrove
CHR-0283.looks: A slim half-elf of 85 who looks barely thirty, with his father's green-stone ring and an archer's calloused fingers.
CHR-0283.manner: Modest and thoughtful, he avoids talk of crowns and prefers the archery butts to any council hall.
CHR-0283.wants: He wants to be left alone with Ilvara and his bow, not crowned heir of the Evenwood at Leaf Fall.
CHR-0283.fears: He fears that the vote over him will set the two elven realms against each other.

CHR-0284.name: Saelith the Veiled Queen
CHR-0284.title: Queen
CHR-0284.looks: A tall, pale elf queen of 211 with eyes that shine in lamplight, always veiled in fine grey gauze by day.
CHR-0284.manner: Cool and businesslike, she bargains like a merchant and decides in months what Sylvaran takes decades over.
CHR-0284.wants: She wants to sell her silence about Serra's proof to the Temple for fifty years of Holy See grain.
CHR-0284.fears: She fears the Temple's envoy stealing Serra's copy from the Silverbough archive in March.

CHR-0285.name: Lirael the Archivist
CHR-0285.looks: A thin, ink-stained elf of 284 with dark hair pinned up with a reed pen and a ring of archive keys at her waist.
CHR-0285.manner: Exact and guarded, she speaks quietly, weighs every request and never lets a stranger near the inner shelves.
CHR-0285.wants: She wants Serra's proof kept hidden until it can buy Eldergrove something great.
CHR-0285.fears: She fears the Temple's envoy and the knight with him, now that word of the archive keys has been sold.

CHR-0287.name: Taeron Windward
CHR-0287.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0287.looks: An old, lean elf of 436 with a bowman's shoulders, a stiff left calf and a grey sealskin cloak over his yew bow.
CHR-0287.manner: Quiet, exact and calculating, he watches a person's stride and the wind before he says anything.
CHR-0287.wants: He wants to stop the knight sent to steal Serra's proof from the Silverbough archive in March.
CHR-0287.fears: He fears his slowing hands, for his draw has fallen from about 40 kg to 32 since 1090.

CHR-0289.name: Loren Seabright
CHR-0289.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0289.title: Captain of the Ithira Fjord Watch
CHR-0289.looks: A lean half-elf of 63 who looks forty, with grey-blue eyes, salt-bleached hair tied back, and a sealskin coat over light mail.
CHR-0289.manner: Speaks little and plainly, like a watch officer reading a beacon log, and never raises his voice even in a fjord gale.
CHR-0289.wants: Wants his Fjord Watch blades in the 120-strong escort Ilvara Mistwalker means to send with Thalion Halfleaf to the Moot at Leaf Fall.
CHR-0289.fears: Fears dying as a nameless captain on a cold fjord, the half-elf son whom House Greywave never once called its…

CHR-0290.name: Ilmar Seawatch
CHR-0290.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0290.title: Captain of the West Strand Watch
CHR-0290.looks: A tall, weathered elf of 234 with sea-grey eyes, a seal hunter's scarred forearms, and an oiled grey wool cloak with a bone pin.
CHR-0290.manner: Quiet and watchful, he answers questions with questions and studies every boat's lines before he greets its crew.
CHR-0290.wants: Wants proof of which Saltleaf boats cut the smuggled fir for Aldmark's 400 masts before Corin Saltleaf can bury the trail.
CHR-0290.fears: Fears the council will shield the rich Half-Elf Speaker and break the watch captain who dared accuse him.

CHR-0291.name: Istavel Starwright
CHR-0291.looks: An old, thin elf of 304, stooped at the shoulders, with silver hair to his waist and fingers stained with ink from star tables.
CHR-0291.manner: Speaks slowly and precisely, counts on his fingers while he talks, and forgets meals and guests whenever a clear night comes.
CHR-0291.wants: Wants to check the eclipses in the archive's Grove Count against the sky, so Queen Saelith's proof against the Temple's calendar cannot be broken.
CHR-0291.fears: Fears fire in the Silverbough Archive more than his own death, because one spark could burn five thousand…

CHR-0292.name: Enna Fairspeech
CHR-0292.looks: A half-elf of 54 who looks thirty, slim and dark-haired, in a good sea-blue wool gown with a small silver pin at the throat.
CHR-0292.manner: Warm, quick and charming in four tongues, she laughs at the right moments and always remembers what each guest likes to drink.
CHR-0292.wants: Wants to be paid in full by the Temple's envoy and gone south before anyone asks who told about the archive keys.
CHR-0292.fears: Fears the cold eyes of Lirael the Archivist, and the day the Council of the Grey Veil asks who knew where the…

CHR-0293.name: Sorel Quietwater
CHR-0293.looks: A handsome elf of 144 in southern linen under a grey Eldergrove cloak, with pale bands on his fingers where sold rings were.
CHR-0293.manner: Polished, soft-voiced and amused, he flatters easily and smiles most when he is most afraid.
CHR-0293.wants: Wants to name the Knight of the Sun riding with the Temple's envoy before his Ostran creditors sell his own name to the Holy See.
CHR-0293.fears: Fears his creditors in Ostra, and the Veiled Queen learning how deep in debt her envoy of thirty-four years…

CHR-0294.name: Brak Longwind
CHR-0294.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0294.title: Master of Messengers
CHR-0294.looks: A lean, long-legged orc of 46 with grey creeping into his braids, copper-capped tusks, and the hard calves of a lifelong runner.
CHR-0294.manner: Speaks softly and exactly, repeats a message word for word, and never sits down while there is still ground to cover.
CHR-0294.wants: Wants to carry Empress Elswyth's Greyhaven pearls to Vrag unseen and keep the Gordush quiet until the wedding on 21 June.
CHR-0294.fears: Fears the clans learning the truth about his line's blood, which would turn the old mockery of half-human…

CHR-0295.name: Skarn Redhand
CHR-0295.title: First War-Captain; chief of the Magak clans
CHR-0295.looks: A long-armed orc of 38, grey at the jaw, with a puckered Goroth arrow scar through his right palm.
CHR-0295.manner: Cool and patient for an orc, he studies the horses in a camp before he looks at the riders.
CHR-0295.wants: Wants enough clans counted by the Great Ride on 21 June to take the war-chief's staff the day Vrag's heart fails.
CHR-0295.fears: Fears a long summer war that would starve the Magak herds and hand the staff to Tarn Halfblood's cause…

CHR-0296.name: Gorm the Trader
CHR-0296.looks: A thick-set half-orc of 44 with small tusks, a broken nose, a felt coat over Aldmark linen, and silver rings on every finger.
CHR-0296.manner: Loud, friendly and quick with a joke in two tongues, he haggles hard and seals every deal by sharing food.
CHR-0296.wants: Wants to move the next Magak herd to Edda Holt's breeders at Millrun before war closes the Skardush road in spring.
CHR-0296.fears: Fears Vrag learning that the Horde's best horses are carrying Aldmark lances, and the Hearth Guard riding to…

CHR-0297.name: Rasha
CHR-0297.title: Mother
CHR-0297.looks: A broad orc woman of 49 with felt dust in her grey braids, strong reddened hands, and silver caps on both tusks.
CHR-0297.manner: Blunt and slow to smile, she counts in knots on a cord and expects every guest to eat before any talk of business.
CHR-0297.wants: Wants her Urgol felts sold in Aldmark's markets through Gorm the Trader before a war shuts the Skardush road.
CHR-0297.fears: Fears a thin winter of grazing and a spring war together, which would leave Urgol's felt-makers without wool…

CHR-0298.name: Shura
CHR-0298.title: Mother
