CHR-0298.looks: A tall, unbent orc of 56, young for a Grey Mother, in a grey-painted hide cloak, carrying a staff notched for every grazing ruling.
CHR-0298.manner: Speaks in the measured lines of the Law of the Grass and never answers a question about pasture on the day it is asked.
CHR-0298.wants: Wants the Reed Wind's grass price of about 150 horses paid quietly again, and nobody searching the old cords of 912 this year.
CHR-0298.fears: Fears that if the cords are shown at the kurultai, her secret grazing deal with the Reed Wind will come out…

CHR-0299.name: Harkun the Drum-Master
CHR-0299.title: Head of the Drum Council; master of the Drum Lodge
CHR-0299.looks: A heavy, deep-chested orc of 54 with drum-callused palms, a grey-streaked crest of hair, and a black hide cloak painted with white lightning.
CHR-0299.manner: Speaks rarely and in rhythm, tapping time on his thigh, and lets a long silence fall before every judgment he gives.
CHR-0299.wants: Wants to judge at the Great Ride on 21 June whether Tarn Halfblood is the rider of two peoples without splitting the Horde.
CHR-0299.fears: Fears that the Horde's holy claim will crack if Ashka Drumtongue's copy of the Grey Mothers' hide reaches the…

CHR-0300.name: Ugra
CHR-0300.title: Mother
CHR-0300.looks: A small, very upright orc of 62 with white braids, one cracked tusk, and fingers stained with paint from the winter-count hides.
CHR-0300.manner: Speaks slowly, remembers every quarrel since her girlhood, and watches people as if she were already painting them onto a hide.
CHR-0300.wants: Wants Maren of Hazelhollow to swear before the Drum Stones on 21 June that Tarn is Durgash's son, giving Gorath's line a second heir.
CHR-0300.fears: Fears Vrag dying young before the clans accept a successor, and the Horde breaking apart as every horde…

CHR-0301.name: Tarn Halfblood
CHR-0301.title: Leader of Tarn's Halfbloods; guest of the fire
CHR-0301.looks: A powerful half-orc of 31 with short tusks, his Northfolk mother's grey eyes, and old burn scars across both forearms.
CHR-0301.manner: Speaks the Northfolk tongue and the orc tongue equally well, rallies men with plain promises, and keeps his temper on a short leash.
CHR-0301.wants: Wants to end Aldmark's License Law by war and to stand at the Great Ride on 21 June as the rider of two peoples.
CHR-0301.fears: Fears the blood fury in himself, which killed his father young and could make him cut down his own riders.

CHR-0302.name: Vrag
CHR-0302.title: War-Chief of the Horde
CHR-0302.looks: A massive orc of 32 with silver-capped tusks, a black hide cloak painted with white lightning, and lips that grey after hard effort.
CHR-0302.manner: Bold and generous at the clan fire, he laughs loudly, keeps the Law of the Fire to the letter, and never shows tiredness in public.
CHR-0302.wants: Wants the Gordush quiet until midsummer, Tusk clans won without a fight, and Tarn Halfblood kept safe as a guest of the fire.
CHR-0302.fears: Fears dying young like his father and grandfather, and the clans tearing the Horde apart before he can name a…

CHR-0305.name: Elsa Millward
CHR-0305.looks: A thin Northfolk woman of 28 with chapped hands, a mud-brown riding cloak, and straw-colored hair cut short for the road.
CHR-0305.manner: Quiet, quick and careful, she smiles at everyone and looks over her shoulder far too often for an honest guide.
CHR-0305.wants: Wants a way out of both bargains: carrying Tarn's messages to his mother and selling his camp to Garrick Harrow to save her father.
CHR-0305.fears: Fears that Lord Harrow will hang her father if her reports stop, and that Tarn's riders will kill her if they…

CHR-0306.name: Ruk Nightrein
CHR-0306.looks: A wiry, scarred orc of 28 from the Salt Edge, dark-skinned for an orc, with a split ear and a horse thief's soft boots.
CHR-0306.manner: Cocky, fast-talking and restless, he grins while he lies and cannot resist boasting once the ale is flowing.
CHR-0306.wants: Wants to steal Garrick Harrow's destriers from the Aldmark march this spring and sell them before the war starts.
CHR-0306.fears: Fears Vrag learning who really took the war-chief's mares, and Grenna Wildmane, who never believed the Nine…

CHR-0307.name: Jessa Crane
CHR-0307.looks: A hard-faced Northfolk woman of 36 with a smuggler's weather-cracked hands, a river boatman's coat, and a knife scar under one eye.
CHR-0307.manner: Dry, practical and short with words, she counts coin twice and trusts a promise only when it is paid in advance.
CHR-0307.wants: Wants to get 200 Iron Road Company crossbows across the Gordush to Tarn's Halfbloods before May Fair and collect her fee.
CHR-0307.fears: Fears Aldmark's river patrols and the gallows at Crossmarch, where smugglers who arm the Horde are hanged.

CHR-0308.name: Grask Firstwave
CHR-0308.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0308.title: Captain of the first wave, Hearth Guard
CHR-0308.looks: A tall, heavy orc of 36 with a broad scarred chest, a shaved head, and the Hearth Guard's black hide over boiled leather.
CHR-0308.manner: Loud in camp and silent in the line, he is loyal to Vrag without question and laughs off any talk of weakness.
CHR-0308.wants: Wants to keep first place in the relay line for his wave and keep Skarn Redhand out of the war-chief's tent.
CHR-0308.fears: Fears the clans learning that the war-chief fainted, and being the man who failed to catch him the next time.

CHR-0309.name: Durk Ironarms
CHR-0309.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0309.title: Second-wave captain, Hearth Guard
CHR-0309.looks: A huge orc of 33, with thick wrestler's arms and crooked fingers that Mother Ossa has reset five times.
CHR-0309.manner: Slow-spoken and good-natured until a fight starts, then wild; he apologizes afterward to the friends he struck.
CHR-0309.wants: Wants to win back the Great Ride wrestling at the Drum Stones this June and wipe out the shame of 1102.
CHR-0309.fears: Fears the blood fury taking him again near his own riders, as it did at the Coldbarrow Bridge in October 1102.

CHR-0310.name: Bram Hollis
CHR-0310.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0310.looks: A grizzled Northfolk man of 46 with a broad back, a sergeant's rope-burned hands, and a faded Aldmark thumb-ring he refuses to take off.
CHR-0310.manner: Gruff, patient and exact, he teaches by doing it slowly once and makes his half-orc pupils repeat it a hundred times.
CHR-0310.wants: Wants Tarn's Halfbloods able to rope down the stake lines he once built at Crossmarch before Aldmark crosses in spring.
CHR-0310.fears: Fears being taken alive by Aldmark, where an outlawed sergeant who trains the Horde would hang in front of…

CHR-0311.name: Garnak Stonehoof
CHR-0311.title: War-Captain of the Gashmar clans
CHR-0311.looks: A grizzled, heavy orc of 52, old for his people, with a stiff left leg and a war-captain's horsetail plume on his helm.
CHR-0311.manner: Gruff and proud, he talks of old battles too often and answers any doubt about his courage with his fists.
CHR-0311.wants: Wants to raid Crossmarch with Hurn Firebrand before May Fair, before the Halfbloods are ready and before Aldmark strikes first.
CHR-0311.fears: Fears dying in bed of old age and being remembered as the youth who ran at the Gashmar Fords in 1070.

CHR-0312.name: Grenna Wildmane
CHR-0312.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0312.looks: A rangy orc woman of 34 with a wild mane of black hair, horse-bitten forearms, and a felt coat smelling of the herds.
CHR-0312.manner: Short-tempered and stubborn, she talks to horses more gently than to people and refuses deals she does not like.
CHR-0312.wants: Wants to stop the coughing sickness in the Goroth herds before the spring war, and before anyone learns of it.
CHR-0312.fears: Fears that a fifth of the Goroth herds will die, leaving the Horde without sound remounts in May.

CHR-0313.name: Hurn Firebrand
CHR-0313.looks: A tall, rangy orc of 18, already full-grown, with fresh tusks, a burn mark on one hand, and a borrowed mail shirt.
CHR-0313.manner: Hot-headed and loud, he makes speeches to young riders and calls every delay cowardice.
CHR-0313.wants: Wants to raid Crossmarch with Garnak Stonehoof before May Fair and avenge the Crown Wall bones on Aldmark.
CHR-0313.fears: Fears being thought a coward by Skarn Redhand, his teacher, and growing old without a famous deed.

CHR-0314.name: Ossa
CHR-0314.title: Mother
CHR-0314.looks: A short, strong orc woman of 44, young for a Grey Mother, with herb-stained fingers and a pouch of dried foxglove at her belt.
CHR-0314.manner: Calm, plain-spoken and gentle with the sick, she says little about her patients and less about the war-chief.
CHR-0314.wants: Wants to keep Vrag's heart beating with careful doses of foxglove through the Great Ride and the summer war.
CHR-0314.fears: Fears giving Vrag a dose too strong and being blamed for his death, as healers have been blamed before.

CHR-0315.name: Tollo Quietfoot
CHR-0315.looks: A lean, light orc of 30 with a runner's long legs, plain uncapped tusks, and a dun cloak the color of dry grass.
CHR-0315.manner: Soft-spoken and patient, he listens far more than he talks and can sit still for half a day without moving.
CHR-0315.wants: Wants to keep trading army counts at the dead oak each new moon, and keep the meeting place hidden from Ysolde Ravenscar.
CHR-0315.fears: Fears that Ravenscar's spy has found the path to the dead oak, which would expose him and his elven partner…

CHR-0316.name: Dorin Swiftarrow
CHR-0316.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0316.title: Master of the Kharsa Arrow Field; leads the Swift Arrows
CHR-0316.looks: A compact half-orc of 40 with short tusks, heavy shoulders from forty years at the bow, and a blue felt coat with horn toggles.
CHR-0316.manner: Cheerful and boastful in the yard, he teaches by shouting and laughing, and goes silent and exact once the arrows fly.
CHR-0316.wants: Wants new pupils of every tribe at the Kharsa Arrow Field and a second win over Oriana Sabine at a western horse fair.
CHR-0316.fears: Fears that the khan's failing sight and a fight over the succession will close the Arrow Field to riders of…

CHR-0317.name: Chagan the Postmaster
CHR-0317.looks: A stout, saddle-bowed man of 45 with a yam keeper's silver tablet on a cord, a weathered round face, and ink on his thumbs.
CHR-0317.manner: Talkative, genial and proud of his relay stations, he can name every yam on a road and the riders who keep it.
CHR-0317.wants: Wants the yam roads kept open and neutral through the Horse Feast, whoever wins the quarrel between Serik and Yesun.
CHR-0317.fears: Fears that Khatun Sorga will learn who told Yesun of the Red Wind where the cords of the Forty Silent Days…

CHR-0318.name: Kaidu Horsemaster
CHR-0318.looks: A lean, bandy-legged man of 55, burned dark by the channel wind, with a horse breeder's scarred hands and a fine fox-fur hat.
CHR-0318.manner: Courteous and shrewd, he speaks Northfolk well, flatters foreign buyers, and never names a price before seeing the buyer's coin.
CHR-0318.wants: Wants the spring horse fairs on the channel shore held as usual, with Greyhaven and Morhaven buyers paying in silver.
CHR-0318.fears: Fears that a war between Aldmark and the Horde will close the western markets and leave thousands of horses…

CHR-0319.name: Bora
CHR-0319.title: Old
CHR-0319.looks: A small, wind-wrinkled woman of 57 with fish-scale scars on her hands, a sturgeon-skin coat, and a gap where two teeth were.
CHR-0319.manner: Sharp-tongued and funny, she swears like a boatman, bargains in three languages, and never forgets an unpaid debt.
CHR-0319.wants: Wants her caviar boats out on the Salt Sea early this spring and a smaller share paid to Tolui of the Reed Wind.
CHR-0319.fears: Fears losing Tolui's protection, which keeps raiders and tax-riders away from her boats on the shores of…

CHR-0320.name: Idris of the Sea Wind
CHR-0320.looks: A tall, bearded man of 41 with a calm, broad face, a Sunland silk sash over his felt coat, and a well-keeper's copper cup.
CHR-0320.manner: Courteous and careful, he speaks slowly in the kurultai, quotes the Path of the Well, and promises nothing before the vote.
CHR-0320.wants: Wants the Path of the Well given an equal voice beside the Eternal Blue, and will sell his Well tribes' votes to whoever grants it.
CHR-0320.fears: Fears being crushed between Serik and Yesun at the Horse Feast on 21 June, whichever way he casts his votes.

CHR-0321.name: Tolui of the Reed Wind
CHR-0321.looks: A heavy, sleek man of 50 with a thin mustache, many gold rings, and a sable-trimmed coat bought with caviar money.
CHR-0321.manner: Smooth and hospitable, he feasts his guests well and changes the subject whenever old cords or old grazing come up.
CHR-0321.wants: Wants nobody searching old cords before the Horse Feast, and his secret grazing deal with Mother Shura kept quiet.
CHR-0321.fears: Fears his shaman's knotted cord of 1041 coming to light, which could throw the Nine Winds into blood feud.

CHR-0322.name: Yesun of the Red Wind
CHR-0322.title: Chief of the Red Wind; voice of the western tribes
CHR-0322.looks: A tall, hawk-faced man of 43 with a trimmed black beard and a red felt coat edged with wolf fur.
CHR-0322.manner: Proud, clever and witty, he speaks for four tribes as though born to it and is never quite loyal to anyone.
CHR-0322.wants: Wants Idris's Well tribes' votes to block Serik at the Horse Feast, and the cords of the Forty Silent Days shown openly.
CHR-0322.fears: Fears that Sartak will talk about the raid of 1079, and that Khatun Sorga will strike before the Horse Feast.

CHR-0323.name: Ilga of the Blue
CHR-0323.looks: A gaunt woman of 60 with long grey braids, a blue felt robe hung with small iron bells, and a scar on one palm.
CHR-0323.manner: Speaks in short riddles and long silences, stares past people at the sky, and rarely smiles in council.
CHR-0323.wants: Wants to read a clear omen at the Horse Feast on 21 June that keeps the khanship in the Kharsan line.
CHR-0323.fears: Fears that Ozbek's blindness and a disputed succession will break the tribes' faith in the Eternal Blue's…

CHR-0324.name: Sorga
CHR-0324.title: Khatun
CHR-0324.looks: A tall, handsome woman of 52 with grey streaks in her braids, a tally-cord pouch at her belt, and silver-and-coral earrings.
CHR-0324.manner: Composed, patient and hard to read, she speaks for the khan in his own words and forgets nothing she is told.
CHR-0324.wants: Wants the khanship passed to Serik at the Horse Feast while she governs quietly in the half-blind khan's name.
CHR-0324.fears: Fears the western tribes seeing the cords of 912 in her chest, which could make the whole Kharsan khanship…

CHR-0325.name: Serik Kharsan
CHR-0325.title: Heir; Commander of the Silver Tablet Guard; master of the Ring Hunt
CHR-0325.looks: A broad, heavy man of 34 already thickening at the waist, with a round face, a short beard, and the Silver Tablet Guard's blue coat.
CHR-0325.manner: Confident and blunt, he speaks like a commander on the hunt and has little patience for chiefs who talk in riddles.
CHR-0325.wants: Wants to be chosen khan at the Horse Feast and to stop the fire-oil sales to Queen Livia before they shame the Khanate.
CHR-0325.fears: Fears the sugar sickness of the lean-blood, which is blinding his father at 59 and may come for him too.

CHR-0326.name: Ozbek Kharsan
CHR-0326.title: Khan of the Nine Winds
CHR-0326.looks: A short, heavy man of 59, once lean and now heavy, with clouded eyes, numb feet in soft boots, and a felt coat.
CHR-0326.manner: Speaks quietly and knows men by their voices; he hides his blindness by letting others talk first and turning toward sounds.
CHR-0326.wants: Wants Queen Livia's 30 jars of fire-oil sent through Bekar and Morhaven this spring, and Serik safely chosen khan after him.
CHR-0326.fears: Fears dying blind and helpless while the western tribes call his house's khanship stolen and pull the Nine…

CHR-0327.name: Duran the Oil-Master
CHR-0327.looks: A wiry man of 47 with singed eyebrows, burn-shiny skin on his hands, and a leather apron that smells of the seeps.
CHR-0327.manner: Nervous and precise, he counts jars aloud, checks every seal twice, and never lets a stranger near a lit lamp.
CHR-0327.wants: Wants the 30 jars for Queen Livia sent out safely this spring without anyone learning that he keeps a record of every jar.
CHR-0327.fears: Fears that his hidden jar record will be found, and that the khan will blame him for the raid of 1079.

CHR-0328.name: Sartak of the Black Wind
CHR-0328.looks: A rangy, weather-beaten man of 42 with a broken nose, a black felt hat, and a missing ear tip from an old feud.
CHR-0328.manner: Sly, jovial and greedy, he tells tall tales of his raiding days and sells any secret to anyone who pays enough.
CHR-0328.wants: Wants to sell the trail to the fire-oil seeps to a Greyhaven cog master before the khan's riders catch him.
CHR-0328.fears: Fears the Keepers of the Seeps, who kill anyone who betrays the seeps' place, and Yesun's silver drying up.

CHR-0329.name: Tamsa of the Salt Wind
CHR-0329.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0329.title: Quiver-master of Salt Wind archers
CHR-0329.looks: A lean half-orc woman of 26 with small tusks, a long black braid, and archer's calluses on three fingers of her right hand.
CHR-0329.manner: Quiet and dry-humored, she shoots more than she talks and gives orders to her archers with short hand signs.
CHR-0329.wants: Wants Uzka Twoblood's riders to reach Tarn and back safely, and her own part in the yam horses kept quiet.
CHR-0329.fears: Fears the khan's people learning she gave the Tusk riders fresh yam horses, which could cost her command or…

CHR-0330.name: Bolor of the Grey Wind
CHR-0330.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0330.title: Captain of the Keepers of the Seeps
CHR-0330.looks: A small woman of 36, with fire-scarred forearms, no mail, and clay fire-pots hung at her saddle.
CHR-0330.manner: Calm, watchful and short-spoken, she keeps every flame at arm's length and checks the wind before she speaks.
CHR-0330.wants: Wants to catch her two deserters, who carry the death oath, before they sell the place of the seeps.
CHR-0330.fears: Fears fire in her own jars more than any enemy, ever since she dragged her father from the burning store at…

CHR-0331.name: Kulan of the Blue Wind
CHR-0331.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0331.title: Captain of the Yam Riders
CHR-0331.looks: A slim, strong woman of 28 with wind-burned cheeks, a blue felt coat over lamellar, and a silver yam tablet at her chest.
CHR-0331.manner: Fast, confident and impatient, she talks like a courier giving orders and rides better than she sits.
CHR-0331.wants: Wants Serik made khan before her child is born, so the child is not born to a fallen heir.
CHR-0331.fears: Fears that her pregnancy will cost her the Yam Riders and draw the anger of Khatun Sorga and the hearth…

CHR-0332.name: Jarak of the Red Wind
CHR-0332.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0332.title: Red Wind champion
CHR-0332.looks: A thick-necked man of 44, with a red cord in his braids and a lance scar from collarbone to hip.
CHR-0332.manner: Loud, angry and quick to laugh, he steps close to talk, and his hands are never far from another man's sleeve.
CHR-0332.wants: Wants to show the grave of Temur's guard captain at the kurultai and win the Red Wind its revenge on the Kharsan house.
CHR-0332.fears: Fears his knees failing before the Horse Feast, and being knifed by Khatun Sorga's men before he can speak.

CHR-0333.name: Hrok Whitehorn
CHR-0333.title: War-Captain; chief of the Whitehorn clans
CHR-0333.looks: A big orc of 36, in iron-plated hide armor, with a rhino-torn left thigh that stops him running far.
CHR-0333.manner: Proud, loud and quick to anger, he speaks in boasts and challenges and never admits that a fight went badly.
CHR-0333.wants: Wants the 2,000 bushels of withheld rye paid, or an excuse to raid past the Thardush cairns before spring.
CHR-0333.fears: Fears the witness Kira Ferryhand hides, who can prove his Whitehorn riders burned the Sevmir farms in…

CHR-0334.name: Grel Rhinospear
CHR-0334.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0334.title: Master of the Rhino Spear Lodge
CHR-0334.looks: A rawboned orc woman of 44 with a rhino-horn scar down one cheek, heavy forearms, and a cloak of woolly rhino hide.
CHR-0334.manner: Grim and sparing with praise, she speaks to students as if each might die tomorrow, because some of them will.
CHR-0334.wants: Wants a strong class at the Rhino Spear Lodge this spring and no more students buried after the trials.
CHR-0334.fears: Fears that the coming war will take her best spears from Krarog and spend them as ordinary riders.

CHR-0335.name: Anvar the Guide
CHR-0335.looks: A wiry, sun-dark man of 49 with three fingers missing from his left hand, a felt coat, and a guide's long fur-trimmed hood.
CHR-0335.manner: Easygoing and slow-talking by the fire, he tells stories about every pass and never says where he will ride next.
CHR-0335.wants: Wants to keep leading Borek Marten's Velgradan caravans past the Kraoth toll on his hidden track this year.
CHR-0335.fears: Fears Toruk Chainsilver's Toll Riders, who killed a young guide in 1103 and buried him under the Kraoth horse…

CHR-0336.name: Gurz the Toll-Keeper
CHR-0336.looks: A stout orc of 43 with silver-capped tusks, ink-stained fingers, a heavy silk-trimmed felt coat, and a bunch of chest keys at his belt.
CHR-0336.manner: Calm and courteous like a merchant, he counts everything twice and talks about trade, not war, at every meeting.
CHR-0336.wants: Wants to raise the Kraoth silk toll again while keeping peace with Drevna and Velgrad, so the silk keeps coming.
CHR-0336.fears: Fears a toll war that empties Grakmar's chests, and King Stanislav finding another silk road over the Roof.

CHR-0337.name: Krasha
CHR-0337.title: Mother
CHR-0337.looks: A heavy old orc woman of 54 with white braids, deep laugh lines, copper-capped tusks, and a grey hide cloak of the clan-mothers.
CHR-0337.manner: Warm and slow-voiced, she listens to everyone before speaking, then speaks the Law of the Grass as final.
CHR-0337.wants: Wants Shara Ironhide ready to rule if Urza falls in the June heat, with her granddaughter Morga ready in reserve.
CHR-0337.fears: Fears Urza dying of heat at the summer Great Ride, as her mother Grakka did in 1080, leaving the league…

CHR-0338.name: Bolg the Drummer
CHR-0338.title: Chief Shaman; master of the Drum Band
CHR-0338.looks: A thickset orc of 55, nearly deaf, with drumstick-callused hands, grey braids, and a cloak sewn with the bones of old drum skins.
CHR-0338.manner: Loud because he cannot hear himself, he watches lips closely and grows angry when he misses a word.
CHR-0338.wants: Wants to denounce Uzka Twoblood and her holy rider at the Tusk Great Ride at Grakmar on 21 June.
CHR-0338.fears: Fears his deafness becoming known, because a chief shaman who cannot hear his own drums may be set aside.

CHR-0339.name: Uzka Twoblood
CHR-0339.title: Leader of the Seekers of the Rider
CHR-0339.looks: A tall, sinewy half-orc woman of 25 with small tusks, a shaved head, a spear-fighter's shoulders, and a white cloth tied on her arm.
CHR-0339.manner: Fiery and eloquent, she preaches the rider of two peoples to any crowd and treats doubters as enemies.
CHR-0339.wants: Wants Tarn Halfblood to come east to the Tusk Great Ride on 21 June and be hailed as the rider of two peoples.
CHR-0339.fears: Fears Bolg the Drummer denouncing her at Grakmar, and the War-Mother casting her out of the league.

CHR-0340.name: Shara Ironhide
CHR-0340.title: Heir; rides in the Hearth Band
CHR-0340.looks: A broad, strong orc girl of 18, with thick, scar-free Ironhide skin, a young face, and the Hearth Band's red rhino-horn badge.
CHR-0340.manner: Proud and stiff in public, she speaks little in council and watches her mother to see how a War-Mother behaves.
CHR-0340.wants: Wants to prove herself in the Hearth Band before anyone questions her right to speak in the clan council.
CHR-0340.fears: Fears the summer heat that killed her grandmother Grakka, and being called to rule before she is ready.

CHR-0341.name: Urza Ironhide
CHR-0341.title: War-Mother of the Tusk Clans
CHR-0341.looks: A powerful orc woman of 38 with thick grey-green hide, silver-capped tusks, and a War-Mother's red rhino-horn on her spear.
CHR-0341.manner: Steady, practical and blunt, she refuses all holy chiefs and talks of rye, horses and tolls instead of prophecy.
CHR-0341.wants: Wants the 2,000 bushels of rye paid by Drevna and the silk tolls kept high without restarting the Tusk War.
CHR-0341.fears: Fears the June heat of the Great Ride, which killed her mother Grakka in 1080 and could kill her too.

CHR-0342.name: Dorn Twotongue
CHR-0342.looks: A lean half-orc of 34 with short tusks, his Drevnan mother's blue eyes, and Drevnan green linen under a Tusk felt coat.
CHR-0342.manner: Patient, polite and careful in both tongues, he chooses every word and translates insults into something gentler.
CHR-0342.wants: Wants the Lake Council to release the 2,000 bushels of withheld rye before Hrok Whitehorn's riders take it themselves.
CHR-0342.fears: Fears being caught between two peoples if war returns, trusted by neither and blamed by both.

CHR-0344.name: Garn Hornbreaker
CHR-0344.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0344.title: Spear-master of the Hearth Band
CHR-0344.looks: A tall, lean orc of 32 with long arms, plated hide armor, and nine notches on his spear shaft, one per rhino.
CHR-0344.manner: Calm, quiet and loyal, he speaks plainly to the young spears he trains and avoids the clan quarrels.
CHR-0344.wants: Wants to keep Shara Ironhide's secret safe and train the Hearth Band's spearmen well before the war season.
CHR-0344.fears: Fears that Hrok Whitehorn will reveal what his scouts saw and shame both Shara and himself.

CHR-0346.name: Toruk Chainsilver
CHR-0346.title: Captain of the Toll Riders
CHR-0346.looks: A burly orc of 37 with a silver chain looped over his felt coat, a heavy jaw, and scarred knuckles on both hands.
CHR-0346.manner: Rough and suspicious, he questions every traveler as if they were already lying and enjoys the fear he causes.
CHR-0346.wants: Wants to find Anvar's hidden track around the Kraoth toll and close it with his 1,600 Toll Riders.
CHR-0346.fears: Fears that the young guide he buried under the horse pens will be found and the killing traced to him.

CHR-0348.name: Hodd Ryeseed
CHR-0348.looks: A stocky orc of 35 with a farmer's stoop, dirt under his nails, and a seed bag where other orcs carry an axe.
CHR-0348.manner: Earnest and stubborn, he talks about soil and rye to anyone who will listen, and laughs off the warriors' scorn.
CHR-0348.wants: Wants to sow stolen tribute rye at the Thardush cairns this spring and show that orcs can feed themselves by the plough.
CHR-0348.fears: Fears that a war on the Thardush line will burn his fields, and that the Plough-Burners will turn on his…

CHR-0349.name: Ashka Drumtongue
CHR-0349.looks: A slight orc woman of 28 with bright, watchful eyes, ink on her fingers, and the small brass drum of a shaman's hearer.
CHR-0349.manner: Quick, quiet and observant, she speaks softly for the deaf Bolg and notices everything people say when they think she is not listening.
CHR-0349.wants: Wants to reach Urgol and copy the Grey Mothers' hide that shows Gorath's Thunder Horse was a staged drive.
CHR-0349.fears: Fears the Grey Mothers catching her at Urgol, as they once hunted her mother, a runaway braid-girl.

CHR-0350.name: Tovik Dustcloak
CHR-0350.looks: A dusty, sun-browned orc of 33 with a lean runner's frame, a sand-colored cloak, and a scout's cracked lips.
CHR-0350.manner: Silent and patient, he answers in single words and reports only to the War-Mother's tent, alone.
CHR-0350.wants: Wants to follow the Velgradan scout seeking a road over the Roof and learn whether a southern silk road is possible.
CHR-0350.fears: Fears that a road over the Roof will make the Kraoth toll useless and leave the Toll Clans poor.

CHR-0351.name: Dmitri Hale
CHR-0351.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0351.looks: A big man of 41, in a tarred sailor's coat, with two stiff fingers on his right hand.
CHR-0351.manner: His voice carries over fifty oar-benches; ashore he is blunt, cheerful and impatient with anyone who cannot row.
CHR-0351.wants: Wants his galley crews ready for Radek Volan's July dusk and a chance to board Rolf Brightwater's flagship himself.
CHR-0351.fears: Fears a real fleet action, which he has never seen, and drowning in mail like the men he warns his crews…

CHR-0352.name: Ruslan Hardhand
CHR-0352.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0352.looks: A hard man of 48, in a mail hauberk, with a ridge of healed bone across his right knuckles.
CHR-0352.manner: Quiet and dutiful, he speaks rarely and simply, and teaches the great-axe with his hands more than with words.
CHR-0352.wants: Wants the king alive through 1105 and the Bear Guard loyal to the king, not to Lord Marshal Zoran Koren.
CHR-0352.fears: Fears the king's bear-blood failing him, as it fails all the tallest Sevrins, and the Bear Guard falling to…

CHR-0353.name: Anton Koren
CHR-0353.title: Commander of the Dawn Volunteers
CHR-0353.looks: A lean, fair man of 30 with a short beard, a scar through one eyebrow, and the bear banner on his surcoat.
CHR-0353.manner: Brave, earnest and religious, he speaks of the Dawn Church's cause with real feeling and expects his men to share it.
CHR-0353.wants: Wants to march with Prince Andros after 1 May and finish the war in the Neck with his 4,000 Dawn Volunteers.
CHR-0353.fears: Fears that Queen Livia's fire-oil will burn his volunteers in their sleep at the winter camp of Coreria.

CHR-0354.name: Dmitar Kovar
CHR-0354.title: Velgrad's captain on Andros's council
CHR-0354.looks: A heavy, well-fed man of 44 in a fur-lined coat and fine boots, with a soldier's broken nose and rings bought with toll silver.
CHR-0354.manner: Smooth and practical, he jokes with soldiers, flatters princes, and always knows the price of a man's loyalty.
CHR-0354.wants: Wants to bring Brann Hollow's 800 Reef Crossbows over to Andros with double pay before the quarter day of 21 June.
CHR-0354.fears: Fears a peace in the Neck that would hand back the three road stations and end his skim of their tolls.

CHR-0355.name: Zoran Koren
CHR-0355.title: Lord Marshal; Lord of the Ostec March
CHR-0355.looks: A stern, grey-bearded man of 54, broad and straight, in a Lord Marshal's red-collared coat with a heavy silver chain.
CHR-0355.manner: Cold, measured and polite, he speaks like a lender reading a contract and never forgets a debt or a slight.
CHR-0355.wants: Wants to be regent for his grandson Radoslav if the short-lived king dies, and to keep Velgrad's army in his own hand.
CHR-0355.fears: Fears being passed over for the regency in favor of his own daughter, the queen.

CHR-0356.name: Borek Marten
CHR-0356.looks: A gruff, heavy man of 55 with a trapper's weathered face, a magnificent sable coat, and a ledger always tucked under his arm.
CHR-0356.manner: Plain-spoken and proud of his humble start, he haggles over every pelt and trusts deeds more than titles.
CHR-0356.wants: Wants the channel and silk tolls cut, by a secret pact with Godric Redley and by Anvar's hidden track past Kraoth.
CHR-0356.fears: Fears that King Stanislav will learn of his letters to Greyhaven and treat them as treason.

CHR-0357.name: Janek Kell
CHR-0357.looks: A solid man of 44 with sawdust in his beard, adze-scarred hands, and a shipwright's leather apron over a red-embroidered shirt.
CHR-0357.manner: Careful and worried, he talks about timber and keels to avoid talking about anything else.
CHR-0357.wants: Wants to get through 1105 without the Channel-Master learning that he has spoken to Greyhaven's spy Merrick Fenn.
CHR-0357.fears: Fears Radek Volan finding out about his talk with Fenn, and the fire-raft plot dragging Sevany into a war.

CHR-0358.name: Mirek Tolmir
CHR-0358.looks: A thin, balding man of 43 with ink-stained cuffs, a fur-lined black coat, and a small brass counting board at his belt.
CHR-0358.manner: Precise, gloomy and dry, he counts every mark and tells everyone that the war is bleeding the realm.
CHR-0358.wants: Wants the war money to Andros stopped and peace made with Greyhaven, while keeping the Ostran talks hidden from the king.
CHR-0358.fears: Fears the king discovering that his Lord Treasurer knew of the Ostran peace talks and kept them secret.

CHR-0359.name: Radek Volan
CHR-0359.title: Channel-Master
CHR-0359.looks: A broad, sea-weathered man of 46 with a grey beard, burn scars on his hands from pitch, and a heavy fur cloak.
CHR-0359.manner: Hard, bitter and patient, he speaks of Greyhaven with hatred and of his plans with careful silence.
CHR-0359.wants: Wants to loose eight fire rafts on a July dusk and seize the Grey Channel tolls in Greyhaven's panic.
CHR-0359.fears: Fears that Greyhaven has already learned of the rafts, which would turn his surprise into a trap.

CHR-0360.name: Kirill the Lamp-Bearer
CHR-0360.looks: A tall, frail old man of 70 with a long white beard, deep-set eyes, and a lamp-bearer's staff he leans on.
CHR-0360.manner: Gentle-voiced and grave, he speaks in prophecies and blessings and never raises his voice, even in anger.
CHR-0360.wants: Wants to see Andros crowned in Tessar and the Dawn Church raised over the whole Neck before he dies.
CHR-0360.fears: Fears dying before the Lamp is relit in the East, and the Dawn Church being sold out at a peace table.

CHR-0361.name: Radoslav Sevrin
CHR-0361.looks: A big, solemn boy of 5, already tall and broad for his age, with his father's dark eyes and a small fur hat.
CHR-0361.manner: Shy with strangers and bold with the Bear Guard, he copies the soldiers' salutes and asks endless questions.
CHR-0361.wants: Wants his father to play with him more and to be given a real axe like the men of the Bear Guard.
CHR-0361.fears: Fears the dark rooms where his father lies with his headaches, and the shouting of grown men.

CHR-0362.name: Zora Sevrin
CHR-0362.looks: A slender, dark-haired woman of 27 with a pale, composed face, a queen's red-embroidered linen, and a small sealed letter case.
CHR-0362.manner: Calm, watchful and reserved, she speaks little at court and listens closely to everything said about her husband's health.
CHR-0362.wants: Wants her son's future secured and the regency kept in her own hands, not her father's, if the king dies.
CHR-0362.fears: Fears her own father, Zoran Koren, who expects to rule Velgrad through her son.

CHR-0363.name: Stanislav Sevrin
CHR-0363.title: King of Velgrad
CHR-0363.looks: A giant man of 33 and very broad, with a heavy brow, a dark beard, and eyes that sometimes stare at nothing.
CHR-0363.manner: Grim and decisive, he speaks bluntly and in a hurry, like a man who knows he has little time.
CHR-0363.wants: Wants to fake the Black Dragon's rising with fire rafts on a July dusk and seize the Grey Channel tolls.
CHR-0363.fears: Fears dying young like the tallest Sevrins before him, leaving a five-year-old heir and House Koren as…

CHR-0364.name: Vera Belak
CHR-0364.looks: A neat, sharp-faced woman of 38 with smooth dark hair, plain dark clothes, and the king's seal on a chain at her neck.
CHR-0364.manner: Polite, soft-spoken and patient, she asks small questions and remembers every answer.
CHR-0364.wants: Wants the Ostran draft treaty out of Cosimo Lunetti's study and in Velgrad by Lantern Night, 2 February.
CHR-0364.fears: Fears the king blaming her for the failed Redcrown sulfur pits that sent Volan's buyers to Smokewell.

CHR-0365.name: Kazimir son of Danek
CHR-0365.looks: A sly, lean man of 36 with a broken front tooth, a river smuggler's patched coat, and a knife hidden in his boot.
CHR-0365.manner: Friendly, quick and untrustworthy, he grins at everyone and sells whatever he hears to the highest bidder.
CHR-0365.wants: Wants to collect his reward from Velgrad's informers and get out of Sevany before Greyhaven's friends come looking.
CHR-0365.fears: Fears Merrick Fenn learning who sold him, or Greyhaven's agents paying him back with a knife.

CHR-0366.name: Katya Vell
CHR-0366.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0366.looks: A tall, wiry woman of 26 with cropped brown hair, a fighter's scarred knuckles, and a plain wool coat over light mail.
CHR-0366.manner: Fierce, direct and loyal, she speaks bluntly and has little patience for nobles or excuses.
CHR-0366.wants: Wants her debtor father off a fire-raft crew before the July dusk, by paying his debt or by force.
CHR-0366.fears: Fears her father burning to death on a raft crew in the plot he does not even understand.

CHR-0367.name: Rurik Greytusk
CHR-0367.title: Captain of Greytusk's Company
CHR-0367.looks: A big half-orc of 39 with short tusks, a shaved head, axe-scarred forearms, and a mail shirt mended many times.
CHR-0367.manner: Rough, loyal and blunt, he jokes with his half-orc axemen and speaks to nobles only when he is paid to.
CHR-0367.wants: Wants his company paid and kept off the muster rolls so the Neck lords cannot deny them land later.
CHR-0367.fears: Fears that his men, unlisted and unprotected, will burn at Coreria if Queen Livia's fire-oil falls on the…

CHR-0368.name: Dana Veskov
CHR-0368.looks: A broad, weathered woman of 38 with short iron-grey hair, a scar along her jaw, and the Ostec March colors on her coat.
CHR-0368.manner: Practical and brisk, she speaks like a quartermaster, counting men, horses and days in every sentence.
CHR-0368.wants: Wants the Ostec March garrisons fed and ready through the spring while the Lord Marshal plays at court.
CHR-0368.fears: Fears being ordered by Zoran Koren to march her garrisons against the king's men in a fight over the regency.

CHR-0369.name: Varin Strak
CHR-0369.title: Captain of the Bear Guard
CHR-0369.looks: A very tall man of 42 with long arms, a great-axe on his shoulder, and the Bear Guard's black bear on white across his mail.
CHR-0369.manner: Polite and correct, he says what he must and nothing more, and smiles only with the Lord Marshal's people.
CHR-0369.wants: Wants to keep his command of the Bear Guard whatever happens, by staying close to both the king and Zoran Koren.
CHR-0369.fears: Fears Ruslan Hardhand, his old master, who knows he is reporting to the Lord Marshal.

CHR-0370.name: Lidia Marek
CHR-0370.looks: A thin, plain woman of 34 in a fur merchant's widow's dark wool, with clever eyes and ink on her fingers.
CHR-0370.manner: Quiet and friendly, she gossips easily with servants and seems harmless, which is exactly what she wants.
CHR-0370.wants: Wants the draft treaty copied by Fausto Renn and sent out of Ostra by Lantern Night, and paid for twice.
CHR-0370.fears: Fears Cosimo Lunetti's people catching Fausto Renn, and her two employers learning that she serves both.

CHR-0371.name: Lev Hollis
CHR-0371.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0371.title: Master of the Still Hall
CHR-0371.looks: A grey, wiry man of 53, with a face nobody remembers and two toes lost to frostbite.
CHR-0371.manner: Cold, dry and quiet, he speaks in a near whisper and holds that a fair fight is a failure of planning.
CHR-0371.wants: Wants to obey the queen's order of silence about the Harvest Home drum, unless she sends him after her husband's drummer.
CHR-0371.fears: Fears his own failing night sight, dimmed since 1102, being discovered by the men he leads in the dark.

CHR-0372.name: Mara Zorac
CHR-0372.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0372.title: Master of the Zorin Crossbow Yard
CHR-0372.looks: A strong, square woman of 34 with her father's heavy jaw, crossbow-callused hands, and a green wool coat over mail.
CHR-0372.manner: Plain, honest and stubborn, she says what she thinks to her father's face and drills her crossbowmen without mercy.
CHR-0372.wants: Wants the rye paid and the Tusk War avoided, and her father's excuse that the roads are unsafe shown to be false.
CHR-0372.fears: Fears that her father's pride will start a war that her crossbowmen will have to fight from the wagon forts.

CHR-0373.name: Vadim Zorac
CHR-0373.title: Lord Marshal; Warden of the Steppe March
CHR-0373.looks: A heavy, grizzled man of 56 with a lined, angry face, a soldier's stoop, and the Steppe March warden's silver chain.
CHR-0373.manner: Proud and harsh, he speaks of the rye as shame and treats anyone who mentions Zorek as an enemy.
CHR-0373.wants: Wants the 2,000 bushels of rye withheld for good and the grazing line pushed back east from the Steppe March.
CHR-0373.fears: Fears being remembered as the boy who ran at Zorek in 1064, and being punished by the queen for holding the…

CHR-0374.name: Hana Voska
CHR-0374.looks: A plump, rosy woman of 40 smelling of beeswax, with burn marks on her fingers and a fine green wool gown.
CHR-0374.manner: Friendly and businesslike, she talks easily about honey, wax and prices and very carefully about where her wax goes.
CHR-0374.wants: Wants her wax to keep reaching the Holy See's candle-makers before Return Day without anyone seeing the Dawn Church marks.
CHR-0374.fears: Fears that the Holy See will find Dawn Church wax in its holy candles and close the trade for good.

CHR-0375.name: Irina Lubec
CHR-0375.looks: A tall, elegant woman of 42 with a long, clever face, a fur-trimmed green coat, and a silver ear-cuff of the Listener.
CHR-0375.manner: Cool, courteous and exact, she speaks in numbers and treats every quarrel as a question of who owes what.
CHR-0375.wants: Wants the rye paid and peace kept with Urza Ironhide, so the silk caravans keep paying their tenth at Lubany.
CHR-0375.fears: Fears war on the Steppe March closing the silk road and ruining the loans her house has made to the crown.

CHR-0376.name: Oleg Ferrin
CHR-0376.looks: A thick-necked river man of 47 with a broken nose, a heavy fur cloak, and the guild's iron chain on his chest.
CHR-0376.manner: Hearty and loud, he buys rounds for bargemen and talks of fair dealing while his eyes count the room.
CHR-0376.wants: Wants Velgradan fur barges robbed on the Dromir so that Drevnan rivermen win the fur trade.
CHR-0376.fears: Fears that Stas of Korov will be caught and name him as the man who pays for the robberies.

CHR-0377.name: Ivo Kolin
CHR-0377.looks: A broad, wind-burned man of 39 with whale-oil stains on his coat, a harpooner's thick wrists, and a fur hat.
CHR-0377.manner: Blunt and angry, he talks about lost boats and hungry families and says the queen sold the whalers to the giants.
CHR-0377.wants: Wants the ban on killing Frost Leviathans lifted, and Arvo Sealbane's 400 hunter families settled on his Whale Coast.
CHR-0377.fears: Fears the Hrimfell giants coming back to Dobin if they learn that his whalers struck a Frost Leviathan.

CHR-0378.name: Pavel Brodar
CHR-0378.title: Prince-Consort; Master of the Sleds; lake fleet
CHR-0378.looks: A big, weathered man of 52 with a short grey beard, a sled-driver's thick coat, and a lake lord's silver ear-cuff.
CHR-0378.manner: Warm and fatherly in public, he speaks of duty to the realm and never shows the anger he feels.
CHR-0378.wants: Wants the Lake Council to set Ludmila aside under the set-aside clause and make his son Yaromir heir instead.
CHR-0378.fears: Fears Gregor Stillwater finding the drummer and the drummer naming the Prince-Consort.

CHR-0379.name: Stefan the Grey
CHR-0379.looks: A thin, grey-bearded man of 64 in grey monk's robes with a plain wooden lamp on his breast and stooped shoulders.
CHR-0379.manner: Soft-spoken and bitter, he speaks of humility while remembering every slight from the Patriarch of Dawn.
CHR-0379.wants: Wants a free Drevnan church, no longer under the Patriarch of Dawn at Velgrad, and will pay for it with silence.
CHR-0379.fears: Fears Kirill the Lamp-Bearer crowning another Drevnan ruler in his place, as he did in 1085.

CHR-0380.name: Ludmila Dravic
CHR-0380.title: Crown Princess and heir
CHR-0380.looks: A slim, pale woman of 24 with sharp grey eyes, wax plugs often in her ears, and the silver open-ear brooch of her house.
CHR-0380.manner: Quiet, determined and proud, she listens more than she speaks and flinches at any sudden loud noise.
CHR-0380.wants: Wants to prove before the Lake Council that she can lead the army even with the Dravic ears that war-drums can fell.
CHR-0380.fears: Fears the war-drums that made her collapse at Harvest Home, and being set aside in favor of her brother.

CHR-0381.name: Yaromir Dravic
CHR-0381.title: Prince
CHR-0381.looks: A tall, easygoing young man of 20 with fair hair, a beekeeper's sting marks on his hands, and a prince's green cloak.
CHR-0381.manner: Charming and gentle, he avoids hard talk, smiles at everyone, and hopes problems will go away if he waits.
CHR-0381.wants: Wants to stay married to Alena Birchwood and escape the Greyhaven marriage before the oath falls due at Sea Opening.
CHR-0381.fears: Fears his father's anger and the day the court learns that he is already married.

CHR-0382.name: Milena Dravic
CHR-0382.title: Queen of Drevna
CHR-0382.looks: A tall, thin woman of 48 with grey-streaked dark hair, sharp grey eyes, and a silver open-ear crown over a green veil.
CHR-0382.manner: Speaks softly and expects others to do the same, and her silences are more frightening than any shout.
CHR-0382.wants: Wants the Greyhaven match for Yaromir, the rye paid, and the Truce of Dobin held, all before Midsummer.
CHR-0382.fears: Fears the war-drums that fell her line, and a split realm if her husband's party sets her daughter aside.

CHR-0383.name: Nadia Lark
CHR-0383.looks: A small, quick woman of 44 with mousy hair, a plain wool dress, and an ordinary face that people forget at once.
CHR-0383.manner: Gentle and attentive, she asks about people's families and remembers every name she hears.
CHR-0383.wants: Wants to keep the queen informed without being forced to name the Prince-Consort as the man who paid for the drum.
CHR-0383.fears: Fears that her hundred informers will be exposed, since she keeps no written list and only her memory…

CHR-0384.name: Kira Ferryhand
CHR-0384.looks: A strong half-orc woman of 30 with short tusks, rope-scarred hands, and a ferryman's oiled coat and boots.
CHR-0384.manner: Gruff and practical, she says little to strangers and watches the river bank more than the passengers.
CHR-0384.wants: Wants to keep the only witness of the Sevmir burnings alive and hidden until it is safe to speak.
CHR-0384.fears: Fears Hrok Whitehorn's riders finding the witness, and finding her as the one who hid them.

CHR-0385.name: Alena Birchwood
CHR-0385.looks: A small, sturdy girl of 19 with honey-brown hair, sting-marked hands, and a plain blue linen dress.
CHR-0385.manner: Shy with nobles and cheerful with bees, she speaks simply and blushes whenever the prince is mentioned.
CHR-0385.wants: Wants her marriage to Prince Yaromir to be recognized, or at least to keep him without anyone harming him.
CHR-0385.fears: Fears the queen and the Prince-Consort learning of the marriage and sending her far away, or worse.

CHR-0386.name: Stas of Korov
CHR-0386.looks: A rough, lean man of 34 with a scarred face, a matted fur cloak, and a short axe always in his belt.
CHR-0386.manner: Cruel and cheerful, he jokes while he robs and boasts that the river belongs to him at night.
CHR-0386.wants: Wants to rob more Velgradan fur barges on the Dromir and keep Oleg Ferrin's silver flowing this year.
CHR-0386.fears: Fears being caught by the Velgradan barge guards, or abandoned by Oleg Ferrin when the robberies grow too…

CHR-0387.name: Lesko Reedpipe
CHR-0387.looks: A thin, nervous man of 29 with long hands, a cheap reed pipe on a string, and a patched brown coat.
CHR-0387.manner: Jumpy and talkative, he laughs too much and is always ready to run from any room.
CHR-0387.wants: Wants to get out of Drevna with Pavel Brodar's money before Gregor Stillwater finds him.
CHR-0387.fears: Fears Gregor Stillwater, who is hunting him, and Pavel Brodar, who may decide a dead drummer is safer.

CHR-0389.name: Zagra Grassless
CHR-0389.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0389.looks: A hard, lean orc woman of 24 with a shaved head, a cut-off clan braid, and an outcast's ragged felt coat.
CHR-0389.manner: Bitter and fierce, she speaks little, trusts no one, and fights anyone who calls her a guest-killer.
CHR-0389.wants: Wants revenge on Hrok Whitehorn and a road back to her people, by guiding Drevnan crossbows to his camp.
CHR-0389.fears: Fears dying as a nameless outcast, blamed forever for a killing she did not do.

CHR-0390.name: Gregor Stillwater
CHR-0390.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0390.title: Captain of the Listener's Guard
CHR-0390.looks: A quiet, lean man of 44 with soft boots, a grey felt coat, and wax and wool always tucked into a pouch for his ears.
CHR-0390.manner: Calm, patient and terse, he speaks in hand signs to his guards and rarely raises his voice.
CHR-0390.wants: Wants to find the drummer of Harvest Home who felled the princess, and bring him before the queen.
CHR-0390.fears: Fears finding the drummer and learning that the trail leads back to the Prince-Consort himself.

CHR-0391.name: Miron Velic
CHR-0391.looks: A thin, scholarly man of 42 with ink-stained fingers, weak eyes, and a monk's grey robe too large for him.
CHR-0391.manner: Nervous and honest, he speaks precisely and cannot hide his discomfort when lying.
CHR-0391.wants: Wants to reveal his proof that the set-aside clause was forged in 1066, but he is bound to obey Stefan the Grey.
CHR-0391.fears: Fears disobeying Stefan, and fears the Lake Council setting Ludmila aside on a forged law.

CHR-0392.name: Ilya Brenn
CHR-0392.looks: A careful, stooped man of 46 with a neat beard, a physician's leather bag, and a silver ear-cuff gifted by the queen.
CHR-0392.manner: Calm, thorough and discreet, he speaks softly and never discusses a patient without the queen's leave.
CHR-0392.wants: Wants to refuse Pavel Brodar's bribe without making an enemy of the queen's husband.
CHR-0392.fears: Fears that the Prince-Consort will ruin him if he refuses, or that the queen will hang him if he accepts.

CHR-0393.name: Nima of the Still Hands
CHR-0393.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0393.title: Master of the Hall of Still Hands
CHR-0393.looks: A lean man of 55, in dark red monk's wool, whose left hand no longer closes.
CHR-0393.manner: Calm past the point of strangeness, he speaks gently, smiles often, and is the only one in any room who is not afraid.
CHR-0393.wants: Wants the Stair Guard to keep its vow never to kill, even as the Stairs drift toward blood when Tashen dies.
CHR-0393.fears: Fears that the White Stair will arm itself to kill, and that his life's teaching will end with him.

CHR-0394.name: Tsering Snowborn
CHR-0394.title: Captain of the Stair Guard
CHR-0394.looks: A strong, weathered man of 36 with a broad Skyfolk face, a wind-burned nose, and an iron-shod staff over his shoulder.
CHR-0394.manner: Steady and thoughtful, he speaks plainly to his guards and takes long silences before any hard decision.
CHR-0394.wants: Wants the 600 Stair Guards to walk the Bluespire circuit from June to August without one killing that breaks the Truce of 1064.
CHR-0394.fears: Fears having to choose between arming his men with Chanari blades and watching them die unarmed against the…

CHR-0395.name: Dawa Windmane
CHR-0395.looks: A wiry, sun-dark herd-lord of 54 with a long grey braid, a yak-hide coat, and a turquoise ring on each thumb.
CHR-0395.manner: Cheerful and cunning, he jokes about the monks' greed and swears that every salt sack he carries has been taxed.
CHR-0395.wants: Wants to keep running his yak trains to the Lakeland and slip more salt past the abbey toll before the Abbot dies.
CHR-0395.fears: Fears a war between the Stairs closing the high passes and stranding his caravans for a season.

CHR-0396.name: Lhamo Bluewater
CHR-0396.looks: A handsome, sturdy woman of 47 with long black braids, silver and coral in her hair, and a fine heavy wool robe.
CHR-0396.manner: Warm and shrewd, she welcomes every pilgrim and counts the butter and silver they bring as carefully as any banker.
CHR-0396.wants: Wants peace between the Stairs so pilgrims return to her inns, after a year when their silver fell by a third.
CHR-0396.fears: Fears that the hidden robber's body under the cairn will be found and blamed on her house.

CHR-0397.name: Pasang Snowborn
CHR-0397.title: Elder of the Snowborn of Bellcrest
CHR-0397.looks: An old, bow-legged man of 66 with a deeply lined face, thick shoulders from carrying loads, and a fox-fur hat.
CHR-0397.manner: Proud and talkative, he tells guiding stories endlessly and treats his kinship with the Abbot as a mark of honor.
CHR-0397.wants: Wants the next abbot found among the Snowborn households, so his house keeps its place at Skyhold.
CHR-0397.fears: Fears that if Tashen dies and the Red Stair wins, the Snowborn of Bellcrest will lose everything they hold.

CHR-0398.name: Pema
CHR-0398.title: Brother
CHR-0398.looks: A frail, bent old monk of 68 with cloudy eyes, a shaking hand, and a worn saffron robe over many layers of wool.
CHR-0398.manner: Timid and kind, he speaks in a whisper and stops mid-sentence whenever a stranger enters the room.
CHR-0398.wants: Wants the 1061 search diary put into Abbot Tashen's own hands before either faction can seize or burn it.
CHR-0398.fears: Fears dying before the truth is told, and Steward Sonam's guards finding the diary on whoever carries it.

CHR-0399.name: Dechen of Moonstair
CHR-0399.title: Abbess of Moonstair
CHR-0399.looks: A tall, stern woman of 59 with a shaved grey head, dark red robes, and a heavy iron key of Moonstair at her belt.
CHR-0399.manner: Direct and fearless, she asks hard questions in council and listens to the answers without blinking.
CHR-0399.wants: Wants Norbu named the next abbot without a search, healing the split between the Stairs before they come to blood.
CHR-0399.fears: Fears that a new search will crack the White Stair, as the old prophecy warns, and drown the circuit in blood.

CHR-0400.name: Jampa of Sunfold
CHR-0400.looks: A plump, soft-faced monk of 54 with ink on his fingers, a saffron robe, and a bag of small bones and omen-stones.
CHR-0400.manner: Earnest and fussy, he talks about signs and omens at every meal and records every dream told to him.
CHR-0400.wants: Wants to prepare the search monks to find the fourteenth abbot in the true way, as soon as Tashen dies.
CHR-0400.fears: Fears that the Quiet Doubters will cancel the search and that his whole life's training will be wasted.

CHR-0401.name: Sonam of Skyhold
CHR-0401.title: Steward of the White Stair
CHR-0401.looks: A hard-faced, heavy man of 55 with a shaved head, a red robe belted with a steward's key-chain, and thick scarred hands.
CHR-0401.manner: Brisk and commanding, he speaks like a general and tolerates no talk of doubt about the White Stair.
CHR-0401.wants: Wants Tashen kept as Abbot while he lives, and the 40 Chanari blades he bought in secret delivered and issued.
CHR-0401.fears: Fears the Red Stair walking into Skyhold with proof, and Abbess Dechen exposing where the lamp gold went.

CHR-0402.name: Norbu of the Red Stair
CHR-0402.title: Claimant Abbot of the Red Stair (rival)
CHR-0402.looks: A tall, rangy man of 44 with a weathered herder's face, a red felt coat, and an old dragon-bone charm on a thong.
CHR-0402.manner: Patient and certain, he speaks of the sky-kings with reverence and of the White Stair with quiet contempt.
CHR-0402.wants: Wants to take Skyhold when Tashen dies and be set in the White Stair as the abbot who was truly found.
CHR-0402.fears: Fears that the search diary will burn before it reaches him, and with it his proof.

CHR-0403.name: Tashen
CHR-0403.title: Abbot
CHR-0403.looks: A thin, sick man of 52 with sunken cheeks, a dry cough that brings up blood, and the Abbot's saffron and gold robes.
CHR-0403.manner: Gentle and tired, he speaks slowly, pauses to breathe, and thinks long about every word before it is said.
CHR-0403.wants: Wants to settle the succession before he dies, and has a sealed letter of his own ready for Norbu.
CHR-0403.fears: Fears dying with the Stairs at war and his own false election tearing Skyhold apart.

CHR-0404.name: Norzin of Starspire
CHR-0404.looks: A small, neat man of 46 with careful hands, a counting cord at his belt, and salt-burned lips from the trails.
CHR-0404.manner: Exact and nervous, he speaks in figures and avoids looking anyone in the eye when the salt train is mentioned.
CHR-0404.wants: Wants the gold he carried south for Steward Sonam forgotten and the treasury rolls kept tidy and unquestioned.
CHR-0404.fears: Fears Abbess Dechen and her questions about the gifts written in Moonstair's name, which his rolls must cover.

CHR-0405.name: Dorje Stonesling
CHR-0405.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0405.title: Captain of the Bluewater circuit wardens
CHR-0405.looks: A lean, hard man of 44 with a sling wound round his wrist, a herder's felt hat, and a scar on his chin.
CHR-0405.manner: Easygoing on the surface and watchful underneath, he speaks little about the summer of 1104.
CHR-0405.wants: Wants the Bluespire circuit kept safe for Lhamo Bluewater's inns, and the robber under the cairn forgotten.
CHR-0405.fears: Fears his old master Nima learning that he killed a man, and the Red Stair learning who killed their robber.

CHR-0406.name: Jigme Snowborn
CHR-0406.title: Captain of the Snowborn Guides
CHR-0406.looks: A short, barrel-chested man of 46 with frost-scarred cheeks, a coiled yak-hair rope, and thick-soled yak-hide boots.
CHR-0406.manner: Calm and confident in the mountains, he talks little and checks the weather every time he steps outside.
CHR-0406.wants: Wants nobody to learn that he guided Inga Crag's crossbowmen over Skyhold goat paths in 1104.
CHR-0406.fears: Fears a Red Stair curse on the Snowborn Guides if the shot sky-king is ever traced back to his path.

CHR-0407.name: Rinchen of the Lamps
CHR-0407.looks: A slight young monk of 34 with a soot-smudged face, a lamp-keeper's tongs at his belt, and a shaven head.
CHR-0407.manner: Quiet and humble, he seems to notice nothing, and remembers every word spoken near the Abbot's lamps.
CHR-0407.wants: Wants a lay messenger to carry word to Norbu of everything said at the Abbot's sickroom.
CHR-0407.fears: Fears Steward Sonam's guards catching him carrying messages to the Red Stair.

CHR-0408.name: Brenna Ironbrow
CHR-0408.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0408.title: Master of the Pike Hall of Mormund
CHR-0408.looks: A broad, square dwarf woman of 74, young for her people, with a braided red-brown beard-fringe at the jaw and pike-callused hands.
CHR-0408.manner: Brisk and loud on the drill ground, she counts cadence aloud and has no patience for slow feet in a pike block.
CHR-0408.wants: Wants her pikes and Torvald Rockcleaver's axemen ready to march on the Nagora Gate with her brother's Old Toll after the snow.
CHR-0408.fears: Fears her brother Kettil learning the truth about his son's death at the Dwarf's Gate in 1084.

CHR-0409.name: Ulf Deepdelve
CHR-0409.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0409.title: Master of the Hall of Counter-Mines
CHR-0409.looks: A broad, short dwarf of 129, with hands like shovels, a hooded lamp, and his left ear missing.
CHR-0409.manner: Quiet and patient, he speaks softly out of habit and tilts his head to listen even in open air.
CHR-0409.wants: Wants the three walled galleries under the Nagora Gate kept secret and ready, in case the Old Toll marches.
CHR-0409.fears: Fears another race under the stone against Rohan Nagar's miners, who beat him and took his ear in 1084.

CHR-0410.name: Grimbald Stonelung
CHR-0410.title: Thane and Mine-Master; war leader
CHR-0410.looks: A stout dwarf of 142, grey-bearded, limping on his left hip, with a caged finch on his pack.
CHR-0410.manner: Commanding and short-tempered, he talks about ground and digging and thinks most commanders are too slow to attack.
CHR-0410.wants: Wants a Stonehold expedition of his own to the upper Tirana gold and the gold gravels east of Moonstair.
CHR-0410.fears: Fears the gas he cannot smell, which has killed 31 of his kin since 812.

CHR-0411.name: Hela Brightforge
CHR-0411.looks: A stout dwarf woman of 94 in her full strength, with burn-scarred forearms, a leather apron, and a guild clasp of gold and steel.
CHR-0411.manner: Proud and fierce about her craft, she speaks of crucible steel as a sacred trust and of leaks as betrayal.
CHR-0411.wants: Wants to find out who taught the smiths of Chanari their crucible steel, as she swore at the Kindling of 1104.
CHR-0411.fears: Fears that the guild's most sacred secret has already been sold, and that no one will be punished for it.

CHR-0412.name: Orrin Goldvein
CHR-0412.looks: A heavy dwarf of 164 with gold rings braided into a grey beard and a black robe with a gold key at his belt.
CHR-0412.manner: Calm, slow and exact, he speaks in figures and never forgives a debt, however small.
CHR-0412.wants: Wants Tessaria to swear again to the secret tenth of 1004 before he lends Queen Livia anything against the Tirana gold.
CHR-0412.fears: Fears that Ragnhild Tallystone, or someone she tells, will expose his unlawful loan to his own mines.

CHR-0413.name: Kettil Ironbrow
CHR-0413.title: Toll-Warden of Zardeep; leader of the Old Toll
CHR-0413.looks: A grim, heavy dwarf of 103 with a forked iron-grey beard, a toll-warden's chain, and a mourning band of black iron on one arm.
CHR-0413.manner: Bitter and proud, he speaks of the Treaty of Tirpur as a shame carved in stone and of Ranpur with hatred.
CHR-0413.wants: Wants to march on the Nagora Gate in April or May and take back the Dwarf's Gate where his son died.
CHR-0413.fears: Fears that Crown Prince Hrodgar will bargain away the war and leave his son's death unavenged.

CHR-0414.name: Thora Grimstone
CHR-0414.looks: A tiny, ancient dwarf woman of 234 with a white beard braided to her waist, cloudy eyes, and a judge's grey robe.
CHR-0414.manner: Slow, precise and stern, she quotes the Deep Law from memory and never hurries a judgment.
CHR-0414.wants: Wants to call Emberdeep's Carvers to the First Hall on 3 March and prove who taught Chanari its steel.
CHR-0414.fears: Fears dying before the Kindling of December 1105 with her oath unfulfilled and two centuries of judgments…

CHR-0415.name: Hrodgar Bardun
CHR-0415.title: Crown Prince; commands the gate wardens
CHR-0415.looks: A strong, stocky dwarf of 118 with a short brown beard, a Gate Warden's round shield, and a plain iron circlet.
CHR-0415.manner: Calm and practical, he speaks of fewer dead and more trade, and argues with older thanes without losing his temper.
CHR-0415.wants: Wants to bargain with Ranpur for a bigger toll share instead of marching, and to make the climb to the Crown Shelf.
CHR-0415.fears: Fears his father dying before he makes the climb, and thanes who hope he fails it.

CHR-0416.name: Harvald Bardun
CHR-0416.title: King of Stonehold
CHR-0416.looks: A very old dwarf of 214, bent and frail, with a long white beard, trembling hands, and a heavy gold crown he rarely wears.
CHR-0416.manner: Speaks slowly and forgets names, often drifting off in council, though at times his old sharpness returns.
CHR-0416.wants: Wants peace and an orderly passing of the crown to his son Hrodgar before the end of his long life.
CHR-0416.fears: Fears that his failing mind will let others rule in his name, and that the thanes will tear the kingdom apart.

CHR-0417.name: Arn Holdfast
CHR-0417.looks: A short, powerful dwarf of 92 with rock dust in his grey beard, a crushed left hand, and a rescue-master's rope.
CHR-0417.manner: Gruff, kindly and fearless, he speaks plainly about danger and never leaves a trapped miner behind.
CHR-0417.wants: Wants to help Hakon Steamwright shore the secret escape tunnel at Emberdeep before a steam burst kills hundreds.
CHR-0417.fears: Fears another collapse like Morhall in 1079, when he dug out Grimbald's nephew and could not save the others.

CHR-0418.name: Eyvind Graywall
CHR-0418.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0418.title: Shield Elder of the Gate Wardens
CHR-0418.looks: A bald dwarf of 169, with a white beard, a dragging left leg, and a battered round shield.
CHR-0418.manner: Slow-spoken and patient, he says little, without pride, and repeats himself only when he means no.
CHR-0418.wants: Wants the Gate Wardens kept home this spring, and says to Torvald's face that they will not march for the Old Toll.
CHR-0418.fears: Fears having to shut another door on his own men, as he did at the Dwarf's Gate in 1084.

CHR-0419.name: Torvald Rockcleaver
CHR-0419.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0419.title: Master of the Axe Hall of Mormund
CHR-0419.looks: A broad dwarf of 114, with a grey-shot black beard and a bearded axe of Stonehold crucible steel.
CHR-0419.manner: Hot, proud and loud, he argues for war at every table and slams his fist when someone says wait.
CHR-0419.wants: Wants to march on the Nagora Gate with Kettil Ironbrow's Old Toll in spring and drive the Ranpuri out.
CHR-0419.fears: Fears Thora Grimstone finding the Chanari blade he hides, and what Stonehold would do to Emberdeep then.

CHR-0420.name: Snorri Truemark
CHR-0420.looks: A thin, careful dwarf of 99 with a neat brown beard, acid-stained fingers, and an assayer's balance in a leather case.
CHR-0420.manner: Precise and nervous, he answers every question with numbers and avoids talking about his family.
CHR-0420.wants: Wants to delay reporting his assay result, which points to his own mother's clan, the Emberhands.
CHR-0420.fears: Fears that his result will send his kin into exile or blood-price under the Deep Law.

CHR-0421.name: Ragnhild Tallystone
CHR-0421.looks: A plain, quiet dwarf woman of 84 with a tidy brown braid, a clerk's ink-stained sleeves, and a wax tally board.
CHR-0421.manner: Polite, patient and unremarkable, she remembers every figure she has ever copied and says very little.
CHR-0421.wants: Wants to use what she knows about Orrin Goldvein and Kiran Ranavir to win a safe, rich place for herself.
CHR-0421.fears: Fears Orrin Goldvein learning that she holds a copy of his forbidden loan to his own mines.

CHR-0422.name: Inga Crag
CHR-0422.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0422.title: Master of the Kardeep Bolt Yard; captain of the Dragon Watch
CHR-0422.looks: A compact dwarf woman of 79 with a sun-darkened face, a heavy windlass crossbow on her back, and a dragon-scale clasp.
CHR-0422.manner: Cool, practical and proud, she talks about wind and angles and dismisses holy talk about sky-kings as herders' nonsense.
CHR-0422.wants: Wants the shot Great Ash Dragon kept walled up in its gallery and the Kardeep gold mines guarded through spring.
CHR-0422.fears: Fears the Red Stair pilgrims learning who killed their sky-king, and a curse turning Skyhold's herders…

CHR-0423.name: Rolf Hammerhand
CHR-0423.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0423.looks: A massive-armed dwarf of 64 with stiff, hunched shoulders, a short red beard, and a great-hammer slung across his back.
CHR-0423.manner: Loud, hungry and blunt, he eats twice what others do and speaks as if every problem could be hammered flat.
CHR-0423.wants: Wants the sealed galleries of Emberdeep reopened for the forges, though the queen keeps them closed for reasons she will not say.
CHR-0423.fears: Fears his own heart failing young, as it has failed 22 Hammerhands before they reached 190.

CHR-0424.name: Orm Coppertooth
CHR-0424.title: Road-Warden of Tharmund
CHR-0424.looks: A thick-set dwarf of 89 with a copper-capped front tooth, a road-warden's iron chain, and gem rings on three fingers.
CHR-0424.manner: Genial, shrewd and greedy, he chats easily with Ranpuri merchants and always finds a little extra for himself.
CHR-0424.wants: Wants 20,000 more lotus from Ranpur for the queen's road, and his own share of the gems pledged under the Lotus Loan.
CHR-0424.fears: Fears the queen counting the pledged gems and finding one in ten missing.

CHR-0425.name: Sigrun Emberhand
CHR-0425.looks: A powerful dwarf woman of 124 with heat-reddened skin, a scarred leather apron, and a steel rune-ring on her thumb.
CHR-0425.manner: Proud, guarded and curt, she speaks of steel with love and changes the subject whenever Chanari is named.
CHR-0425.wants: Wants the Chanari Compact buried for good, and her old mother Aud kept from crossing the passes to confess.
CHR-0425.fears: Fears exile or blood-price for her clan if Stonehold proves that Emberhands taught Chanari crucible steel.

CHR-0426.name: Dagny Stonelung
CHR-0426.title: Head of the Mine-Masters; Kardeep
CHR-0426.looks: A sturdy dwarf woman of 114 with dust-grey braids, a scarred nose that smells almost nothing, and a mine-master's lamp.
CHR-0426.manner: Shrewd, cheerful and practical, she talks of ore and profit and treats the holy slopes as just more gravel.
CHR-0426.wants: Wants the gold gravels east of Moonstair worked by her cousin Grimbald's people before anyone else stakes them.
CHR-0426.fears: Fears the gas she cannot smell, and the Red Stair's fury if the gold rush spills onto holy ground.

CHR-0427.name: Bolli Ashgrave
CHR-0427.looks: A very old dwarf of 174 with a long grey beard, bent shoulders, and a Carver's iron stylus hanging from his neck.
CHR-0427.manner: Stern and pious, he speaks of the Smith-Father's Breath and calls anyone who talks of leaving the forges faithless.
CHR-0427.wants: Wants the heat of the deep rock kept secret forever and the First Forge never abandoned.
CHR-0427.fears: Fears panic, the flight of the smiths, and the end of Emberdeep's holy forges.

CHR-0428.name: Asta Hammerhand
CHR-0428.title: Forge-Princess and heir; leads the Hammer Guard
CHR-0428.looks: A broad, very strong dwarf woman of 102 with heavy shoulders, a braided black beard-fringe, and the Hammer Guard's red badge.
CHR-0428.manner: Honest and forceful, she argues openly for confession and makes enemies by saying what others whisper.
CHR-0428.wants: Wants Emberdeep to confess the old wrongs of 612 and 950 to Stonehold before they are found out.
CHR-0428.fears: Fears that Thora Grimstone will expose the Chanari Compact first, leaving Emberdeep no mercy.

CHR-0429.name: Hilde Hammerhand
CHR-0429.title: Forge-Queen
CHR-0429.looks: A powerful old dwarf woman of 160 with enormous arms, stiff shoulders, a grey braided beard-fringe, and a red hammer badge.
CHR-0429.manner: Commanding and calm, she speaks little and decides quickly, and she does not explain her reasons.
CHR-0429.wants: Wants the secret escape road to Balmund finished before the deep heat breaks out, without a panic in the hold.
CHR-0429.fears: Fears a steam burst killing hundreds before the tunnel is done, and the smiths fleeing if the truth leaks.

CHR-0430.name: Hakon Steamwright
CHR-0430.looks: A thin, nervous dwarf of 84 with singed eyebrows, a surveyor's tally board, and a steam-burn scar on his neck.
CHR-0430.manner: Careful, worried and honest, he speaks in numbers and grows angry when anyone tries to change them.
CHR-0430.wants: Wants his true heat tallies to reach the Forge-Queen before the spring cutting, and the tunnel shored by Arn Holdfast.
CHR-0430.fears: Fears the tunnel being cut on Bolli's false numbers and a steam burst killing hundreds.

CHR-0431.name: Yrsa Windbellows
CHR-0431.looks: A wiry dwarf woman of 74 with frost scars on her cheeks, a cut-off clan braid, and soot-stained hands.
CHR-0431.manner: Bitter, clever and quick-tongued, she mocks the holds' laws and speaks of her exile with cold fury.
CHR-0431.wants: Wants to sell proof of the Chanari Compact to Stonehold and get her revenge on Bolli Ashgrave.
CHR-0431.fears: Fears Devika Varma, who is hunting her, and being caught and handed back to Emberdeep's judges.

CHR-0432.name: Vigga Blackpick
CHR-0432.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0432.title: Captain of the works guard
CHR-0432.looks: A stocky dwarf woman of 86 with a black war-pick on her belt, a short braided beard-fringe, and a works guard's mail.
CHR-0432.manner: Brusque and watchful, she follows orders without question and reports everything she sees.
CHR-0432.wants: Wants to report every step of the queen's secret tunnel to Eldest Carver Bolli without being caught.
CHR-0432.fears: Fears the queen discovering that the captain of her own works guard is spying for the Eldest Carver.

CHR-0433.name: Kolbein Bearbane
CHR-0433.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0433.looks: A big, weathered dwarf of 104 with a bear-claw necklace, a scarred face, and a hunter's fur cloak.
CHR-0433.manner: Boastful and greedy, he tells hunting stories loudly and keeps quiet only when he has been paid.
CHR-0433.wants: Wants to stake the gold gravels east of Moonstair this spring, even on ground the Red Stair calls holy.
CHR-0433.fears: Fears the Red Stair pilgrims, and the Forge-Queen's anger if he talks about the steam.

CHR-0434.name: Aud Emberhand
CHR-0434.looks: A tiny, ancient dwarf woman of 199 with a white braided beard-fringe, burned and twisted hands, and failing eyes.
CHR-0434.manner: Gentle, slow and remorseful, she speaks of old forges with love and of her sin with sorrow.
CHR-0434.wants: Wants to cross the passes to Stonehold in June and confess the Chanari Compact before she dies.
CHR-0434.fears: Fears dying with her sin unconfessed, and her daughter Sigrun stopping her from making the journey.

CHR-0435.name: Bala Mallik
CHR-0435.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0435.looks: A wiry, dark man of 59 with an elephant-driver's hooked goad, grey stubble, and an old tusk scar across his ribs.
CHR-0435.manner: Patient and soft-spoken, he talks to elephants more than to people and never shouts near a beast.
CHR-0435.wants: Wants Prince Vikram's visit to Nagita to pass without the boy seeing the pale cow he trained to kneel.
CHR-0435.fears: Fears being named as the man who trained the false calf if the fraud is exposed after Moon-Pearl dies.

CHR-0436.name: Kavi Rane
CHR-0436.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0436.looks: A small, quick man of 44, with a smith's forearms and a Chanari crucible-steel blade at his hip.
CHR-0436.manner: Cold and calm, he calls himself a smith who cuts, and speaks more fondly of steel than of any person.
CHR-0436.wants: Wants a Raja who will keep the Chanari Compact, and has promised Kiran Ranavir the Steel Guard if Prince Vikram fails.
CHR-0436.fears: Fears what Stonehold will do to Chanari once Thora Grimstone proves that dwarves taught it crucible steel.

CHR-0437.name: Rohan Nagar
CHR-0437.title: Warden of the Nagora March; commander of the army
CHR-0437.looks: A tall, heavy-set man of 49 with a soldier's scarred hands, gold earrings, and a saffron sash over his mail.
CHR-0437.manner: Confident and direct, he talks of roads, forts and gold, and treats the dwarves of Stonehold as old enemies.
CHR-0437.wants: Wants to push trade and soldiers past Nagora and get Ranpur into the race for the upper Tirana gold.
CHR-0437.fears: Fears the new Amberport toll farmer arriving at Tirpur and finding his two toll books.

CHR-0438.name: Amar Sethi
CHR-0438.looks: A smooth, well-fed man of 38 in fine indigo cotton, with a trimmed beard, gold rings, and a merchant's ledger case.
CHR-0438.manner: Persuasive and warm, he talks of one god and fair loans and is always ready with money for a good cause.
CHR-0438.wants: Wants the One Face to win the next Raja and break the temples' land, courts and 12% loans.
CHR-0438.fears: Fears the temple families learning that he secretly pays Dev the Unbound to burn their ledgers.

CHR-0439.name: Ravi Lohar
CHR-0439.looks: A broad, soot-darkened man of 50 with burn scars up both arms, a heavy leather apron, and a blacksmith's thick neck.
CHR-0439.manner: Gruff, proud and practical, he talks steel and money and scorns the Varma wardens who count his every blade.
CHR-0439.wants: Wants to finish and deliver the 40 Chanari blades for Skyhold without Devika Varma finding them.
CHR-0439.fears: Fears Devika Varma discovering his hidden mill and the blades forged off her tally.

CHR-0440.name: Devika Varma
CHR-0440.looks: A tall, severe woman of 41 in dark saffron silk, with gold earrings, a steel-warden's key, and sharp, tired eyes.
CHR-0440.manner: Cold and suspicious, she counts blades and smiths and treats every visitor to Chanari as a possible thief.
CHR-0440.wants: Wants to catch the dwarven exile Yrsa Windbellows and every blade forged outside her tally.
CHR-0440.fears: Fears the Stonehold Carvers proving the Chanari Compact, which would cut Chanari off from Emberdeep.

CHR-0441.name: Hari Mallik
CHR-0441.title: Master of Elephants
CHR-0441.looks: A heavy, grey-haired man of 54 with a broad face, gold earrings, and the elephant badge of House Mallik on his sash.
CHR-0441.manner: Proud and boastful, he talks of his elephants like sons and of their prices like a merchant.
CHR-0441.wants: Wants his illegal sale of 30 war elephants in 1103 to stay buried in the Amberport market roll.
CHR-0441.fears: Fears the Well-Keepers' audit of the Amberport roll, where his own forbidden sale sits beside the false calf.

CHR-0442.name: Kiran Ranavir
CHR-0442.looks: A handsome man of 43 in rich silks, with gold rings, a trimmed beard, and a Chanari sword he wears with pride.
CHR-0442.manner: Charming and ambitious, he gives lavish gifts and speaks of duty to the house while counting the prince's fevers.
CHR-0442.wants: Wants to be named heir in sickly Prince Vikram's place, and courts Govind the Elder with costly gifts.
CHR-0442.fears: Fears his secret Hold Bank debt of 30,000 lotus becoming known before he is named heir.

CHR-0443.name: Sanjay Dhar
CHR-0443.looks: A thin, balding man of 52 with ink-stained fingers, a squint from long reading, and a plain white cotton robe.
CHR-0443.manner: Dry, careful and blunt, he counts every coin and hates every foreign debt.
CHR-0443.wants: Wants Prince Vikram kept safe as heir and the Nagora tolls fairly counted, so the Hold Bank is paid on time.
CHR-0443.fears: Fears that the sale of the Nagora toll farm will expose the short-paid tolls and bring Stonehold to war.

CHR-0444.name: Govind the Elder
CHR-0444.looks: A frail, white-bearded man of 68 in saffron and white robes, with heavy gold rings and a priest's sandalwood beads.
CHR-0444.manner: Slow, gracious and unyielding, he speaks softly of the thousand gods and firmly of the temples' rights.
CHR-0444.wants: Wants the temples to choose the next Raja if Prince Vikram fails, and the One Face crushed for good.
CHR-0444.fears: Fears the merchants taking their money to Amberport, and the temples losing their land and courts.

CHR-0445.name: Anand
CHR-0445.title: Keeper
CHR-0445.looks: A stout, mild-looking man of 56 with a shaved head, white temple robes, and the White Stable's silver bangle.
CHR-0445.manner: Pious and polished, he speaks of Moon-Pearl with love and of her calf as already blessed.
CHR-0445.wants: Wants the pale young elephant shown as Moon-Pearl's calf when she dies, and the 1101 sale entry cut from the Amberport roll.
CHR-0445.fears: Fears the Well-Keepers' January audit finding the sale entry before his agent can remove it.

CHR-0446.name: Vikram Ranavir
