CHR-0446.looks: A thin, pale boy of 11 with large dark eyes, a sickly cough, and fine silk robes too heavy for him.
CHR-0446.manner: Polite and eager, he asks many questions and hides his weakness, wanting very much to be thought strong.
CHR-0446.wants: Wants to visit Nagita and see the elephants, and to pass his next arsenic test before the court.
CHR-0446.fears: Fears the yearly arsenic test that made him sick in 1102, and his cousin Kiran's smiling attention.

CHR-0447.name: Indrajit Ranavir
CHR-0447.title: Raja of Ranpur
CHR-0447.looks: A tall, heavy man of 46 with gold earrings, a dark beard, and silk robes of saffron and white embroidered with lotuses.
CHR-0447.manner: Courteous and tired, he listens to every faction and decides as late as he can.
CHR-0447.wants: Wants his son Vikram to live and inherit, and Ranpur to win a share of the upper Tirana gold.
CHR-0447.fears: Fears his only son dying and the temples choosing the next Raja from among his rivals.

CHR-0448.name: Jiva Pala
CHR-0448.looks: A lean, sun-darkened man of 54 with an elephant keeper's calloused hands, a plain cotton wrap, and a gentle face.
CHR-0448.manner: Simple, honest and quiet, he speaks lovingly about the pale cow and nervously about the priests.
CHR-0448.wants: Wants to keep the pale cow healthy and hidden on the temple estate near Nagita, as Keeper Anand commands.
CHR-0448.fears: Fears that the priests will blame him if anyone finds the pale cow before Moon-Pearl dies.

CHR-0449.name: Dev the Unbound
CHR-0449.looks: A gaunt, wiry man of 34 with debt-brands on his arms, a ragged headcloth, and a sickle at his belt.
CHR-0449.manner: Fierce and righteous, he speaks for the debtors and gives stolen rice to the poor.
CHR-0449.wants: Wants to burn the temple ledgers that bind thousands of debtors to the temple fields.
CHR-0449.fears: Fears being caught and dragged back to work the temple fields, as a broken debtor.

CHR-0450.name: Mahesh Scarback
CHR-0450.looks: A rough man of 44 with a whip-scarred back, a robber's patched coat, and a long knife in his sash.
CHR-0450.manner: Cynical and greedy, he sells whatever he hears and laughs at people who talk about loyalty.
CHR-0450.wants: Wants to keep selling road news to the Old Toll of Stonehold until their spring march.
CHR-0450.fears: Fears Rohan Nagar's road patrols, who hang robbers on the Nagora road.

CHR-0451.name: Meera Jalan
CHR-0451.looks: A slight, fiery young woman of 26 with bright eyes, a plain indigo wrap, and a bruise from the temple guards.
CHR-0451.manner: Passionate and clear, she preaches the One Face on the River Steps and draws crowds of thousands.
CHR-0451.wants: Wants to preach the One Face to every corner of Ranpur and break the power of the temple families.
CHR-0451.fears: Fears the knife in the crowd that nobody can name, and the temple guards who dragged her from the Great…

CHR-0452.name: Nikhil Das
CHR-0452.looks: A sleek, quiet man of 32 in a merchant's plain cotton, with ink-stained fingers and a small knife hidden in his sleeve.
CHR-0452.manner: Polite and patient, he waits for the right moment and always seems to be just passing through.
CHR-0452.wants: Wants to cut the 1101 sale entry from the Amberport market roll after the Well-Keepers' January audit.
CHR-0452.fears: Fears the audit clerks finding the entry first, and the Vizier's watcher Musa Kerang, who saw the bribe.

CHR-0453.name: Tara Moti
CHR-0453.looks: A plump, motherly woman of 36 with a kind face, a nurse's white cotton wrap, and nervous, restless hands.
CHR-0453.manner: Warm and protective with the prince, she grows quiet and evasive whenever anyone asks about his health.
CHR-0453.wants: Wants to water Prince Vikram's next arsenic dose so he passes the test and nobody learns he failed before.
CHR-0453.fears: Fears being discovered as Kiran Ranavir's paid informer, and the prince dying of the next dose.

CHR-0454.name: Nuri Salleh
CHR-0454.looks: A lean, deep-chested man of 34 with salt-cracked skin, reddened eyes from diving, and a shark-tooth knife on a cord.
CHR-0454.manner: Cheerful and modest, he jokes with his divers and goes silent whenever anyone mentions the pearl banks.
CHR-0454.wants: Wants to keep his divers working the Isle of Pearls banks in secret before the Sultan's fleet claims them.
CHR-0454.fears: Fears Admiral Jaya Rawang learning that the Rusiing divers have worked the banks for years without a share to…

CHR-0455.name: Fikri Laut
CHR-0455.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0455.title: Master of the Rowing Hall of Tekook
CHR-0455.looks: A strong, broad-backed man of 38 with oar-thickened hands, a shaved head, and a batik wrap tied for rowing.
CHR-0455.manner: Loud and cheerful, he leads with chants and drums and judges men by how long they can pull an oar.
CHR-0455.wants: Wants to fill the 1,100 empty places on his rowing rolls before the fleet sails for the Isle of Pearls on 1 April.
CHR-0455.fears: Fears the fleet sailing short-handed, with green rowers who break at the first ram.

CHR-0456.name: Hamzah Batu
CHR-0456.title: Warden of the Highlands
CHR-0456.looks: A hard, lean man of 42 with a wyrm-bite scar on his thigh, a headcloth of green batik, and a heavy spear.
CHR-0456.manner: Gruff and secretive, he talks loudly of crushing the hill tribes and quietly of amber-gum prices.
CHR-0456.wants: Wants 1,000 more spearmen from the court while keeping his secret truce with the Cloud Ridge clan.
CHR-0456.fears: Fears the court learning that he pays the wyrm bounty while bargaining with the clan he calls his worst enemy.

CHR-0457.name: Jaya Rawang
CHR-0457.title: Admiral of the Fleet
CHR-0457.looks: A tall, sea-weathered man of 44 with a grey-shot beard, pearl earrings, and an admiral's green and gold sash.
CHR-0457.manner: Bold and ambitious, he talks of conquest and honor and makes promises faster than he can keep them.
CHR-0457.wants: Wants to claim the Isle of Pearls with Keshi ships when the fleet sails at Sea Opening on 1 April.
CHR-0457.fears: Fears the fleet failing for lack of rowers or pilots, and his secret promise to Jabari Tide coming out.

CHR-0458.name: Bakar the Wyrm-Killer
CHR-0458.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0458.title: Master of the Spear Yard of Aming
CHR-0458.looks: A huge, scarred man of 45 with wyrm-claw marks down one arm, a heavy hunting spear, and a necklace of wyrm teeth.
CHR-0458.manner: Boastful and fearless, he tells hunting stories with relish and is impatient with townsmen.
CHR-0458.wants: Wants to keep earning the Warden's wyrm bounty, and is being asked by Keeper Anand to catch another pale calf.
CHR-0458.fears: Fears his part in the false calf being found, and the Zanari tracker who salted the resold heads near his…

CHR-0459.name: Bayu Karang
CHR-0459.title: Master of Pilots
CHR-0459.looks: A wiry, weathered man of 47 with sharp eyes, a pilot's sun-darkened face, and a locked wooden box at his side.
CHR-0459.manner: Proud and secretive, he speaks of reefs and tides with authority and refuses any question about how he steers.
CHR-0459.wants: Wants no Keshi pilot aboard the joint fleet, so the secret of the lodestone needle stays with Amberport's pilots.
CHR-0459.fears: Fears the needle secret spreading, which would end his house's power over the reef channels.

CHR-0460.name: Dewi Merah
CHR-0460.looks: A tall, elegant woman of 46 with gold and pearl jewelry, clove-scented hair, and a rich batik gown.
CHR-0460.manner: Proud and sharp-tongued, she speaks openly against the Grand Vizier and never forgets that her cloves were burned.
CHR-0460.wants: Wants the clove prices kept high and the Madamo harbor fees restored, and refuses to pay for the Pearl war.
CHR-0460.fears: Fears that the Sultan will burn her cloves again, as his men did in 1101.

CHR-0461.name: Rahim Sulong
CHR-0461.looks: A thin, grey-bearded man of 55 of Qadiri blood with a clerk's stooped shoulders and a vizier's gold chain.
CHR-0461.manner: Calm, careful and calculating, he speaks of money and treaties and never reveals his own wishes.
CHR-0461.wants: Wants to pay for the Pearl war and keep the spice monopoly, and is weighing Hamisi Monuri's offer of ships.
CHR-0461.fears: Fears the clove lords refusing the spice fifth and the treasury running dry before the fleet returns.

CHR-0462.name: Hamid Sari
CHR-0462.looks: An old, dignified man of 59 with a white beard, a plain white robe, and the copper well-ring of his office.
CHR-0462.manner: Grave, fair and stubborn, he speaks the Book of Wells from memory and does not bend to the Sultan.
CHR-0462.wants: Wants the Sultan to name a storm-sensing heir before the fleet sails, and the January audit done honestly.
CHR-0462.fears: Fears the realm left without a proven heir if the Sultan dies at sea with no successor named.

CHR-0463.name: Iskandar Maruang
CHR-0463.title: Sultan, Guardian of the Water
CHR-0463.looks: A strong, handsome man of 40 with a trimmed beard, gold and pearls at his throat, and a habit of rubbing his ears.
CHR-0463.manner: Charming and cunning, he talks of friendship with the Keshi while planning to turn on them.
CHR-0463.wants: Wants to take the Isle of Pearls on 1 April with Keshi ships and then turn on the Keshi themselves.
CHR-0463.fears: Fears the cyclone season's headaches, and a court split between his two sons over the storm-sense.

CHR-0464.name: Lintang Cloudwalker
CHR-0464.looks: A lean, tattooed hill man of 36 with long hair tied up, a bark-cloth wrap, and a blowpipe on his back.
CHR-0464.manner: Proud and watchful, he speaks little to lowlanders and keeps every promise he makes.
CHR-0464.wants: Wants his clan fed and safe through 1105 under his secret bargain with Warden Hamzah Batu.
CHR-0464.fears: Fears his own clan learning that he bargained with the man whose Spears killed his father in 1086.

CHR-0465.name: Musa Kerang
CHR-0465.looks: A slight, smiling young man of 29 with a neat headcloth, a courtier's soft hands, and a shell bead bracelet.
CHR-0465.manner: Friendly and attentive, he is everyone's helpful acquaintance and nobody's close friend.
CHR-0465.wants: Wants to get Corwin Saltmarsh's map of the Isle of Pearls interior for the Vizier, and a copy for Kesh.
CHR-0465.fears: Fears either of his masters learning that he reports to both Amberport and Kesh.

CHR-0466.name: Arif Senyap
CHR-0466.looks: A silent, heavy-set man of 41 with a pilot's sun-darkened face, scarred hands, and a knife never far from the needle box.
CHR-0466.manner: Quiet and grim, he answers in grunts and watches everyone who comes near the pilot's station.
CHR-0466.wants: Wants the needle bowl kept hidden from every Keshi eye on the joint fleet, even if he must sink a ship.
CHR-0466.fears: Fears failing his oath to guard the needle, which he values more than his own life.

CHR-0467.name: Faris Bahri
CHR-0467.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0467.looks: A thick-set, sea-tanned man of 46 with rope-burned palms, a white head-cloth, and a boarding axe at his belt.
CHR-0467.manner: Earnest and thorough, he drills marines endlessly and speaks of fire at sea with more confidence than knowledge.
CHR-0467.wants: Wants the stolen Sabran fire-oil jar so he can test his wet hides before the fleet sails on Sabra.
CHR-0467.fears: Fears that his wet hides will fail against real fire-oil and that the fleet will burn as it did before.

CHR-0468.name: Nabil Tarsi
CHR-0468.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0468.title: Warden of the Sabun
CHR-0468.looks: A hard, lean man of 41 with a mountain soldier's sun-darkened face, a short beard, and a curved sword at his hip.
CHR-0468.manner: Watchful and careful, he speaks little, keeps his promises to his own men, and waits to see which side wins.
CHR-0468.wants: Wants to hold the Sabun Pass and see which way the war with Sabra turns before he commits his men.
CHR-0468.fears: Fears his father's debts and war-talk dragging the Tarsi house into a war it cannot win.

CHR-0469.name: Jalal Zahiri
CHR-0469.title: Grand Admiral; Bahesh Party
CHR-0469.looks: A broad, bearded man of 44 with a weathered sailor's face, an admiral's green sash, and pain lines from kidney stones.
CHR-0469.manner: Bold, impatient and proud, he speaks of the fleet as his own creation and of Sabra as stolen land.
CHR-0469.wants: Wants to sail on Sabra after 1 April with his 34 galleys while the fleet is new and the Sultan lies sick.
CHR-0469.fears: Fears losing a second fleet to Sabra's fire-oil, as Qadir lost 19 galleys before.

CHR-0470.name: Hamid the Papermaker
CHR-0470.looks: A thin, white-bearded man of 55 with rag-dust on his robe, stained fingers, and a mill family's brass stamp on a cord.
CHR-0470.manner: Grave and worried, he speaks for the mill families with dignity and grows quiet when Rafiq the Quiet is near.
CHR-0470.wants: Wants his two great-nephews, the runaway journeymen Adil and Hakim, brought home alive before they are outlawed.
CHR-0470.fears: Fears that the paper craft will leave Qadir with the journeymen, and that they will die for it.

CHR-0471.name: Nadira Hassani
CHR-0471.looks: A tall, handsome woman of 42 with a shipowner's sharp eyes, a fine blue linen robe, and pearl earrings.
CHR-0471.manner: Cool, polite and firm, she speaks of trade and peace and does not raise her voice even when she refuses.
CHR-0471.wants: Wants peace and sea trade, and holds back the rowers' pay so the Grand Admiral's fleet cannot sail.
CHR-0471.fears: Fears losing the 200,000 suns her house has lent the crown if the fleet burns in a war on Sabra.

CHR-0472.name: Rasha the Ragwoman
CHR-0472.looks: A stout, loud woman of 53 with a ragpicker's strong hands, a dusty head-cloth, and a bundle of tally sticks.
CHR-0472.manner: Brash and quick-witted, she quarrels loudly in public and does her real business in whispers.
CHR-0472.wants: Wants the rag trade kept flowing to Qadir's mills and the Rag Compact price kept where it is.
CHR-0472.fears: Fears the shroud trade with Ankhu the Embalmer coming out, which could cost both their lives.

CHR-0473.name: Salim the Pilot
CHR-0473.looks: A weathered, grey-bearded man of 54 with squinting sea-eyes, a pilot's staff, and a sun-faded blue head-cloth.
CHR-0473.manner: Cautious and stubborn, he talks of winds and seasons and refuses to guide any fleet out of season.
CHR-0473.wants: Wants to keep carrying the mills' paper safely by sea and keep his pilots out of the admiral's war.
CHR-0473.fears: Fears being forced to guide the war fleet past the Bone Coast in bad weather.

CHR-0474.name: Bashir Tarsi
CHR-0474.title: Emir of Mirad
CHR-0474.looks: A heavy, proud man of 56 with a dyed black beard, a gold-threaded robe, and an old-fashioned emir's turban.
CHR-0474.manner: Pompous and warlike, he signs only as Emir of Basir and talks of retaking the lower Bahesh.
CHR-0474.wants: Wants war on Sabra so the Tarsi date lands on the lower Bahesh can be won back.
CHR-0474.fears: Fears his secret debt to the Water Endowment being called in before the war brings him land.

CHR-0475.name: Idris Qasimi
CHR-0475.title: Emir of Basim
CHR-0475.looks: A lean, sharp-faced man of 49 with a copper merchant's green-stained hands, olive oil in his beard, and fine white robes.
CHR-0475.manner: Smooth and quiet, he speaks of olives and loyalty and never mentions copper sales over the pass.
CHR-0475.wants: Wants his copper trains to keep crossing the Sabun Pass to Sabra, whatever the Divan decides.
CHR-0475.fears: Fears the Sultan learning that Qasimi copper becomes the boiling pans of Sabra's fire-oil sheds.

CHR-0476.name: Omar the Patient
CHR-0476.looks: A small, grey old man of 63 with a neat white beard, ink-stained cuffs, and a vizier's plain dark robe.
CHR-0476.manner: Patient, dry and suspicious, he trusts nobody under 50 and answers most questions with silence.
CHR-0476.wants: Wants to keep the Divan from voting for war, and is weighing Walid Hazimi's secret offer of a vassal's peace.
CHR-0476.fears: Fears the Sultan dying with the realm split between war and peace.

CHR-0477.name: Yusuf Alami
CHR-0477.looks: A tall, thin old man of 68 with a long white beard, a plain white robe, and the Keeper's copper water-cup.
CHR-0477.manner: Stern and learned, he quotes the Book of Wells and speaks to sultans as an equal.
CHR-0477.wants: Wants to declare the war on Sabra against the Book on Well Day, 14 March, and keep the Well-Keepers above the Sultan.
CHR-0477.fears: Fears Tariq Bahar reading the contract of Zahir aloud at the Well, which would shame the dynasty.

CHR-0478.name: Samir Zahiri
CHR-0478.title: Commander of the Guard of the Water Jar
CHR-0478.looks: A tall, slender young man of 23 with a thin beard, a guardsman's green coat, and a pale, strained face.
CHR-0478.manner: Courteous and calm, he speaks for peace and hides any sign of pain behind a polite smile.
CHR-0478.wants: Wants peace with Sabra and his uncle's war stopped before the fleet sails on 1 April.
CHR-0478.fears: Fears kidney stones killing him young, as they killed his grandfather and now trouble his father.

CHR-0479.name: Zahir IV Zahiri
CHR-0479.title: Sultan, Guardian of the Water
CHR-0479.looks: A gaunt, sallow man of 47 lying in white linen, with a ruler's ringed hands and a carved cup always beside him.
CHR-0479.manner: Weak and suspicious, he speaks in short breaths and trusts nothing he has not tasted himself.
CHR-0479.wants: Wants to live through the stones, and to settle with Sabra by war or peace before he dies.
CHR-0479.fears: Fears poison above all, and drinks only from the 'unicorn horn' cup Mosi III sold him.

CHR-0480.name: Rafiq the Quiet
CHR-0480.title: Master of Doors
CHR-0480.looks: A small, neat man of 52 with a forgettable face, soft shoes, and a plain grey robe without ornament.
CHR-0480.manner: Soft-voiced and patient, he never threatens anyone and never needs to.
CHR-0480.wants: Wants the two runaway paper journeymen found before the craft reaches Ranpur, and the stolen Sabran jar bought.
CHR-0480.fears: Fears that Qadir's rag-paper monopoly, held since about 880, will be lost on his watch.

CHR-0481.name: Samira the Sieve
CHR-0481.looks: A wiry woman of 33 with a sharp face, rag-dust in her hair, and calloused hands from a lifetime of sorting.
CHR-0481.manner: Brash and funny, she bargains hard and boasts that nothing leaves Qadira without her carts.
CHR-0481.wants: Wants to keep her rag carts moving out of Qadira every night without the Master of Doors searching them.
CHR-0481.fears: Fears Rafiq the Quiet learning that she smuggled the journeymen out in rag bales.

CHR-0482.name: Kamal the Eel
CHR-0482.looks: A slippery, thin man of 38 with a boatman's tar-stained hands, oiled black hair, and a constant grin.
CHR-0482.manner: Talkative and charming, he says what each listener wants to hear and keeps several stories going at once.
CHR-0482.wants: Wants to carry the two journeymen to Marira when the sea opens on 1 April and collect his pay.
CHR-0482.fears: Fears his master Rafiq the Quiet learning that his own informer moved the journeymen behind his back.

CHR-0483.name: Anwar Rashidi
CHR-0483.looks: A thin, bright-eyed scholar of 35 with dust in his beard, ink on his fingers, and a satchel of copied texts.
CHR-0483.manner: Excited and talkative about his finds, he forgets danger and argues with anyone about old words.
CHR-0483.wants: Wants to publish the lost saying of Samar that he found at Zarak, whatever it costs the Well-Keepers.
CHR-0483.fears: Fears Ayub the Deep chiseling off the old marks on the Well shaft before his find can be proved.

CHR-0484.name: Hala Nasiri
CHR-0484.looks: A quiet, plain woman of 36 in a modest dark robe and head-cloth, with clever hands and a soft voice.
CHR-0484.manner: Calm, agreeable and unremarkable, she listens carefully and seems never to have an opinion.
CHR-0484.wants: Wants to buy the fire-oil jar and the runaway boiler for Rafiq, while selling each offer to Faisal the Broker.
CHR-0484.fears: Fears Rafiq the Quiet discovering that his own agent reports to Sabra.

CHR-0485.name: Dalia Sharif
CHR-0485.looks: A pleasant young woman of 30 with a nurse's white linen, gentle hands, and calm dark eyes.
CHR-0485.manner: Soft-spoken and kind with the sick, she listens to everything said around the Sultan's bed.
CHR-0485.wants: Wants to send Tahir Sabrani word of the day the Qadiri fleet sails.
CHR-0485.fears: Fears being caught by Rafiq the Quiet's men while passing reports through the Qasimi mule trains.

CHR-0486.name: Ahmose the Mason
CHR-0486.looks: A frail, bony old man of 73 with stone-cracked hands, a mason's bent back, and clouded eyes, lying on a reed mat.
CHR-0486.manner: Drowsy and confused from poppy, he mumbles about stone and water and wakes in sudden fright.
CHR-0486.wants: Wants a Talim priest at his deathbed so he can confess what he cut on the Flood Stairs in 1089.
CHR-0486.fears: Fears dying unconfessed, with the lie of the flood mark on his soul before the Flood Mother.

CHR-0487.name: Hapu the Reed
CHR-0487.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0487.title: Master of the Reed School of Marira; captain of the Ibis Archers
CHR-0487.looks: A lean, wiry man of 42 with long arms, a reed-cutter's scarred hands, a white linen kilt, and a short Tamari bow.
CHR-0487.manner: Sly and mocking, he jokes about tall shields and teaches his archers to shoot from boats and reeds.
CHR-0487.wants: Wants the Ibis Archers to prove themselves in the coming year, and to show Intef the Shield that a tall shield is a target.
CHR-0487.fears: Fears the delta fever, which has taken more of his archers than any enemy.

CHR-0488.name: Intef the Shield
CHR-0488.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0488.title: Master of the House of the Shield; captain of the Sons of the Mother
CHR-0488.looks: A lean, dark, shaven-headed man of 48, with a shaking left forearm and a 1.4 m ox-hide tall shield.
CHR-0488.manner: Even, slow to speak and steady, his voice carries over a fight, and he never raises it in peace.
CHR-0488.wants: Wants the Flood Stairs and the palace held through 1105 for the Flood Mother's son, whatever the mason confesses.
CHR-0488.fears: Fears his bad knees and failing forearm letting the wall break when the king needs it most.

CHR-0489.name: Rahotep Kadari
CHR-0489.title: General of the River
CHR-0489.looks: A heavy, scarred soldier of 52 with a shaven head, a bronze-plated leather cap, and a general's collar of gold beads.
CHR-0489.manner: Bitter and forceful, he speaks of Kadah's burning as if it were yesterday and of Tessaria with hatred.
CHR-0489.wants: Wants blood-price for Kadah from Tessar by offering Prince Andros ten river galleys and a copy of the sealed Kadah order.
CHR-0489.fears: Fears the king learning that his own general has made a secret offer to a foreign prince.

CHR-0490.name: Ankhu the Embalmer
CHR-0490.looks: A gaunt, stooped man of 57 with resin-stained hands, a shaved head, and a linen apron that smells of natron.
CHR-0490.manner: Gloomy and quarrelsome in public, he shouts at the Qadiri rag-buyers and whispers with them at night.
CHR-0490.wants: Wants the secret shroud trade with Rasha the Ragwoman kept hidden and the linen kept flowing.
CHR-0490.fears: Fears the drowning law for tomb robbers, which would fall on him if the shroud trade came out.

CHR-0491.name: Nofret the Weaver
CHR-0491.looks: A sturdy woman of 45 with thread-cut fingers, a fine white sheath dress, and a bead collar of blue faience.
CHR-0491.manner: Brisk and ambitious, she talks prices with everyone and changes the subject when asked about her workshop.
CHR-0491.wants: Wants the Rag Compact price raised and her stolen spinning wheel built and working before anyone finds it.
CHR-0491.fears: Fears Nella Brisa of Varenna finding the stolen wheel she is building in secret.

CHR-0492.name: Pashed the Boatman
CHR-0492.looks: A broad, weathered boatman of 51 with sun-black skin, a river captain's staff, and a linen kilt stained with mud.
CHR-0492.manner: Cheerful and greedy, he jokes about the river and never asks what his passengers carry.
CHR-0492.wants: Wants to carry the two Qadiri journeymen up the Monuti toward Ranpur and collect his fee.
CHR-0492.fears: Fears Qadir's Master of Doors and the river patrols that check boats on the Monuti.

CHR-0493.name: Yunus Marari
CHR-0493.looks: A plump, well-dressed man of 50 with a neat beard, Qadiri-style robes, and a harbor-master's bronze seal.
CHR-0493.manner: Polite and patient, he speaks for the Delta Wells calmly and never shows his anger at the temples.
CHR-0493.wants: Wants believers of the Path of the Well to hold temple land and office, and plans to petition the king on 1 March.
CHR-0493.fears: Fears that if the king falls, the Talim priests and not the Delta Wells will take power.

CHR-0494.name: Seti the Scribe
CHR-0494.looks: A thin, precise man of 59 with a shaven head, ink-stained fingers, and a scribe's palette hanging from his belt.
CHR-0494.manner: Calm and formal, he speaks in court phrases and records everything he hears.
CHR-0494.wants: Wants the courts, scribes and corvée rolls run smoothly while the king's flood crisis passes.
CHR-0494.fears: Fears being blamed for the king's troubles if the 1089 mark is exposed.

CHR-0495.name: Djedi Senmut
CHR-0495.looks: A tall, stern man of 54 with a shaven head, a priest's white linen, and a gold flood-measure on a chain.
CHR-0495.manner: Grave and ambitious, he speaks of the faith's law and of the king's duty with careful menace.
CHR-0495.wants: Wants the Talim priests over the Tamar temple, and over the king if the flood fails again.
CHR-0495.fears: Fears Menna's temple guards reaching old Ahmose first and silencing him forever.

CHR-0496.name: Menna the Measurer
CHR-0496.looks: A stooped old man of 66 with a shaven head, a wig for rites, white linen, and a measuring rod of black wood.
CHR-0496.manner: Learned and calm, he speaks of the river with love and of his rivals with cold contempt.
CHR-0496.wants: Wants the king kept on his throne and the 1089 secret buried, while he calls the 1105 flood crest.
CHR-0496.fears: Fears a third lean flood, which would strip the king of his right to rule by the faith's own law.

CHR-0497.name: Khaset Tamaren
CHR-0497.looks: A slight, quiet boy of 8 with a shaven head and side-lock, fine white linen, and a left eye that wanders.
CHR-0497.manner: Shy and watchful, he turns his head to see with his right eye and hides it whenever he can.
CHR-0497.wants: Wants to be a good prince and to please his father at the Harvest of the Mother.
CHR-0497.fears: Fears that someone will notice his weak eye and say he cannot be king.

CHR-0498.name: Nefret Tamaren
CHR-0498.looks: A tall, graceful woman of 34 with a heavy black wig, a broad bead collar, and sorrowful, watchful eyes.
CHR-0498.manner: Gentle and reserved, she speaks little at court and watches her husband's face closely.
CHR-0498.wants: Wants her only living son Khaset kept safe and his succession secure.
CHR-0498.fears: Fears losing a second son to the blood sickness, after her first son died of it in 1101 at 11.

CHR-0499.name: Tiye Tamaren
CHR-0499.looks: A stout, sharp-eyed woman of 56 with a grey wig, heavy gold bracelets, and a granary-keeper's tally board.
CHR-0499.manner: Practical and blunt, she talks of grain and bread and has little time for priests' arguments.
CHR-0499.wants: Wants the royal granaries kept full through a lean year, with four months' bread for the city.
CHR-0499.fears: Fears another Hungry Year like 1088, when a crowd stormed the Tamar granaries.

CHR-0500.name: Amenhar V Tamaren
CHR-0500.title: King, Son of the Flood Mother
CHR-0500.looks: A tall, lean man of 38 with a shaven head, a gold collar of the Flood Mother's son, and tired, anxious eyes.
CHR-0500.manner: Gracious and careful in public, he speaks of the river's favor while waiting for every flood report.
CHR-0500.wants: Wants to keep his throne through the 1105 flood and refuse King Yared's demand for the river gift in silver.
CHR-0500.fears: Fears a third lean flood, or old Ahmose's confession, either of which would void his right to rule.

CHR-0501.name: Nakht the Oar
CHR-0501.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0501.title: Captain of the Crocodile Boats at Talim
CHR-0501.looks: A strong, scarred man of 36 with oar-thickened arms, a crocodile-skin belt, and a river captain's white kilt.
CHR-0501.manner: Tough and loyal, he speaks plainly and keeps his master's secrets better than his own.
CHR-0501.wants: Wants to seize the sealed Kadah order from Djedi Senmut's vault at Talim for General Rahotep.
CHR-0501.fears: Fears being caught in the temple vault, which would expose his general's secret plans.

CHR-0502.name: Faruq the Lamp
CHR-0502.looks: A thin, intense man of 39 with burning eyes, a plain linen robe, and a small oil lamp he carries while preaching.
CHR-0502.manner: Fiery and eloquent, he preaches that a fever-proof king cannot know his people's suffering.
CHR-0502.wants: Wants to preach any confession from the Flood Stairs at the Harvest of the Mother on 1 March.
CHR-0502.fears: Fears the Stair Temple's hired men, who would gladly see him fall in the river.

CHR-0503.name: Bakhet Stonehand
CHR-0503.looks: A powerful, rough man of 34 with a mason's thick arms, an outlaw's ragged kilt, and a brand on one shoulder.
CHR-0503.manner: Angry and loyal, he speaks bluntly and has little patience for priests or kings.
CHR-0503.wants: Wants to carry his dying father Ahmose to Djedi Senmut's priests so he can confess before he dies.
CHR-0503.fears: Fears Hori of the Stairs' poppy killing his father before he can speak.

CHR-0504.name: Merit the Star-Reader
CHR-0504.looks: A slender, serious young woman of 31 with ink-stained fingers, a scribe's white linen, and tired eyes from night watching.
CHR-0504.manner: Quiet and precise, she speaks of stars and numbers and is nervous about her room in the Stair Precinct.
CHR-0504.wants: Wants the hidden 1089 tax roll moved out of the Stair Precinct before Menna's guards search her room.
CHR-0504.fears: Fears being caught with the roll Menna ordered burned, which would cost her life.

CHR-0505.name: Hori of the Stairs
CHR-0505.looks: A lean, quiet man of 40 with a temple servant's linen, soft hands, and a little pouch of poppy at his belt.
CHR-0505.manner: Gentle and attentive, he seems a kind nurse to the dying and listens too closely to their words.
CHR-0505.wants: Wants old Ahmose kept quiet with poppy until he dies, so the 1089 secret stays buried.
CHR-0505.fears: Fears Bakhet Stonehand, the old man's outlaw son, and the Talim priests catching him at the sickbed.

CHR-0506.name: Tuya Senmut
CHR-0506.looks: A pretty young woman of 24 with a neat wig, a nurse's white linen, and a small bronze amulet of the Flood Mother.
CHR-0506.manner: Warm and cheerful with the prince, she is careful in her words with everyone else.
CHR-0506.wants: Wants to report weekly to her uncle Djedi Senmut about the Crown Prince's health and the palace.
CHR-0506.fears: Fears the king discovering that the heir's nurse reports to the Talim priests.

CHR-0507.name: Henut Ankhesi
CHR-0507.looks: A pleasant, round-faced woman of 37 with a Tessarian-style dress, a Tamari bead bracelet, and quick eyes.
CHR-0507.manner: Chatty and friendly, she gossips with servants and seems to have no secrets at all.
CHR-0507.wants: Wants to learn from the queen's taster what Queen Livia is planning, and whether it involves fire-oil.
CHR-0507.fears: Fears her hidden Tessarian husband being arrested as a deserter, which would expose her.

CHR-0508.name: Nasr the Cutter
CHR-0508.looks: A short, leathery man of 61 with salt-cracked hands, a sun-squint, and an indigo head-cloth wound over his face.
CHR-0508.manner: Stubborn and plain-spoken, he argues for his cutters like a father and haggles over every share.
CHR-0508.wants: Wants a larger share from the Salt-Master, and means to stop cutting on Well Day unless he gets it.
CHR-0508.fears: Fears his cutters going hungry while the Bahar clan grows rich on their salt.

CHR-0509.name: Jabir Hazari
CHR-0509.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0509.looks: A lean man of 57, stiff at dawn, with a javelin scar in his right calf and a tamarisk lance.
CHR-0509.manner: Proud and reserved, he speaks of honor and the Long Ride, and avoids any talk of Zanara.
CHR-0509.wants: Wants to keep his school's good name and his student Mansur's trust while the clans argue over the Salt Road.
CHR-0509.fears: Fears that the Desert Night March he sold will be used against the clans by Marshal Juma's riders.

CHR-0510.name: Khalid the Star
CHR-0510.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0510.title: Master of the Brotherhood of Guides
CHR-0510.looks: A weathered, wiry man of 58 with deep sun-lines, keen eyes, a digging staff, and a guide's star-badge on his head-cloth.
CHR-0510.manner: Calm and wise, he speaks of stars, sand and water and is trusted by every clan.
CHR-0510.wants: Wants the new well he found at Red Hollow kept secret, while serving every caravan that hires him.
CHR-0510.fears: Fears war on the Salt Road between the clans and Zanara, now that he has guided Zanara's surveyors east.

CHR-0511.name: Hamza Bahar
CHR-0511.looks: A sharp-eyed, stout man of 46 with the Bahar habit of going bare-eyed in glare, a fine robe, and a tally cord.
CHR-0511.manner: Shrewd and friendly, he counts loads aloud and quarrels endlessly with the salt cutters.
CHR-0511.wants: Wants to keep collecting Zanara's gold at Mirah and skimming a little on the side, through the Salt Road crisis.
CHR-0511.fears: Fears the clans finding his second tally cord, and Nasr's cutters stopping work on Well Day.

CHR-0512.name: Harith Sayf
CHR-0512.title: Chief of Clan Sayf, lord of Mirah
CHR-0512.looks: A tall, hawk-faced man of 44 with an indigo veil, a curved sword, and gold rings bought with salt money.
CHR-0512.manner: Fierce and blunt, he speaks for the southern clans and threatens war whenever gold is mentioned.
CHR-0512.wants: Wants to close the Salt Road if any Zanari gold goes east, and a larger share of the salt fee for the south.
CHR-0512.fears: Fears Zanara's east road skipping the clans' fees and leaving the south poor.

CHR-0513.name: Rami Yasiri
CHR-0513.looks: A lean, sun-darkened man of 40 with a fisherman's scarred hands, a salt-stained robe, and a coastal chief's silver ring.
CHR-0513.manner: Easygoing and sly, he jokes like a smuggler and keeps the water-oath as sacred.
CHR-0513.wants: Wants to keep the two Qadiri journeymen safe under his water-oath until Kamal the Eel takes them to Marira.
CHR-0513.fears: Fears Qadir's Master of Doors learning where the journeymen hide, and his clan being punished.

CHR-0514.name: Salma Bahar
CHR-0514.looks: A small, very old-looking woman of 64 with bare, sharp eyes, deep sun-lines, and many knotted cords at her belt.
CHR-0514.manner: Patient and exact, she speaks rarely and remembers every clan's water rights by knot and memory.
CHR-0514.wants: Wants the missing children of the Marad camps found and brought home, and the Red Hollow well kept hidden.
CHR-0514.fears: Fears a blood feud between the Sand Clans and Sabra's pearl lords if the stolen children are proved.

CHR-0515.name: Umar Hazari
CHR-0515.title: Chief of Clan Hazari, Guardian of the Well Road
CHR-0515.looks: A tall, grey-bearded man of 53 with a rider's lean frame, an undyed head-cloth, and a long spear.
CHR-0515.manner: Stern and traditional, he speaks of Hazir the Rider and distrusts every foreigner near the Well.
CHR-0515.wants: Wants every Qadiri scholar out of the desert before Well Day on 14 March.
CHR-0515.fears: Fears Qadir's Well-Keepers taking control of the Well of Samar and the pilgrims' road.

CHR-0516.name: Ayub the Deep
CHR-0516.looks: A thin, wiry old man of 60 with rope-scarred hands, a lamp-blackened face, and a cord around his waist.
CHR-0516.manner: Quiet and secretive, he speaks only of the Well and grows uneasy when strangers ask questions.
CHR-0516.wants: Wants to chisel the Old Tamari marks off the Well shaft before anyone else sees them.
CHR-0516.fears: Fears the miracle of the Well being called a lie if the old marks are found.

CHR-0517.name: Tariq Bahar
CHR-0517.title: Speaker of the Sand Clans
CHR-0517.looks: A tall, stern man of 55 with sharp bare eyes that shun no glare, a rust-red robe, and a Speaker's black ring.
CHR-0517.manner: Calm, proud and hard-bargaining, he speaks for 23 clans and threatens Qadir with polite words.
CHR-0517.wants: Wants Qadir to pay 20,000 suns and a share of the paper duty, or he will read the contract of Zahir aloud on Well Day.
CHR-0517.fears: Fears raiders on moonless nights, when the Bahar chief's line is almost blind.

CHR-0518.name: Zayd Blackveil
CHR-0518.looks: A hard, gaunt man of 32 with a black veil over his face, a curved sword, and a raider's thin, tough camel.
CHR-0518.manner: Silent and bitter, he speaks little and kills without hesitation.
CHR-0518.wants: Wants to burn the well-camps on Zanara's east road and be paid well by his kinsman Harith Sayf.
CHR-0518.fears: Fears dying of thirst alone in the desert, as he was cast out to do.

CHR-0519.name: Mansur Bahar
CHR-0519.title: Captain of the Noon Lances
CHR-0519.looks: A lean, fit man of 33 with sharp Bahar eyes, a Noon Lance captain's rust-red robe, and a long lance.
CHR-0519.manner: Ambitious and confident, he speaks well and makes promises he expects others to keep.
CHR-0519.wants: Wants to be acclaimed Speaker when the office falls empty, with the southern clans behind him.
CHR-0519.fears: Fears his father learning that he has sold a third of the salt fee to the south.

CHR-0520.name: Nuri Hazimi
CHR-0520.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0520.title: Master of the Camel School; captain of the Camel Guard
CHR-0520.looks: A strong, sun-darkened man of 34 with a camel rider's lean legs, a white head-cloth, and a long curved sword.
CHR-0520.manner: Cool and practical, he speaks of heat and water like a soldier and keeps his thoughts on the war to himself.
CHR-0520.wants: Wants to hold the Sabun road with his camel riders and see which way the war turns before he commits.
CHR-0520.fears: Fears being caught between his uncle's secret peace and the Emir's war.

CHR-0521.name: Saad the Burnt
CHR-0521.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0521.looks: A scarred, burned man of 47 with shiny fire-scarred skin on his face and arms, and singed eyebrows.
CHR-0521.manner: Rough and fearless, he speaks of fire with respect and has no patience for careless men.
CHR-0521.wants: Wants his fire-boat crews ready to burn the Qadiri fleet at Miruma before it sails.
CHR-0521.fears: Fears another shed fire like the one at Zariya in November 1104, which killed 11 slaves.

CHR-0522.name: Faisal the Broker
CHR-0522.title: Master of Caravans
CHR-0522.looks: A plump, smooth man of 51 with a trimmed beard, silk robes, and many gold rings, always smelling of sandalwood.
CHR-0522.manner: Warm and persuasive, he judges in one meeting what would turn a man, and ten of twelve take his offer.
CHR-0522.wants: Wants the spring gold caravan from Zanara to reach Sabra before any war closes the Bahesh.
CHR-0522.fears: Fears war with Qadir closing the gold roads that make his fortune.

CHR-0523.name: Jamila Sabrani
CHR-0523.looks: A tall, handsome woman of 46 with pearls in her ears, a rich white robe, and the hard eyes of a trader.
CHR-0523.manner: Proud and sharp, she speaks of pearls and profit and defends slavery as the way things have always been.
CHR-0523.wants: Wants to keep her slave divers, who bring in two-thirds of Sabra's pearls, against Mahmud the Just.
CHR-0523.fears: Fears Mahmud the Just freeing every believing diver on Well Day, halving her fortune.

CHR-0524.name: Musa Zarani
CHR-0524.title: Lord of the South March
CHR-0524.looks: A heavy, scarred man of 44 with a cruel mouth, a slave-raider's whip on his belt, and fine white robes.
CHR-0524.manner: Smooth and cold, he speaks of divers as goods and of the Sand Clans with contempt.
CHR-0524.wants: Wants the trade in divers kept going and the missing Marad children forgotten.
CHR-0524.fears: Fears the Sand Clans finding out that he sold their children as Veld-born divers.

CHR-0525.name: Qasim Nafari
CHR-0525.title: Oil-Master
CHR-0525.looks: A sharp, thin man of 55 with oil-stained hands, a tally-stick bundle at his belt, and a burn mark on his neck.
CHR-0525.manner: Cold and suspicious, he counts every jar and trusts nobody near the boiling-sheds.
CHR-0525.wants: Wants the escaped boiler Salwa Ropecutter caught before she sells the secret of the seeps.
CHR-0525.fears: Fears Varenna linking the smoke of Zariya to Blackreef's dragon and bringing war.

CHR-0526.name: Walid Hazimi
CHR-0526.title: Lord of Hazim
CHR-0526.looks: A grey, careful man of 53 with an upland lord's weathered face, a plain white robe, and an old sword.
CHR-0526.manner: Calm and cautious, he speaks of old loyalties and warns of war, choosing his words carefully.
CHR-0526.wants: Wants peace with Qadir, even as its vassal, before the oil trade brings a northern war.
CHR-0526.fears: Fears the Emir learning that he has offered Sabra to Qadir behind his back.

CHR-0527.name: Mahmud the Just
CHR-0527.looks: A thin, white-bearded man of 61 with a kind face, a plain white robe, and the copper well-ring of his office.
CHR-0527.manner: Gentle and firm, he speaks of mercy and the Book, and cannot be moved by threats.
CHR-0527.wants: Wants to declare on Well Day that every slave diver who takes the Path of the Well is free.
CHR-0527.fears: Fears the Emir calling him a traitor, and the pearl lords' anger falling on the freed divers.

CHR-0528.name: Tahir Sabrani
CHR-0528.title: Heir; Captain of the Fire-Boats
CHR-0528.looks: A tall, strong young man of 26 with a smooth face, a white robe over light mail, and a fire-pot captain's black sash.
CHR-0528.manner: Bold and eager, he speaks of striking first and is impatient with his father's caution.
CHR-0528.wants: Wants to burn Grand Admiral Jalal's fleet at Miruma before it sails, as soon as he knows the day.
CHR-0528.fears: Fears his father keeping him in port while Qadir's 34 galleys sail on Sabra.

CHR-0529.name: Karim Sabrani
CHR-0529.title: Emir
CHR-0529.looks: A heavy, sweating man of 50 with a trimmed black beard, gold rings, and a water jar always within reach.
CHR-0529.manner: Cautious and calculating, he talks of silver and freedom and hides his fear of war behind smiles.
CHR-0529.wants: Wants the oil secret kept, the silver coming, and Sabra free of Qadir without a battle.
CHR-0529.fears: Fears Varenna linking Sabra's smoke to Blackreef's dragon, and Nell Brine reselling his oil.

CHR-0530.name: Bilal Nine-Fathom
CHR-0530.looks: A lean, deep-chested young man of 24 with a diver's turtle-shell nose clip on a cord and scars on his wrists.
CHR-0530.manner: Quiet and watchful, he speaks little and holds his breath when nervous, out of habit.
CHR-0530.wants: Wants to guide Sand Clan riders to the pens at Zaran and free the children held there.
CHR-0530.fears: Fears being caught and sent back to the diving boats, or killed for what he knows.

CHR-0531.name: Rima the Water-Seller
CHR-0531.looks: A small, quick young woman of 28 with a water-seller's skin bag, a bright head-cloth, and sun-browned arms.
CHR-0531.manner: Cheerful and talkative, she gossips with sailors and slaves as she sells her water.
CHR-0531.wants: Wants to keep carrying the Well-Keepers' water to the slave pens and earn a little on the side.
CHR-0531.fears: Fears the oil-master's men learning what she knows about the Oil Shore gate.

CHR-0532.name: Salwa Ropecutter
CHR-0532.looks: A wiry woman of 35 with oil-burned hands, a cropped head, and the scarred ankles of a former boiling-shed slave.
CHR-0532.manner: Wary and tough, she trusts no one and speaks only to people who can help her get away.
CHR-0532.wants: Wants to escape Sabra for good, paying her way by selling what she knows to Qadir's Master of Doors.
CHR-0532.fears: Fears Oil-Master Qasim Nafari, who is hunting her, and being dragged back to the boiling-sheds.

CHR-0533.name: Dauda the Smith
CHR-0533.looks: A broad, heavy-armed man of 49 with burn-speckled forearms, a leather apron, and an indigo cotton wrap tied at the waist.
CHR-0533.manner: Steady and closed-mouthed, he talks about iron and fire and says nothing about who buys his spearheads.
CHR-0533.wants: Wants to keep forging spearheads by night for King Kato and keep being paid in Tedana gold dust.
CHR-0533.fears: Fears the emperor's men learning that his forges arm a vassal king's secret spearmen.

CHR-0534.name: Baraka Tedani
CHR-0534.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0534.looks: A tall, muscular man of 40 with a spearman's scarred hands, a shaven head, and a short stabbing spear.
CHR-0534.manner: Confident and careful, he speaks of duty and peace while watching everyone's reaction.
CHR-0534.wants: Wants his uncle's crown, promised to him by the Marshal in return for reporting the night drills.
CHR-0534.fears: Fears his uncle discovering that his own nephew sold him to Marshal Juma.

CHR-0535.name: Sefu the Runner
CHR-0535.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0535.title: Master of the House of Runners
CHR-0535.looks: A long-legged, lean man of 56, with a face that reddens in heat, bare feet in sandals, and three javelins.
CHR-0535.manner: Dry, patient and measured, he lives by a clock and speaks as if counting every breath.
CHR-0535.wants: Wants to decide whom his runners serve first if the emperor falls, and to keep Crown Prince Tano safe.
CHR-0535.fears: Fears the stroke of the Runner's blood, which killed five emperors of his house before 50.

CHR-0536.name: Juma Kanemba
CHR-0536.title: Marshal of the Empire
CHR-0536.looks: A strong, red-faced man of 38 with a heavy jaw, a marshal's gold arm-rings, and a cotton robe over light mail.
CHR-0536.manner: Ambitious and commanding, he speaks bluntly to soldiers and smoothly to lords he needs.
CHR-0536.wants: Wants the regency if the emperor dies, and Tamowa taken from Abara before the May rains.
CHR-0536.fears: Fears the stroke in his own blood, and the young heir's friends turning the runners against him.

CHR-0537.name: Bakari Kante
CHR-0537.looks: A plump, dignified man of 52 with a neat beard, a Well believer's copper cup, and fine indigo robes.
CHR-0537.manner: Pious and cautious, he speaks of trade and faith together, and never openly crosses the court.
CHR-0537.wants: Wants the northern trade through Sabra and Qadira kept open and the east road blocked.
CHR-0537.fears: Fears the Old Voices pushing the Path of the Well out of court and his merchants' gold north for good.

CHR-0538.name: Kwame Sorondo
CHR-0538.looks: A heavy, grave man of 54 with gold rings, a merchant's soft hands, and a set of brass scale weights at his belt.
CHR-0538.manner: Formal and exact, he speaks of weights and measures and never jokes about money.
CHR-0538.wants: Wants the Scale Pact kept and the 100,000 suns he lent Mosi for the east road repaid.
CHR-0538.fears: Fears Qadir's Master of Doors testing the Scale Pact weights along with the Sultan's cup.

CHR-0539.name: Amara Kabale
CHR-0539.looks: A hard-faced woman of 46 with gold anklets, a dusty mining robe, and a whip at her belt.
CHR-0539.manner: Cold and businesslike, she speaks of slaves as numbers and of war as a way to buy more.
CHR-0539.wants: Wants Marshal Juma to march into Abara and take captives for her mines.
CHR-0539.fears: Fears that her dying vein will be discovered before she finds a new one.

CHR-0540.name: Kato Tedani
CHR-0540.looks: A proud, grey-bearded man of 55 with a vassal king's gold circlet, a leopard-skin cloak, and old spear scars.
CHR-0540.manner: Proud and resentful, he speaks of the old Tedana kingdom and treats the emperor's envoys coldly.
CHR-0540.wants: Wants a fair share of the Tedana gold, or the old crown of the Tedana itself.
CHR-0540.fears: Fears that the Marshal already knows about his night drills and is waiting to strike.

CHR-0541.name: Oduya the Long-Voiced
CHR-0541.looks: A frail old man of 70 with a white beard, a deep voice still strong, and a staff hung with ancestor beads.
CHR-0541.manner: Slow and solemn, he speaks in chants and long pauses, and forgets names more often each year.
CHR-0541.wants: Wants the ancestors kept first at court and the Path of the Well pushed out.
CHR-0541.fears: Fears his failing memory, which has made him forget a name in the morning song.

CHR-0542.name: Tano Kanemba
CHR-0542.title: Crown Prince; colonel of the First Bull
CHR-0542.looks: A tall, lean youth of 16 with long runner's legs, a red face in the heat, and the First Bull's colonel's sash.
CHR-0542.manner: Earnest and quick, he listens to his teachers carefully and hides his new faith from the court.
CHR-0542.wants: Wants to prove himself on the Runner's Round and earn the respect of his father's generals.
CHR-0542.fears: Fears his father's death leaving him to face his ambitious cousin Juma alone.

CHR-0543.name: Mosi III Kanemba
CHR-0543.title: Emperor, Voice of the Ancestors
CHR-0543.looks: A tall, strong man of 41 with a red face, a runner's lean frame, and gold rings in the emperor's colors.
CHR-0543.manner: Confident and grand, he speaks of roads and gold and hides any sign of weakness.
CHR-0543.wants: Wants the east road cut to the Monuti before the May rains, freeing Zanara from the Salt Road fees.
CHR-0543.fears: Fears the stroke that killed five emperors of his house between 44 and 49.

CHR-0544.name: Nia Tembo
CHR-0544.looks: A sturdy, sun-darkened woman of 34 with a surveyor's measuring cords, ink-stained fingers, and dusty boots.
CHR-0544.manner: Practical and determined, she speaks of distances and costs and has little patience for politics.
CHR-0544.wants: Wants to cut the east road to Atani before the May rains, though Fikru's terraces sit on her line.
CHR-0544.fears: Fears war with Abara or the Sand Clans stopping her road before it is done.

CHR-0545.name: Kojo Tatendi
CHR-0545.looks: A lean, strong young man of 22 with burn-scarred arms, a bellows-worker's broad shoulders, and a cotton wrap.
CHR-0545.manner: Quiet and shy, he works hard and speaks only when asked, but notices everything at the forge.
CHR-0545.wants: Wants to learn the smith's craft from Dauda and someday have his own forge.
CHR-0545.fears: Fears the emperor's soldiers finding out about the night work at the forge and blaming him.

CHR-0546.name: Sadiki the Lamp
CHR-0546.looks: A thin, scarred man of 42 with a freed slave's brand, a lamp-carrier's soot-blackened hands, and a quiet face.
CHR-0546.manner: Calm and respected, he speaks softly and remembers the name of every miner who died in the fire.
CHR-0546.wants: Wants to free the slaves of the Kabale mines in a rising on the Night of Masks.
CHR-0546.fears: Fears being betrayed before the rising, and the slaves dying in the attempt.

CHR-0547.name: Zuberi Omamba
CHR-0547.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0547.title: First Spear of the Horn Regiments
CHR-0547.looks: A tall, powerful man of 34 with long runner's legs, a First Spear's leopard-skin collar, and a heavy spear.
CHR-0547.manner: Commanding and calm, he drills his men tirelessly and speaks of discipline above all.
CHR-0547.wants: Wants the 36,000 men of the Horn Regiments drilled and ready for war with Abara or the Sand Clans.
CHR-0547.fears: Fears the Marshal and the heir pulling the army apart if the emperor dies.

CHR-0548.name: Chuma the Dragonspear
CHR-0548.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0548.looks: A tall, scarred man of 40 with a long dragon-spear, a necklace of wyrm teeth, and a hunter's leather armor.
CHR-0548.manner: Boastful and fearless, he talks of killing the Red Widow and laughs at those who call it impossible.
CHR-0548.wants: Wants to buy Liss Cairnhold's charts at Highcastle in May and kill the Red Widow by autumn.
CHR-0548.fears: Fears being exposed as a cheat, since some of the wyrm heads he sold were salted and resold.

CHR-0549.name: Imani Tembo
CHR-0549.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0549.looks: A lean, tough young woman of 28 with a hunter's bow, braided hair, and scars from the Deep Green's thorns.
CHR-0549.manner: Adventurous and blunt, she speaks of trails and rivers and loves the wild more than courts.
CHR-0549.wants: Wants to find a track from the Mosawa lands to Monuro, paid by Hamisi Monuri.
CHR-0549.fears: Fears the Keshi court learning that she works for a Monuri plot against House Keshari.

CHR-0550.name: Tafari the Horn
CHR-0550.group: Beast hunters, explorers and creature experts
CHR-0550.title: Master of the Elephant Corps and the Ring Hunters
CHR-0550.looks: A big, heavy man of 44 with an elephant goad, a horn badge on his chest, and tusk scars across his thigh.
CHR-0550.manner: Gruff and patient, he talks to his elephants gently and to men harshly.
CHR-0550.wants: Wants the Marshal's elephants fed and ready for war at Atani before the May rains.
CHR-0550.fears: Fears his elephants panicking in battle and trampling his own men.

CHR-0552.name: Sauda the Drum
CHR-0552.looks: A slim, quick woman of 30 with a small talking drum at her hip, bright eyes, and a traveler's dusty wrap.
CHR-0552.manner: Friendly and curious, she asks innocent questions and remembers every answer.
CHR-0552.wants: Wants a copy of King Yonas's secret clause giving Zanara the right to 500 men at Tamowa.
CHR-0552.fears: Fears being caught as a Zanari spy at Tamowa, where Gebre Tsega's men watch every gate.

CHR-0553.name: Tumaini the Rope
CHR-0553.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0553.title: Master of the Rope Hall
CHR-0553.looks: A small, wiry man of 48, with long fingers, leather-hard palms, and a coil of rope over one shoulder.
CHR-0553.manner: Quiet and grinning, he says little, loves House Keshari, and still hates the Amber Isles from 1068.
CHR-0553.wants: Wants his 400 boarding climbers kept home this spring, not sent with the Amber fleet to the Isle of Pearls.
CHR-0553.fears: Fears his weakening grip and clicking left knee, remembering that Kombo Keshari died when a knee gave way on…

CHR-0554.name: Jabari Tide
CHR-0554.title: Admiral of the League; master of the Sea School of Monuro
CHR-0554.looks: A strong, sea-weathered man of 38 with a short beard, an admiral's green sash, and scars from boarding fights.
CHR-0554.manner: Bold and practical, he speaks of ships and crews, and distrusts every promise from Amberport.
CHR-0554.wants: Wants 8 Keshi ships kept home from the Isle of Pearls venture, though Jaya Rawang has secretly promised him a rich share.
CHR-0554.fears: Fears the Amber Sultan turning on the Keshi ships once the Isle of Pearls is taken.

CHR-0555.name: Hamisi Monuri
CHR-0555.looks: A stout, proud man of 53 with grey hair, a merchant lord's silk robe, and a heavy gold harbor-lord's chain.
CHR-0555.manner: Smooth and scheming, he speaks of the Old Houses' rights and of Keshari failures with careful scorn.
CHR-0555.wants: Wants the princedom back for House Monuri at the next election, with Amber ships behind him.
CHR-0555.fears: Fears his letter to the Amber Grand Vizier falling into Keshari hands.

CHR-0556.name: Rehema the Shipwright
CHR-0556.looks: A strong, sun-browned woman of 43 with sawdust in her hair, adze-scarred hands, and a shipwright's leather apron.
CHR-0556.manner: Blunt and stubborn, she talks of timber and payment and will not move until she is paid.
CHR-0556.wants: Wants to be paid in full before she releases the last 6 of the 20 new ships to the Prince.
CHR-0556.fears: Fears being blamed for the four hulls built of green timber when they fail at sea.

CHR-0557.name: Zawadi Kioyani
CHR-0557.looks: A tall, sharp-featured woman of 41 with a pepper-seed necklace, imported silk, and a weigher's brass scale at her belt.
CHR-0557.manner: Proud and cold, she speaks of peace and pepper and hates the Amber Isles, where her father burned in 1068.
CHR-0557.wants: Wants to stop the Isle of Pearls venture by withholding the Prince's weighing fees from the Pepper Hall.
CHR-0557.fears: Fears a new war with the Amber Isles ruining the pepper season and her house.

CHR-0558.name: Laila Maruang
CHR-0558.looks: A slender, graceful woman of 24 with fine Amber features, gold and pearls, and a habit of touching her ears.
CHR-0558.manner: Charming and determined, she pushes her brother's cause at her husband's court and smiles through every refusal.
CHR-0558.wants: Wants the 20 Keshi ships she promised her brother to sail with the Amber fleet on 1 April.
CHR-0558.fears: Fears having to choose between her brother the Sultan and her husband's house over her infant son.

CHR-0559.name: Nuru Keshari
CHR-0559.looks: A small infant of 1 with soft, loose joints, dark eyes, and a habit of clawing at his ears before storms.
CHR-0559.manner: A restless, fussy baby who screams for a night and a day before a cyclone strikes.
CHR-0559.wants: Wants nothing but milk, sleep and his mother, though two courts want to raise him.
CHR-0559.fears: Fears, as babies do, loud storms and strangers, and screams before the cyclone season begins.

CHR-0560.name: Amani Keshari
CHR-0560.title: Prince of Kesh, leader of the fleet
CHR-0560.looks: A lean, flexible man of 44 with long fingers, a prince's green robe, and old scars on his loose wrists.
CHR-0560.manner: Easygoing and hopeful, he promises much and pays late, and smiles even when his treasury is empty.
CHR-0560.wants: Wants the Isle of Pearls venture to succeed, so he can pay the Amber loans and keep the princedom.
CHR-0560.fears: Fears the Old Houses electing a Monuri prince if the venture goes wrong.

CHR-0561.name: Faraji Keshari
CHR-0561.title: Keeper of Keys
CHR-0561.looks: A lithe, thin man of 32 with loose, double-jointed limbs, knees already stiff, and a ring of keys at his belt.
CHR-0561.manner: Sly and clever, he jokes lightly and listens closely, and trusts only his own family.
CHR-0561.wants: Wants the Monuri letter itself, not just word of it, and news of the infant heir from the nurse he pays.
CHR-0561.fears: Fears his failing knees, which may cripple him before 40 as they did his kin.

CHR-0562.name: Kito the Gecko
CHR-0562.looks: A small, wiry young man of 24 with impossibly loose joints, scraped knees, and a thief's dark, tight clothes.
CHR-0562.manner: Cheeky and fearless, he grins at danger and boasts of roofs no one else can climb.
CHR-0562.wants: Wants to rob the Amber merchant house that holds Prince Amani's pawned harbor dues.
CHR-0562.fears: Fears his loose joints failing on a roof, as they failed his father.

CHR-0564.name: Neema Nightwater
CHR-0564.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0564.title: Captain of the Night Swimmers
CHR-0564.looks: A small, strong woman of 36, with a blackened knife, a scarred palm, and no armor ever.
CHR-0564.manner: Calm and fierce, she speaks little and refuses to take orders from any Amber captain.
CHR-0564.wants: Wants her 400 Night Swimmers kept under Keshi command and never placed under the Amber fleet.
CHR-0564.fears: Fears dying in a harbor under Amber command, for a war that is not Kesh's.

CHR-0565.name: Asha Redvine
CHR-0565.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0565.title: Captain of the Pepper Guard
CHR-0565.looks: A tall, strong woman of 32 with a spear, a red vine painted on her shield, and a scar over one eyebrow.
CHR-0565.manner: Brisk and loyal, she guards the Pepper Hall closely and talks to strangers only when she must.
CHR-0565.wants: Wants the Pepper Hall safe through the quarrel over weighing fees and the Isle of Pearls venture.
CHR-0565.fears: Fears being ordered by the Prince to seize the Pepper Hall's fees from the woman she serves.

CHR-0566.name: Baruti Monuri
CHR-0566.title: Captain of the Pearl Squadron
CHR-0566.looks: A strong, sea-weathered man of 40 with a ram-captain's scarred hands, a Monuri gold ring, and a green sash.
CHR-0566.manner: Ambitious and restless, he speaks of glory at sea and of landing first on the Isle of Pearls.
CHR-0566.wants: Wants to land first on the Isle of Pearls with his 20-ship Pearl Squadron.
CHR-0566.fears: Fears his uncle Hamisi learning that he betrayed the Vizier letter to Faraji Keshari.

CHR-0567.name: Daudi Kalamu
CHR-0567.looks: A thin, grey-haired physician of 48 with careful hands, a bag of herbs and poppy, and a scholar's white robe.
CHR-0567.manner: Gentle and worried, he speaks softly and tells the truth only to those he trusts.
CHR-0567.wants: Wants the whole royal nursery replaced before the naming feast, so no spy can watch the infant heir.
CHR-0567.fears: Fears the Sultan taking the storm-sensing boy to Amberport, and the League breaking over a child.

CHR-0568.name: Kebede the Pike
CHR-0568.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0568.title: Master of the Spear Yard of Zutati
CHR-0568.looks: A lean, tall man of 51, with creaking knees, a left forearm that never closed fully, and a 5 m cedar pike.
CHR-0568.manner: Steady and quiet, he speaks little and builds a line that does not move, standing in its first line himself.
CHR-0568.wants: Wants the 12,000 Tsega Pikes drilled to meet a Zanari column before the May rains.
CHR-0568.fears: Fears that a Zanari army fed on Abari beef and mounted on Abari horses will meet his pikes on open ground.

CHR-0569.name: Yohannes Mandari
CHR-0569.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0569.looks: A lean, hard rider of 36 with bowed legs, a highland riding cloak with a colored border, and a javelin case.
CHR-0569.manner: Cheerful and reckless, he loves horses and raids and laughs off talk of loyalty to either court.
CHR-0569.wants: Wants to keep selling Mandi horses to Zanara's Golden Horse and keep his 300 riders ready for Tekle.
CHR-0569.fears: Fears his cousin Mesfin or Tekle learning that Mandi horses are mounting the enemy.

CHR-0570.name: Gebre Tsega
CHR-0570.title: Marshal of the Northern Host
CHR-0570.looks: A broad, stern man of 46 with a close-cut grey beard, a marshal's green-bordered shawl, and a heavy spear.
CHR-0570.manner: Hard and unforgiving, he speaks bluntly to his officers and remembers every old grudge.
CHR-0570.wants: Wants to hold Tamowa against Juma Kanemba's 12,000 and keep the Zanari road shut for King Yared.
CHR-0570.fears: Fears Prince Tekle coming home with the southern lords behind him.

CHR-0571.name: Tekle Asfari
CHR-0571.title: Captain of the queen's hired companies
CHR-0571.looks: A long-armed man of 42, with heavy shield shoulders and a bolt scar in his right calf.
CHR-0571.manner: Patient and controlled, he speaks courteously and lets his anger show only in his eyes.
CHR-0571.wants: Wants his release from Queen Livia before she marches after 1 May, to ride home to the Monundi horsemen.
CHR-0571.fears: Fears that Livia will not let him go cheaply, and that his road home is already watched.

CHR-0572.name: Tadesse the Salt
CHR-0572.looks: A dusty, wiry man of 47 with salt-cracked hands, a carrier's shoulder pad, and a white shawl gone grey.
CHR-0572.manner: Talkative and sly, he jokes with toll-men and gives each one a small gift.
CHR-0572.wants: Wants to keep passing banned Keshi pepper as salt bars past King Yared's new toll-men at Koyako.
CHR-0572.fears: Fears the new toll-men looking too closely at his salt bars.

CHR-0573.name: Almaz Teferi
CHR-0573.looks: A neat, sharp-eyed woman of 40 with a treasurer's tally cords, a white shawl with both green and blue borders, and ink on her fingers.
CHR-0573.manner: Careful and diplomatic, she speaks to both courts with equal respect and promises nothing in writing.
CHR-0573.wants: Wants Tamar's river gift paid in wheat, linen and papyrus as the pact says, not in silver as King Yared demands.
CHR-0573.fears: Fears the two courts going to war, and her treasury being split between them.

CHR-0574.name: Dawit Mekonen
CHR-0574.looks: A grave, grey-haired man of 54 with a priest's white shawl, a staff of cedar, and dusty sandals from the Source.
CHR-0574.manner: Solemn and proud, he speaks of the Monuti's source as holy and of Tamar's complaints with contempt.
CHR-0574.wants: Wants Tamar's river gift paid, and threatens to postpone the May Source rite unless it comes in silver.
CHR-0574.fears: Fears his Loati channel being called a dam that steals Tamar's flood.

CHR-0575.name: Mesfin Mandari
CHR-0575.title: Lord of Mandi, leader of Kiros's Men
CHR-0575.looks: A proud, grey-bearded cavalry lord of 49 with a colored shawl over mail, a fine horse, and gold earrings.
CHR-0575.manner: Warm and passionate, he speaks of Kiros and Tekle as if the old war were still being fought.
CHR-0575.wants: Wants to raise the Horsemen of the Monundi and bring Prince Tekle home as sole king.
CHR-0575.fears: Fears that his letters to Tekle are being read by the enemy, though he does not know by whom.

CHR-0576.name: Selam the Knot-Keeper
CHR-0576.looks: A thin, old woman of 63 with white braids, knotted cords around her neck, and a Rememberer's blue and green shawl.
CHR-0576.manner: Quiet and precise, she recites genealogies from memory and keeps silent about what matters most.
CHR-0576.wants: Wants the birth-cord of 1029 kept safe and the Compact of 1053 unbroken while she lives.
CHR-0576.fears: Fears that revealing the cord would set the twin kings and Tekle at war.

CHR-0577.name: Saba Asfari
CHR-0577.looks: A dignified woman of 52 with grey braids, a white shawl bordered in both green and blue, and calm, tired eyes.
CHR-0577.manner: Gentle and firm, she speaks to both sons equally and expects to be obeyed.
CHR-0577.wants: Wants to keep her twin sons from war with each other while Yared reigns this year.
CHR-0577.fears: Fears the twin-born law splitting the realm between her sons, and Tekle's return.

CHR-0578.name: Yared Asfari
CHR-0578.title: Twin King, reigning in 1105
CHR-0578.looks: A strong, handsome man of 34 with a short beard, a green-bordered white shawl, and his twin brother's face.
CHR-0578.manner: Forceful and proud, he speaks of making his odd years count and of undoing his brother's promises.
CHR-0578.wants: Wants Tamar's river gift in silver by 1 March and the Zanari road refused in his reigning year.
CHR-0578.fears: Fears his brother's court and Zanara uniting against him, or Tekle coming home.

CHR-0579.name: Yonas Asfari
CHR-0579.title: Twin King, reigning in even years
CHR-0579.looks: A strong, calm man of 34 with a short beard, a blue-bordered white shawl, and his twin brother's face.
CHR-0579.manner: Thoughtful and patient, he speaks softly and waits for his reigning year to come round again.
CHR-0579.wants: Wants his Road Promise to Zanara honored and its tolls taken in even years.
CHR-0579.fears: Fears his brother voiding everything he builds, and his court's debts to the Gold Houses.

CHR-0580.name: Hailu the Digger
CHR-0580.looks: A stooped, bony man of 55 with clay-stained hands, a digger's leather bag, and a calm, distant face.
CHR-0580.manner: Thoughtful and slow, he speaks of the ancient dead with more care than of the living.
CHR-0580.wants: Wants to keep digging the Long Rift clay below Koyako with the Rememberers' money.
CHR-0580.fears: Fears that new finds will contradict the Rememberers who pay for his digs.

CHR-0581.name: Meron the Red Cow
CHR-0581.looks: A strong, hard young woman of 28 with a red-dyed cow-hide cloak, a cattle raider's spear, and a scarred chin.
CHR-0581.manner: Bold and loud, she laughs at danger and speaks of her dead father with fierce pride.
CHR-0581.wants: Wants to keep selling stolen Tsega cattle to Juma Kanemba's commissaries at Atani.
CHR-0581.fears: Fears Gebre Tsega's riders catching her raiders on the Zutati pastures.

CHR-0583.name: Eleni Sabara
CHR-0583.group: Elite fighters, duelists and school masters
CHR-0583.title: Captain of the Blue Twin Guard
CHR-0583.looks: A tall woman of 34, with a spear-point scar along her jaw and a tall hide shield.
CHR-0583.manner: Steady and loyal, she speaks little, guards her king closely, and carries her twin's secret heavily.
CHR-0583.wants: Wants King Yonas safe and her twin's secret kept, while the courts edge toward war.
CHR-0583.fears: Fears that the birth-cord will come out and break the Compact of 1053, setting the whole realm at war.

CHR-0584.name: Tsion Mekonen
CHR-0584.title: Marshal of the Blue Host
CHR-0584.looks: A tall, strong woman of 32 with a marshal's blue-bordered shawl, a short spear, and her father's grave face.
CHR-0584.manner: Practical and cool, she speaks plainly to soldiers and keeps her own counsel with kings.
CHR-0584.wants: Wants to keep the Blue Host out of a war at Tamowa that her king did not choose.
CHR-0584.fears: Fears Gebre Tsega's war dragging the Blue Host into a fight with Zanara.

CHR-0585.name: Mekdes the Second
CHR-0585.looks: A slight, quiet woman of 34 with her twin's face, a Rememberer's knotted cords, and no marriage ring.
CHR-0585.manner: Gentle and careful, she speaks rarely and reads old cords like others read books.
CHR-0585.wants: Wants the birth-cord of 1029 kept safe and the truth used wisely, not for war.
CHR-0585.fears: Fears Selam learning that her apprentice has read the cord and told her twin sister.

CHR-0587.name: Fikru the Terrace-Maker
CHR-0587.looks: A wiry, sun-darkened man of 44 with engineer's measuring sticks, mud-caked sandals, and calloused hands.
CHR-0587.manner: Practical and honest, he talks of water and stone and avoids politics whenever he can.
CHR-0587.wants: Wants his terraces kept safe from Nia Tembo's road crews, which are cutting toward them.
CHR-0587.fears: Fears being blamed for Tamar's low floods because of the Loati channel he cut.

CHR-0588.name: Desta the Pedlar
CHR-0588.looks: A cheerful, scrawny man of 40 with a pedlar's pack of needles and beads, a dusty shawl, and quick hands.
CHR-0588.manner: Friendly and chatty, he sells trinkets and gossip at every village and never seems to take sides.
CHR-0588.wants: Wants to keep carrying Mesfin Mandari's letters to Tekle and selling copies to Gebre Tsega.
CHR-0588.fears: Fears either side learning that he serves both.
